perReviewer.area: FISHER — Fisher exact test & foundational statistics (FisherExact.cpp/.hpp, MathUtils.cpp/.hpp, Stats.hpp; cross-checked LocalTest.cpp, GlobalTest.cpp, PerCpgAsm.cpp)
perReviewer.notes:
已查且判定為「正確、不報」的項目：(1) test_2x2 雙尾 p 值用 log-sum-exp 累加（FisherExact.cpp:84-106），數值穩定處理正確，並有 extreme-separation 單元測試（test:445-469）驗證不 underflow 到 0；R Lady-Tasting-Tea/no-association 參考值通過。(2) log_factorial 表 + Stirling（含 1/(12n)-1/(360n^3) 修正項）對大 n 正確，有 R lfactorial 參考值測試。(3) log_hypergeom_pmf bounds check (max(0,n-(N-K)), min(n,K)) 正確，PMF 和=1 有測試。(4) log_sum_exp max-shift 與空/全 -inf guard 正確。(5) Wilson score CI（binomial_ci）公式正確（z 用查表 2.576/1.96/1.645 合理）。(6) cramers_v 的 sqrt(chi2/(n*(min_dim-1))) 與 clamp[0,1] 公式正確；is_reliable 用 expected<5 cell 比例>20% 的 Cochran 規則合理。(7) 2x2 走 exact enumeration（非 MC），不受 FISHER-4/5 的 MC 偏差影響。

最高優先：FISHER-1（over-dispersion 未處理，直接命中任務的已知顧慮，HIGH，會膨脹 ASM 率）、FISHER-2（chi_square_p 是 placeholder=Fisher p，欄名語意錯，可能雙重計數，HIGH）、FISHER-3（best_p_value=min-p 無校正 selection bias，HIGH）。需 rerun 量化的：FISHER-1/3/5/8（標 needs_rerun=true）。所有 effect 量級未捏造，僅給方向 + 量化方法。

all_findings.title: read-level CpG 甲基化用 Fisher exact 假設 read 獨立，over-dispersion 完全未處理 → p 值系統性偏小、Fisher_Frac_Sig 膨脹
all_findings.description: per-CpG ASM 對每個 CpG 建 2x2 表（HP1 meth/unmeth × HP2 meth/unmeth），直接餵 test_2x2 跑標準 Fisher exact，再做 BH-FDR。Fisher exact 的 null 假設每個 observation（這裡是一條 read 在一個 CpG 的 binary 甲基化呼叫）是獨立 Bernoulli。但 read-level ONT 甲基化資料明確違反：(a) 同一條 read 跨多個 CpG 高度相關（共享 read-level epialllele state / 共享 basecaller error），(b) 同一 HP 群內的 reads 也非獨立（共享 haplotype 甲基化 program）。沒有任何 over-dispersion / beta-binomial / read-level random effect 處理。grep 全 codebase 無 beta-binomial、無 quasi-binomial、無 GEE/cluster-robust。
all_findings.why_wrong: 當資料 over-dispersed 時，二項/Fisher null 低估 variance，p 值系統性偏小，false-positive 顯著 CpG 數膨脹。result.fisher_frac_sig（=n_sig/n_tested，PerCpgAsm.cpp:336）與 fisher_max_neg_log_fdr 直接被當特徵輸出（RegionProcessor.cpp:1033, 1256），ASM 「存在性」率會被高估。社群（DSS/dmrseq/methylKit）正是為此改用 beta-binomial + shrinkage。BH-FDR 控制的是 family-wise FDR 假設各檢定 p 值在 null 下 ~Uniform，但若每個 p 本身偏小，FDR 也失效。
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: Fisher_Frac_Sig 與 fisher_max_neg_log_fdr 系統性偏高（顯著 CpG 偏多）；TP vs FP / HP-axis 的 ASM 率差會被同向放大，方向結論可能仍成立但量值不可信。
all_findings.quantification_method: 取若干 region 的 methylation.csv（read×CpG），對同一 2x2 counts 分別跑 (a) 現行 Fisher exact、(b) beta-binomial / Fisher 但以 read 為 cluster 的 permutation（shuffle HP label 在 read 層而非 read×CpG 層）得 empirical null，比較 fisher_frac_sig 與 permutation-based frac_sig 的差。也可對 significance_summary.csv 的 Fisher_Frac_Sig 欄與 PERMANOVA p（read-level permutation，已正確處理相依）做散點對照，看 Fisher 是否系統性更顯著。
all_findings.fix_direction: per-CpG 檢定改 beta-binomial（如 DSS 的 Wald on arcsine 或 methylKit 的 over-dispersion 校正），或至少把 read 當 cluster 做 read-level permutation null 取代 hypergeometric null；若維持 Fisher 僅作描述，需在輸出明標『independence-assumed, anti-conservative』並以 read-level PERMANOVA 為主判據。

all_findings.title: chi_square_p 欄位是 placeholder（直接複製 Fisher MC p），並非 chi-square 分布 p 值 — 欄名與語意不符
all_findings.description: GlobalTestResult.chi_square_p 宣稱是 chi-square 檢定 p 值（Stats.hpp:187），但 GlobalTest.cpp 計算完 chi_square 統計量後，p 值處 hardcode `result.chi_square_p = result.fisher_ffh.p_value;  // Placeholder`，註解明寫『we skip p-value computation』『In production, you'd use a chi-square CDF』。MathUtils 也沒有任何 chi-square CDF / gamma incomplete function。
all_findings.why_wrong: 任何讀 chi_square_p 的 downstream / 報告會以為它是獨立的卡方檢定 p（自由度 (r-1)(c-1)），實際上是 Monte-Carlo Fisher p 的複製。兩者數值與假設不同（卡方是大樣本近似、Fisher 是 exact MC）。若論文或表格把『chi-square p』與『Fisher p』當兩個獨立證據並列，等於同一數字重複計數；且該欄完全不反映卡方統計量。chi_square_reliable（cell expected≥5 比例）這個 gate 因此也沒有對應的真 p 值可守門。
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: 任何引用 chi_square_p 的分析會把 Fisher MC p 誤當卡方 p（雙重計數同一證據）；若無 downstream 引用則僅是 dead/misleading 欄位（影響降為文件正確性）。
all_findings.quantification_method: grep chi_square_p 在 scripts/ 與 docs/ 報告的使用；若有 region 表把 chi_square_p 與 fisher p 當兩欄展示，檢查兩欄是否逐列相等（會暴露 placeholder）。
all_findings.fix_direction: 要嘛真正實作卡方 CDF（用 std::tgamma 的 regularized lower incomplete gamma P((r-1)(c-1)/2, chi2/2)）填 chi_square_p，要嘛刪除此欄並在 schema 標註只用 Fisher MC p，避免被誤引。

all_findings.title: LocalTest 取多 cluster × 多維度的最小 p 值當 best_p_value，無任何 multiple-testing 校正（selection bias）
all_findings.description: test_all 對每個 cluster 跑 allele/hp/hp_family/sample 四個維度的 One-vs-Rest Fisher，然後在 all clusters × 4 dimensions 範圍內取『最小 p 值』作為 best_p_value 與 best_dimension，未做任何 Bonferroni/maxT/permutation 校正。best_p_value 被輸出為 Local_Best_P 並進 is_significant 判定（RegionProcessor.cpp:1267-1268）。
all_findings.why_wrong: 『取 K 個檢定的最小 p』本身不是有效 p 值：在 null 下最小 p 的分布遠小於 Uniform，E[min p] ≈ 1/(K+1)。cluster 數 × 4 維度可達 8-20+ 個檢定，min-p 會系統性偏小，把純 noise region 也判顯著。這與 PerCpgAsm 有做 BH-FDR 形成不一致雙重標準（per-CpG 有校正、per-cluster best 沒校正）。
all_findings.evidence: LocalTest.cpp:289-320: 對每個 cs 逐一 `if (cs.fisher_allele.p_value < result.best_p_value) { result.best_p_value = ...; }` 重複 4 維度，跨所有 cluster 取 min；無 *n_tests 或 maxT permutation。RegionProcessor.cpp:1605 result.local_best_p_value = sig_result.local_result.best_p_value 後直接寫表。
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: Local_Best_P 系統性偏小、被標 significant 的 region 偏多，cluster 數越多的 region 偏差越大（與 n_reads/n_clusters confound）。
all_findings.quantification_method: 在 significance_summary.csv 對 Local_Best_P 與『每 region 的檢定數 K（cluster 數 × 有效維度）』做迴歸/分層，看 Local_Best_P 是否隨 K 單調下降（selection bias 指紋）；或對 HP-shuffle null region 比較校正前後的 significant 比例。
all_findings.fix_direction: best_p_value 改報『校正後最小 p』：Bonferroni（min_p × K）或 maxT permutation（shuffle cluster label 重算 min-p 的 null 分布），並在輸出記錄 K。

all_findings.title: RxC Monte-Carlo p 值未把 observed table 計入分子，可得 p=0（anti-conservative，違反 MC p 應為 (b+1)/(m+1)）
all_findings.description: test_rxc_mc 以 n_extreme = #{sampled table with logP <= logP_obs} 累加，最後 p_value = n_extreme / n_samples。標準 Monte-Carlo permutation p 應為 (n_extreme + 1)/(n_samples + 1)（把 observed 自身算進去），保證 p>0 且 unbiased。現行公式在強訊號（無任何 sampled table 比 observed 更極端）時回傳 0。
all_findings.why_wrong: p=0 在數學上不可能（observed 自己 P(table) ≤ P(obs) 恆成立），且後續 -log10(p) 會 inf；MC p=0 是已知 anti-conservative 偏差。R 的 fisher.test(simulate.p.value=TRUE) 正是用 (b+1)/(B+1)。早停（early stopping）用 binomial_ci 估 p，但最終點估計仍用未加 1 的比例。
all_findings.evidence: FisherExact.cpp:285 `int n_extreme = 0;` ... :293-295 `if (log_p_sample <= log_p_obs + 1e-10) { ++n_extreme; }` ... :314 `result.p_value = static_cast<double>(n_extreme) / static_cast<double>(result.n_samples);` — 無 +1。
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: 強訊號 region 的 fisher_ffh.p 可能為 0（下游 -log10 → inf，或被 clamp）；中等訊號 p 略偏小一個量級 1/m。方向不變但極端 region 的 p 數值失真。
all_findings.quantification_method: 對 cells={50,0,0,50} 類 region 觀察輸出 fisher_ffh p 是否為 0；或對固定 seed region 比較 (n_extreme)/m 與 (n_extreme+1)/(m+1) 的差，對 m=2000 約差 5e-4。
all_findings.fix_direction: 改 p_value = (n_extreme + 1)/(n_samples + 1)，並對應修早停 CI 的成功數定義。

all_findings.title: Patefield 條件分布抽樣用未正規化 cumsum 當 uniform 上界，且 col1 殘量耗盡時前面 cell 仍從 N 抽 → 邊緣不守恆風險 / null 分布偏
all_findings.description: sample_table_with_marginals 對每個 cell 即時建 hypergeometric CDF：`std::uniform_real_distribution<double> dist(0.0, cumsum)`，其中 cumsum 是 PMF 在 [k_min,k_max] 上的『未必等於 1』的累加（hypergeom_pmf 各值理論和=1，但浮點累加 + bounds 截斷可能 <1）。用 cumsum 當上界而非 1.0 是一種隱式正規化，掩蓋了 PMF 不完整的問題；更關鍵的是這是『簡化版 Patefield』（作者註明 :157-158），逐 cell 用邊際 hypergeometric 連乘，並非 Patefield 1981 的精確條件抽樣，可能不嚴格產生 uniform-over-tables-with-fixed-marginals 的 null。
all_findings.why_wrong: 若抽樣分布偏離『固定邊際下的均勻表分布』，test_rxc_mc 的 null 就錯，p 值有偏。即使 cumsum 正規化讓單 cell 抽樣合法，逐 cell greedy 連乘的聯合分布不等於正確的多維 hypergeometric（Patefield 用特定條件順序與精確 PMF 才保證）。tie 容差 +1e-10（:97, :293）對 logP 比較合理，但抽樣本身的正確性未被任何單元測試以分布層級驗證（test 只查 p∈[0,1] 與強訊號顯著，不查 null 校準）。
all_findings.evidence: FisherExact.cpp:155-158 註解 `// This is a simplified version using sequential filling`；:192-199 `for k: p=hypergeom_pmf(...); cumsum+=p; cdf.push_back(cumsum);` 然後 `dist(0.0, cumsum)`（非 1.0）。無 null 校準測試（test_significance_stats.cpp 只有 FisherRxC_BasicTest/StrongAssociation/EarlyStopping）。
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: RxC（HP fine 4-group、cluster×label）的 fisher_ffh.p 校準可能偏（方向難定，需 null 模擬）；2x2 不受影響（2x2 走 exact enumeration，非 MC）。
all_findings.quantification_method: 離線小腳本：固定一組邊際，跑 N=1e5 次 sample_table_with_marginals，比對抽到各表的頻率 vs 理論 multivariate hypergeometric P(table)，做 chi-square goodness-of-fit；或對已知邊際的小表，比較 test_rxc_mc p 與 R fisher.test(simulate.p.value) / exact FFH。
all_findings.fix_direction: 改用正規 Patefield (1981) AS159 或 R 的 rcont2；或至少加一個 null-calibration 單元測試（uniform 邊際下 p 應 ~Uniform）。uniform 上界改回 1.0 並 assert |cumsum-1|<eps 以暴露 PMF 不完整。

all_findings.title: FullLabel::combo_code Allele UNKNOWN=2(binary 10) 與 HP 低位 bit (bit2) 重疊，combo code 碰撞
all_findings.description: combo_code 宣稱 Bits 0-1 = Allele、Bits 2-4 = HP。但 allele=UNKNOWN 時 `code |= 2`（binary 10），佔 bit1 沒問題；HP 用 `code |= (hp_code << 2)`。bit0-1 容納 0/1/2 沒溢位（2 仍在 2-bit 內）。實際碰撞風險在另一處：allele 值 2 = `10`，仍只佔 bit0-1，未越界——重新核對後 bit 配置正確。但 hp_code 預設『unphase=5』而 enum 設計只列 0-5，5<<2 佔 bit2-4（5=101 需 3 bits，OK）。經逐位驗證 bit 分配不衝突。此項實為低風險，僅文件化『UNKNOWN=2 用滿 2-bit、無保留值』供後續若要擴 allele 類別時注意。
all_findings.why_wrong: combo_code 僅用於 debug/traceability（Stats.hpp:62-63『for debugging and traceability』），不進統計檢定，故即使未來擴充 allele>2 類會碰撞，當前無數值影響。標 LOW/INFO 以記錄邊界。
all_findings.evidence: FisherExact.cpp:354-364 allele switch `code |= 0/1/2`；:367-379 `hp_code` 0-5 後 `code |= (hp_code<<2)`。test_significance_stats.cpp:362-383 驗 code=0 與 code=101 通過（但未測 UNKNOWN allele 的 code）。
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: 當前無統計影響（combo_code 不入檢定）；僅為未來擴充 allele 類別的 latent 碰撞。
all_findings.quantification_method: 無需資料；靜態確認 combo_code 僅用於輸出欄非檢定即可。
all_findings.fix_direction: 若日後 allele 類別 >3，需把 allele 改 3-bit 或重排 bit 配置；目前加註解標明 bit0-1 已用滿。

all_findings.title: Fisher exact 全程雙尾 (logP<=logP_obs)，但下游有 HP1−HP2 有向 Δβ — 雙尾 p 與有向 effect 並用時方向性未被檢定
all_findings.description: test_2x2 嚴格雙尾（two-sided，sum P(table)<=P(obs)），符合宣稱（R fisher.test 預設）。per-CpG ASM 同時輸出有向 delta = hp1_frac − hp2_frac（PerCpgAsm.cpp:310）。雙尾 p 配有向 effect 本身可接受，但若報告把『顯著且 Δβ>0』當 HP1 hyper 的『單尾證據』，雙尾 p 對單尾結論偏保守 2x（方向反）。這非 bug，是口徑一致性提醒：顯著性是雙尾、effect 是有向，兩者語意要對齊。
all_findings.why_wrong: 非錯誤；屬口徑一致性。若需要『HP1 顯著高於 HP2』的有向宣稱，雙尾 p 是 conservative（不會 inflate FP），故方向上安全，僅 power 略損。標 LOW。
all_findings.evidence: FisherExact.cpp:96-98 `// Two-sided: include if P(k) <= P(observed)` `if (log_p_k <= log_p_obs + 1e-10)`；PerCpgAsm.cpp:310 `deltas[j] = hp1_frac - hp2_frac;`（有向）。
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: 雙尾→單尾宣稱時保守，不會造成 FP 膨脹（方向安全）；僅 power 較低。
all_findings.quantification_method: 無需重跑；確認報告對『顯著 + 有向 Δβ』的措辭與雙尾 p 一致即可。
all_findings.fix_direction: 若有單尾假設，明示並改單尾累加（只累 logP<=logP_obs 且 same-sign deviation 的尾）；否則維持雙尾並在報告標明顯著性為雙尾。

all_findings.title: per-CpG BH-FDR 只在『單一 region 內』跨 CpG 校正，未跨 region/全基因組校正 → 全域 FP 仍未控
all_findings.description: bh_fdr_correction 對 raw_pvalues（一個 region 內所有 CpG）做 BH，輸出 fisher_n_sig / fisher_frac_sig / max_neg_log_fdr。但這是 per-region local FDR；當把全基因組數萬 region × 多 CpG 的 Fisher_Frac_Sig 拿來宣稱『ASM 廣泛存在』或當特徵時，跨 region 的 multiplicity 未被控制（每個 region 都用 α=0.05 的 local FDR，全域 FP 累積）。
all_findings.why_wrong: local（region 內）FDR 控制的是該 region 內 CpG 的 FDR，不等於全基因組 region-level FDR。若論文用『多少 region 有顯著 ASM CpG』作存在性證據，正確做法應對 region-level summary p（或把全部 CpG p 池化）再做一次全域 BH。否則 region 數越多、報出的『至少一個顯著 CpG』region 越多，全域 FP 線性累積。
all_findings.evidence: PerCpgAsm.cpp:319 `std::vector<double> fdr = bh_fdr_correction(raw_pvalues);`（raw_pvalues 只含本 region n_cpgs 個）；:326 `if (fdr[j] < 0.05) n_sig++;` 每 region 獨立用 0.05。無全域 pooling。
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: 以 region-count 為基礎的 ASM 存在性比例會被全域 multiplicity 膨脹（region 數越多偏差越大）；frac_sig 作 per-region 特徵時則受 local FDR 影響較小。
all_findings.quantification_method: 把全 region 的 raw per-CpG p 池化跑一次全域 BH，比較『全域顯著 CpG 數 / region 數』vs 現行『各 region 自報 n_sig 加總』，量化膨脹；或對 HP-shuffle null 全基因組跑，看現行管線報出的顯著 region 比例是否 >5%。
all_findings.fix_direction: 存在性宣稱層級加全域 FDR：把所有 region 的 per-CpG p 池化後全域 BH，或對 region-level 統計（如 region min-p 經 maxT 校正）再做跨 region BH/Bonferroni。

all_findings.title: odds_ratio 永遠加 Haldane-Anscombe +0.5（即使 cell 無零），對非稀疏表引入向 1 收縮的系統偏
all_findings.description: odds_ratio 與 log_odds_ratio 無條件對全部 cell +0.5（Haldane-Anscombe），不論是否有 zero cell。Haldane 校正的標準用法是『僅在有 0 cell 時』套用，對大 count 表無條件 +0.5 會把 OR 向 1 收縮（attenuation），低估 effect 量值。
all_findings.why_wrong: 對 a,b,c,d 都大的表，+0.5 影響可忽略；但對中等 count（單位數~十幾）的 cluster One-vs-Rest 表，+0.5 會系統性把 log_odds_ratio 往 0 拉，使 best_log_odds_ratio（LocalTest 輸出的 effect）偏保守、低估。方向安全（不會 inflate），但 effect 量值偏小。
all_findings.evidence: MathUtils.cpp:82-88 `// Haldane-Anscombe correction: add 0.5 to all cells` 無 if-zero 條件，直接 a+0.5 等。test_significance_stats.cpp:106-118 也以含校正值為 expected（把行為釘住）。
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: log_odds_ratio / best_log_odds_ratio 系統性向 0 收縮（effect 偏小），中小 count 表偏差較大；不影響 p 值（p 由 Fisher hypergeometric 算，不經此 OR）。
all_findings.quantification_method: 對若干 cluster 2x2 表分別算 +0.5（現行）與條件式（僅 zero-cell 才 +0.5）的 OR，量化 best_log_odds_ratio 的偏移；檢查是否有報告用此 OR 量值做生物學解讀。
all_findings.fix_direction: 改為條件式 Haldane（僅當任一 cell=0 才 +0.5），或明標輸出 OR 為 Haldane-corrected 並在報告用 CI 而非點估計解讀。

verified_high.title: read-level CpG 甲基化用 Fisher exact 假設 read 獨立，over-dispersion 完全未處理 → p 值系統性偏小、Fisher_Frac_Sig 膨脹
verified_high.description: per-CpG ASM 對每個 CpG 建 2x2 表（HP1 meth/unmeth × HP2 meth/unmeth），直接餵 test_2x2 跑標準 Fisher exact，再做 BH-FDR。Fisher exact 的 null 假設每個 observation（這裡是一條 read 在一個 CpG 的 binary 甲基化呼叫）是獨立 Bernoulli。但 read-level ONT 甲基化資料明確違反：(a) 同一條 read 跨多個 CpG 高度相關（共享 read-level epialllele state / 共享 basecaller error），(b) 同一 HP 群內的 reads 也非獨立（共享 haplotype 甲基化 program）。沒有任何 over-dispersion / beta-binomial / read-level random effect 處理。grep 全 codebase 無 beta-binomial、無 quasi-binomial、無 GEE/cluster-robust。
verified_high.why_wrong: 當資料 over-dispersed 時，二項/Fisher null 低估 variance，p 值系統性偏小，false-positive 顯著 CpG 數膨脹。result.fisher_frac_sig（=n_sig/n_tested，PerCpgAsm.cpp:336）與 fisher_max_neg_log_fdr 直接被當特徵輸出（RegionProcessor.cpp:1033, 1256），ASM 「存在性」率會被高估。社群（DSS/dmrseq/methylKit）正是為此改用 beta-binomial + shrinkage。BH-FDR 控制的是 family-wise FDR 假設各檢定 p 值在 null 下 ~Uniform，但若每個 p 本身偏小，FDR 也失效。
verified_high.effect_hypothesis: Fisher_Frac_Sig 與 fisher_max_neg_log_fdr 系統性偏高（顯著 CpG 偏多）；TP vs FP / HP-axis 的 ASM 率差會被同向放大，方向結論可能仍成立但量值不可信。
verified_high.quantification_method: 取若干 region 的 methylation.csv（read×CpG），對同一 2x2 counts 分別跑 (a) 現行 Fisher exact、(b) beta-binomial / Fisher 但以 read 為 cluster 的 permutation（shuffle HP label 在 read 層而非 read×CpG 層）得 empirical null，比較 fisher_frac_sig 與 permutation-based frac_sig 的差。也可對 significance_summary.csv 的 Fisher_Frac_Sig 欄與 PERMANOVA p（read-level permutation，已正確處理相依）做散點對照，看 Fisher 是否系統性更顯著。
verified_high.fix_direction: per-CpG 檢定改 beta-binomial（如 DSS 的 Wald on arcsine 或 methylKit 的 over-dispersion 校正），或至少把 read 當 cluster 做 read-level permutation null 取代 hypergeometric null；若維持 Fisher 僅作描述，需在輸出明標『independence-assumed, anti-conservative』並以 read-level PERMANOVA 為主判據。

verdict.reasoning:
CONFIRMED as a real statistical limitation, but claimed severity HIGH is overstated → MEDIUM.

CODE FACTS (all verified):
- PerCpgAsm.cpp:228-249: rows of the methylation matrix ARE individual reads (n_reads = meth_mat.num_reads()); hp1_indices/hp2_indices are read-level lists.
- PerCpgAsm.cpp:274-313: for each CpG j, each read's call (val>0.5 → meth, else unmeth) increments one cell of a 2x2 (hp1_meth/hp1_unmeth/hp2_meth/hp2_unmeth), fed straight into fisher.test_2x2 (line 304). So each read×CpG binary call is treated as an independent Bernoulli observation. Correct.
- FisherExact.cpp:55-109 + log_table_prob_2x2 (42-53): pure two-sided hypergeometric Fisher exact (log-sum-exp tail), zero inflation/dispersion parameter. Correct.
- PerCpgAsm.cpp:317-337: BH-FDR (bh_fdr_correction, standard) → fisher_frac_sig = n_sig/n_tested.
- Downstream wiring confirmed: RegionProcessor.cpp:1032-1035 copies into result; :1255-1258 emits per_cpg_fisher_n_sig / _frac_sig / _max_neg_log_fdr as CSV features. So these ARE feature outputs.
- grep over src/include for beta-binomial/quasi-binomial/over-dispersion/GEE/cluster-robust/random-effect/mixed-model/shrinkage: NONE related to read-level inference (only StructureTest.cpp check_dispersion = betadisper-style PERMANOVA variance homogeneity, unrelated). So the "no over-dispersion handling anywhere" claim is accurate.

STRONG INDEPENDENT CORROBORATION: the project's OWN method-comparison study reaches the identical conclusion and ranks it #1 highest-ROI fix — 05_improve_learn_recommendations.md:48-50 + :47-49: "ONT 長讀同 haplotype/clone reads 非獨立 → true over-dispersion φ>0 → Fisher (φ=0) 低估變異、p 偏小 → 顯著位點膨脹". methylKit comparison (02_external_tools_survey.md:53) notes methylKit offers an explicit overdispersion 'MN' option even when using Fisher — i.e. the field recognizes this. The direction of bias (p too small, sig-count inflated) is sound.

WHY SEVERITY DOWNGRADED FROM HIGH → MEDIUM (skeptical adjustments):
1. The finding's point (a) is partially mis-attributed: "same read across multiple CpGs is correlated" does NOT create over-dispersion WITHIN a single 2x2 table (each read contributes exactly one increment per CpG-table). Cross-CpG correlation instead affects only the BH-FDR step (correlated p-values), and BH controls FDR under positive dependency (PRDS, Benjamini-Yekutieli) so is partly robust. The genuinely valid over-dispersion source is point (b): reads within one HP group sharing an epiallele/sub-clone program → super-binomial within-row proportion. So the mechanism is real but the finding conflates two distinct correlation structures.
2. Impact on the project's conclusions is limited. fisher_frac_sig is empirically near-non-discriminative for TP/FP (AUC ≈ 0.50–0.55: docs/experiments/.../20260423_B4_S4_Secondary_Discrimination_01.md:48 = 0.549; ReadParser doc 20260421...:109 ΔAUC +0.008) and is used for biological characterization/LOH stratification (20260415_PerCpG_ASM_Epiallele_Metrics_01.md), NOT in any production filter. The project's headline ASM-existence claims rest on the HP-axis Δβ / excess-over-null + HP-shuffle permutation null pipeline (self-calibrated against a null label-shuffle, immune to the Fisher independence assumption), not on the absolute calibration of fisher_frac_sig. So "ASM 存在性率被高估" would bias a secondary descriptive count (number of FDR<0.05 CpGs), not the load-bearing conclusions.

Net: a genuine, correctly-identified methodological weakness already on the project's roadmap, but conclusions do not currently hinge on it and the affected feature is near-random for discrimination → MEDIUM, not HIGH.

verified_high.title: chi_square_p 欄位是 placeholder（直接複製 Fisher MC p），並非 chi-square 分布 p 值 — 欄名與語意不符
verified_high.description: GlobalTestResult.chi_square_p 宣稱是 chi-square 檢定 p 值（Stats.hpp:187），但 GlobalTest.cpp 計算完 chi_square 統計量後，p 值處 hardcode `result.chi_square_p = result.fisher_ffh.p_value;  // Placeholder`，註解明寫『we skip p-value computation』『In production, you'd use a chi-square CDF』。MathUtils 也沒有任何 chi-square CDF / gamma incomplete function。
verified_high.why_wrong: 任何讀 chi_square_p 的 downstream / 報告會以為它是獨立的卡方檢定 p（自由度 (r-1)(c-1)），實際上是 Monte-Carlo Fisher p 的複製。兩者數值與假設不同（卡方是大樣本近似、Fisher 是 exact MC）。若論文或表格把『chi-square p』與『Fisher p』當兩個獨立證據並列，等於同一數字重複計數；且該欄完全不反映卡方統計量。chi_square_reliable（cell expected≥5 比例）這個 gate 因此也沒有對應的真 p 值可守門。
verified_high.effect_hypothesis: 任何引用 chi_square_p 的分析會把 Fisher MC p 誤當卡方 p（雙重計數同一證據）；若無 downstream 引用則僅是 dead/misleading 欄位（影響降為文件正確性）。
verified_high.quantification_method: grep chi_square_p 在 scripts/ 與 docs/ 報告的使用；若有 region 表把 chi_square_p 與 fisher p 當兩欄展示，檢查兩欄是否逐列相等（會暴露 placeholder）。
verified_high.fix_direction: 要嘛真正實作卡方 CDF（用 std::tgamma 的 regularized lower incomplete gamma P((r-1)(c-1)/2, chi2/2)）填 chi_square_p，要嘛刪除此欄並在 schema 標註只用 Fisher MC p，避免被誤引。

verdict.reasoning:
The factual core is CONFIRMED verbatim. GlobalTest.cpp:124 reads `result.chi_square_p = result.fisher_ffh.p_value;  // Placeholder`, with comments at lines 121-123 stating "we skip p-value computation and rely on Fisher test" / "In production, you'd use a chi-square CDF". Stats.hpp:186-188 declares `double chi_square_p = 1.0;` under the "Chi-square test (if valid)" comment, so the field name does claim chi-square semantics while holding a Monte-Carlo Fisher p-value. MathUtils.cpp only computes the chi2 statistic (MathUtils.cpp:105) and has no chi-square CDF / incomplete-gamma, confirming no real chi-square p exists. So the naming-vs-semantics mismatch is real.

HOWEVER the claimed HIGH severity is overstated and the central harm scenario is REFUTED by the call graph. I traced every consumer of `chi_square_p`: it is WRITTEN ONCE (GlobalTest.cpp:124) and READ NOWHERE. (a) Not emitted to significance_summary.csv — the header at RegionProcessor.cpp:1078-1122 has no chi-square p column. (b) Not emitted to significance.json (RegionProcessor.cpp ~1716+) which writes fisher_ffh.p_value / cramers_v / PERMANOVA p only. (c) Not used by apply_gating (GlobalTest.cpp:140 uses fisher_ffh.p_value). (d) Not used in the significance determination (RegionProcessor.cpp:1143-1146 uses global_p_value + cramers_v). (e) No Python/report consumer references "chi_square" at all (grep over scripts/ research/ *.py returned empty). The test file mention (test_significance_stats.cpp:9) is only a docstring, asserting nothing about chi_square_p. The reviewer's headline harm — a paper listing "chi-square p" and "Fisher p" as two independent evidence pieces and double-counting — is conditional and NOT realized: no output surface exposes the field, so no current report can double-count it. The chi_square_reliable gate concern is similarly moot since chi_square_reliable is also unconsumed by gating/output.

Net: a genuine latent defect (dead, mislabeled struct field that would mislead anyone naively serializing GlobalTestResult), but not an active correctness bug producing wrong outputs today, and the double-counting harm is purely hypothetical given the call graph. Correct severity is LOW, not HIGH.

verified_high.title: LocalTest 取多 cluster × 多維度的最小 p 值當 best_p_value，無任何 multiple-testing 校正（selection bias）
verified_high.description: test_all 對每個 cluster 跑 allele/hp/hp_family/sample 四個維度的 One-vs-Rest Fisher，然後在 all clusters × 4 dimensions 範圍內取『最小 p 值』作為 best_p_value 與 best_dimension，未做任何 Bonferroni/maxT/permutation 校正。best_p_value 被輸出為 Local_Best_P 並進 is_significant 判定（RegionProcessor.cpp:1267-1268）。
verified_high.why_wrong: 『取 K 個檢定的最小 p』本身不是有效 p 值：在 null 下最小 p 的分布遠小於 Uniform，E[min p] ≈ 1/(K+1)。cluster 數 × 4 維度可達 8-20+ 個檢定，min-p 會系統性偏小，把純 noise region 也判顯著。這與 PerCpgAsm 有做 BH-FDR 形成不一致雙重標準（per-CpG 有校正、per-cluster best 沒校正）。
verified_high.evidence: LocalTest.cpp:289-320: 對每個 cs 逐一 `if (cs.fisher_allele.p_value < result.best_p_value) { result.best_p_value = ...; }` 重複 4 維度，跨所有 cluster 取 min；無 *n_tests 或 maxT permutation。RegionProcessor.cpp:1605 result.local_best_p_value = sig_result.local_result.best_p_value 後直接寫表。
verified_high.effect_hypothesis: Local_Best_P 系統性偏小、被標 significant 的 region 偏多，cluster 數越多的 region 偏差越大（與 n_reads/n_clusters confound）。
verified_high.quantification_method: 在 significance_summary.csv 對 Local_Best_P 與『每 region 的檢定數 K（cluster 數 × 有效維度）』做迴歸/分層，看 Local_Best_P 是否隨 K 單調下降（selection bias 指紋）；或對 HP-shuffle null region 比較校正前後的 significant 比例。
verified_high.fix_direction: best_p_value 改報『校正後最小 p』：Bonferroni（min_p × K）或 maxT permutation（shuffle cluster label 重算 min-p 的 null 分布），並在輸出記錄 K。

verdict.reasoning:
The finding's statistical mechanism is real, but its load-bearing impact claim is factually wrong, and that claim is what justifies HIGH severity.

WHAT IS TRUE: LocalTest.cpp:285-321 (test_all) does take the minimum p-value across all clusters × 4 dimensions (allele/hp/hp_family/sample) via repeated `if (cs.fisher_X.p_value < result.best_p_value) {...}` with no Bonferroni/maxT/permutation correction. The reviewer's note that uncorrected min-p is biased small under null is statistically correct.

WHAT IS FALSE (the decisive part): The finding claims "best_p_value 被輸出為 Local_Best_P 並進 is_significant 判定（RegionProcessor.cpp:1267-1268）". I read those lines. Line 1267 writes `r.local_best_p_value` as a CSV column; line 1268 writes the already-computed `is_significant` flag as the next CSV column. They are adjacent output fields, NOT a causal dependency. The reviewer misread CSV column adjacency as the significance gate.

The actual significance decision is at RegionProcessor.cpp:1143-1146: `is_significant = r.passed_gating && (r.global_p_value <= 0.05) && (r.cramers_v >= 0.1) && (r.num_reads >= 20)`. It uses `global_p_value` (= std::min of p_alt/p_hp/p_hp_family from the GLOBAL Fisher tests, line 1590), `cramers_v`, gating, and read count — it never references `local_best_p_value`.

I grepped every consumer of `local_result.best_p_value` / `local_best_p_value` in src/core + include/core: the ONLY downstream writes are the CSV column (line 1267) and the JSON report. It feeds no decision. Confirmed the other classification paths also exclude it: SignificanceAnalyzer.cpp:309-311 `cluster_significant` uses global_alt/global_hp_family Fisher p-values; verification_class (326-340) uses label_sig + cluster_significant; compute_heuristic_score (378-409) explicitly takes min over global_alt/global_hp/global_hp_family, NOT the LocalTest result.

CONCLUSION: The uncorrected min-p is a purely descriptive/diagnostic field (Local_Best_P column + JSON). It does NOT "把純 noise region 也判顯著" because it participates in no significance verdict. The claimed PerCpgAsm-vs-LocalTest "雙重標準" is moot since LocalTest's p never gates anything. Residual concern is real but minor: an analyst reading the Local_Best_P column at face value could over-interpret it — a labeling/documentation issue (could add an n_tests/correction note), not a HIGH-severity selection-bias bug in the significance pipeline. The finding as stated (mechanism + impact + cited evidence chain) is refuted on the impact and the evidence; downgraded to INFO.

perReviewer.area: PERMANOVA / permutation / bootstrap / structure tests (StructureTest, LocalTest, GlobalTest, Bootstrap, LabelTest permanova paths)
perReviewer.notes:
Verified-correct items (NOT reported as findings): (1) PERMANOVA permutation p-value uses the textbook (b+1)/(B+1) estimator — n_extreme initialized to 1 to include the observed statistic, denominator n_permutations+1, in BOTH StructureTest.cpp:188/198 and all four LabelTest paths (L388/432, 568/579, 702/713, 850/896). Correct. (2) The pseudo-F one-sidedness (perm_f >= observed) is correct for an inherently one-sided F. (3) The SS decomposition in StructureTest::compute_ss (L107-138) is algebraically equivalent to ss_total - ss_within; I worked through the algebra: ss_between = cross_raw/n + Σ_g within_raw_g*(1/n - 1/n_g), which equals total_raw/n - Σ within_raw_g/n_g exactly. The catastrophic-cancellation-avoidance and the ss_within=0 → 1e9 sentinel are intentional and unit-tested (test_structure_bootstrap.cpp:364-463). Correct and well-engineered. (4) Seed reproducibility for the production region path is fine: a fresh SignificanceAnalyzer is constructed per SNV (RegionProcessor.cpp:1581) seeded at top-level 42 → structure seed 44, so per-region permutation nulls are deterministic and order-independent (NOT the shared-rng order-dependence I initially suspected). df_between=k-1, df_within=n-k are correct. The bootstrap resamples CpG columns (correct unit for cluster-stability) and ARI math (Bootstrap.cpp:30-81) is the standard Hubert-Arabie form.

Cross-module inconsistency theme worth the parent's attention: there are THREE separate PERMANOVA implementations (StructureTest::run_permanova, LabelTest hp_permanova at L508, LabelTest fine_p at L644) with DIVERGENT edge-case handling — StructureTest refuses NaN + uses 1e9 sentinel; both LabelTest copies coerce NaN→0 AND return F=0 on zero within-SS. The two divergences (PERMANOVA-1 anti-conservative, PERMANOVA-2 conservative) act in OPPOSITE directions depending on region sparsity, so net effect on any aggregate ASM rate is data-dependent and must be measured, not assumed. Highest-priority to quantify first: PERMANOVA-1 (HIGH) and PERMANOVA-3 (HIGH), then PERMANOVA-5 (p-floor) since it bounds genome-wide claims. Consolidating to a single SS/pseudo-F implementation (StructureTest's) would fix PERMANOVA-1, PERMANOVA-2 at once.

Scope note: FDR (BH) exists only within per-CpG ASM (PerCpgAsm.cpp:26), confirmed by grep — there is no genome-wide region-level multiple-testing correction in any of the structure-test modules (PERMANOVA-6).

all_findings.title: LabelTest PERMANOVA substitutes missing (NaN) pairwise distances with 0 → 'identical reads' artifact inflates within-group cohesion and pseudo-F
all_findings.description: In the label-based PERMANOVA paths (hp_permanova at L508-517 and the actively-reported fine_p path at L644-652), the sub-distance matrix is built with `sub_dist(i,j) = std::isnan(d) ? 0.0 : d;`. Read pairs with no overlapping CpG (genuinely undefined methylation distance) are coerced to distance 0, i.e. treated as perfectly identical. StructureTest::run_permanova by contrast refuses the whole region on any NaN (StructureTest.cpp:164-172) and the Phase-3 path pre-filters reads to a complete matrix.
all_findings.why_wrong: A NaN distance means 'no shared CpG, distance undefined', not 'distance = 0'. Setting it to 0 adds spurious within-group (and between-group) similarity. Because reads of the same HP group are more likely to be co-incident in sparse short windows, NaN→0 tends to shrink ss_within more than ss_between, inflating pseudo-F and producing anti-conservative (too-small) permutation p-values. This directly affects the HP-fine PERMANOVA that MEMORY notes is used to call 'latent' HP structure (gated CV=0 but PERMANOVA significant).
all_findings.evidence: L515: `sub_dist(i, j) = std::isnan(d) ? 0.0 : d;  // Replace NaN with 0`  and identical L652 in the fine_p path. Contrast StructureTest.cpp:164-172 which returns invalid_reason="incomplete_distance_matrix" on any NaN.
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: Regions with sparse coverage (many NaN read pairs) will show inflated pseudo-F and deflated PERMANOVA p in the LabelTest paths; the bias grows with NaN fraction and could flip borderline regions from non-significant to 'latent HP structure'.
all_findings.quantification_method: From the per-region distance_matrix_*.csv count the fraction of NaN pairs; rerun fine_p PERMANOVA two ways (NaN→0 vs read-filtered-complete, as StructureTest does) on the actual HCC1395 regions and compare pseudo_f and p_value distributions (significance.json hp_permanova_p / fine_p columns). Stratify the p-shift by NaN fraction.
all_findings.fix_direction: Use the same complete-matrix read filtering as StructureTest::filter_reads_for_complete_matrix before the label PERMANOVA, or exclude NaN pairs from both ss_total and ss_within consistently (and recompute df from the retained reads). Never substitute 0 for an undefined distance.

all_findings.title: LabelTest pseudo-F returns 0 when within-group SS = 0 (perfect separation) → perfectly cohesive HP groups get p=1.0 (false negative); inconsistent with StructureTest sentinel
all_findings.description: LabelTest's local `compute_pseudo_f` lambda returns 0.0 whenever `ss_within <= 0.0` (L555 for hp_permanova, L690 for fine_p). With ss_within=0 the F is mathematically +inf (perfect separation), the strongest possible signal. StructureTest::compute_pseudo_f (StructureTest.cpp:143-147) correctly returns a 1e9 sentinel in this case (and it is explicitly unit-tested, test_structure_bootstrap.cpp:386-407).
all_findings.why_wrong: Reads with identical methylation within an HP group (common when reads are short / few CpGs, or perfectly allele-specific) give ss_within=0. Returning F=0 makes observed F never exceed permuted F, so n_extreme stays near max and p→1.0 — the most clearly structured regions are reported as non-significant. This is the opposite-direction error to PERMANOVA-1, and the two LabelTest PERMANOVA implementations disagree with the StructureTest one for the same edge case.
all_findings.evidence: L555: `if (k <= 1 || n <= k || ss_within <= 0.0) return 0.0;` (and L690 identical). Compare StructureTest.cpp:143-147: `if (ss_within <= 0.0) { ... return (ss_between > 0.0) ? 1e9 : 0.0; }`.
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: A subset of perfectly-separated HP-fine regions report fine_p≈1.0 instead of significant; count of such regions is the false-negative load.
all_findings.quantification_method: In significance.json scan for regions where fine_f==0 but the contingency shows full HP separation (cluster perfectly aligned to HP), or where StructureTest cluster_permanova reports 1e9 but label fine_f=0. Count and inspect.
all_findings.fix_direction: Make LabelTest reuse StructureTest::compute_pseudo_f (single source of truth) with the 1e9 sentinel for ss_within=0 & ss_between>0; or compute F=+inf and rank it as most-extreme.

all_findings.title: Dispersion (PERMDISP) p-value is a hardcoded 3-step lookup of the F-statistic, not a real F-CDF or permutation
all_findings.description: check_dispersion computes an ANOVA F on per-read pseudo-distances-to-centroid, then sets `anova_p = anova_f > 4.0 ? 0.01 : (anova_f > 2.5 ? 0.05 : 0.1)` and flags `warning = anova_p < dispersion_alpha`. There is no degrees-of-freedom-aware F distribution CDF and no permutation null; the p-value is one of three magic constants determined by two magic thresholds (2.5, 4.0).
all_findings.why_wrong: The F critical value depends on df1=k-1 and df2=N-k, which vary per region. A fixed threshold of 4.0→p=0.01 is wrong for almost every region (e.g. for df2 small the real critical F is much larger; for df2 large much smaller). This mis-flags dispersion heterogeneity. The dispersion warning feeds result.score_ambiguous (SignificanceAnalyzer.cpp:346) and the verification classification, so a wrong p contaminates whether a region is marked ambiguous. Additionally, the proper PERMDISP procedure is a permutation test on residuals, not a parametric ANOVA — the parametric assumption is itself invalid for distance-to-centroid values.
all_findings.evidence: L292: `result.anova_p = result.anova_f > 4.0 ? 0.01 : (result.anova_f > 2.5 ? 0.05 : 0.1);` consumed at SignificanceAnalyzer.cpp:346 `result.score_ambiguous = result.dispersion_warning || ...`.
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: dispersion_warning is set on a basis uncorrelated with true type-I error; regions with small n_k or many groups will be mis-flagged, perturbing score_ambiguous / verification_class counts. (Note: production main path sets enable_dispersion=false at RegionProcessor.cpp:1575, so impact is limited to the default-on analyze() path and any tool invocation leaving the default.)
all_findings.quantification_method: Compute the true parametric F p-value (boost/std incomplete beta) and a permutation PERMDISP p for the actual all_distances/group_labels per region, compare warning flips vs the lookup table; check how many regions have enable_dispersion on in shipped configs.
all_findings.fix_direction: Replace the lookup with either an F-distribution CDF using correct (k-1, N-k) df, or a proper permutation PERMDISP (shuffle residuals, recompute F). Move 2.5/4.0 out of code regardless.

all_findings.title: Cluster-label PERMANOVA tests cluster labels against the same distance matrix that produced the clusters (circularity) and is emitted as cluster_permanova_p
all_findings.description: In Phase 3, run_permanova is called with filtered_labels = cluster_labels (L118-121), i.e. the PERMANOVA groups ARE the hierarchical-clustering output derived from this very distance matrix. The result is written out as cluster_permanova_f/p (RegionProcessor.cpp:1609-1610) and used as evidence of structure.
all_findings.why_wrong: Clustering partitions reads to maximize between-cluster distance; testing those clusters against the same distances with a label-permutation null is circular and yields anti-conservatively small p-values almost by construction (the observed F is near the maximum the partition can achieve). This is distinct from the valid label_hp/label_allele PERMANOVA (which use externally-defined HP/allele labels, run_grouped_structure L172-267). If downstream analysis treats cluster_permanova_p as independent evidence of real biological structure, it overstates significance. MEMORY notes a 'PERMANOVA gate' used to recover 'latent' structure — that must use the label PERMANOVA, not cluster_permanova.
all_findings.evidence: L118-121 `filtered_labels[i] = cluster_labels[valid_read_indices[i]];` then L123 `result.permanova = run_permanova(filtered_dist, filtered_labels);` emitted at RegionProcessor.cpp:1609-1611 as cluster_permanova_*.
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: cluster_permanova_p is systematically smaller (more significant) than label_hp/label_allele_permanova_p on the same regions; if any selection/gating uses cluster_permanova_p it inflates the apparent structured-region count.
all_findings.quantification_method: From significance.json compare cluster_permanova_p vs label_hp_permanova_p / label_allele_permanova_p distributions across regions; grep scripts (script 88 PERMANOVA gate per MEMORY) to confirm which column the gate uses.
all_findings.fix_direction: Document cluster_permanova as a within-clustering descriptive statistic (not a hypothesis test), and ensure any structure 'gate' uses only the external-label PERMANOVA. If an honest cluster-validity p is wanted, use a null that re-clusters permuted/resampled data (sigclust-style), not label shuffling on fixed clusters.

all_findings.title: Production runs PERMANOVA with only 99 permutations → minimum p-value floor of 0.01, incompatible with genome-wide (~30k region) significance
all_findings.description: The shipped pipeline sets `sig_config.structure_config.n_permutations = 99` (and LabelTest default is 999). With B=99 and the correct (b+1)/(B+1) estimator, the smallest attainable p-value is 1/100 = 0.01. No region can report p<0.01 from PERMANOVA.
all_findings.why_wrong: Across ~30,350 regions (per MEMORY/state), any multiple-testing control (Bonferroni or BH) needs p far below 0.01 to declare a region genome-wide significant. A 0.01 floor means PERMANOVA can never reach genome-wide significance and its p-values saturate at the floor for all truly-structured regions, destroying the ability to rank/threshold them. It also makes per-region p-values coarsely quantized (101 possible values).
all_findings.evidence: L1573 `sig_config.structure_config.n_permutations = 99;`. p formula StructureTest.cpp:198 `n_extreme / (n_permutations + 1)` with n_extreme>=1.
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: All structured regions pile at p=0.01; post-FDR no region survives, or selection collapses to the F-statistic ordering only. Increasing B to >=9999 would spread the tail.
all_findings.quantification_method: Histogram cluster/label permanova_p in significance.json — expect a spike at 0.01. Re-run a sample of strong regions with n_permutations=9999 and compare attainable p and FDR survival.
all_findings.fix_direction: Raise n_permutations for the structure tests (e.g. 9999) for any region intended for genome-wide claims, or use an analytic/Box-approximation F p-value to complement permutation; expose as config not hardcoded.

all_findings.title: No multiple-testing correction on the per-region 'best p-value across dimensions' (LocalTest best_p, heuristic best_p) — selection inflates significance
all_findings.description: LocalTest::test_all selects the single minimum Fisher p across all clusters AND all four dimensions (allele/hp/hp_family/sample) as best_p_value (L285-321). compute_heuristic_score (SignificanceAnalyzer.cpp:384-385) likewise takes min over alt/hp/hp_family. No within-region correction for the number of clusters x dimensions tested, and BH-FDR exists only for per-CpG ASM (PerCpgAsm.cpp:26), not for these region-level minima or across the ~30k regions.
all_findings.why_wrong: Taking the minimum of many Fisher tests (one per cluster per dimension) without adjusting for the number of comparisons makes best_p anti-conservative — a region with several clusters has many chances for a low p by chance. Reporting best_p as the region's significance, and not BH-correcting across regions, biases the genome-wide structured-region count upward.
all_findings.evidence: LocalTest.cpp:289-320 four `if (cs.fisher_*.p_value < result.best_p_value)` updates choosing the global minimum; SignificanceAnalyzer.cpp:385 `double best_p = std::min({p_val_alt, p_val_hp, p_val_hp_family});`. FDR only in PerCpgAsm.cpp.
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: best_p underestimates the true per-region p by roughly the number of effective comparisons; regions with more clusters are preferentially called significant (cluster-count confound).
all_findings.quantification_method: Recompute per-region significance applying a within-region Bonferroni/BH over (n_clusters x n_dimensions) and across-region BH over all regions in significance.json; compare the count of significant regions before/after, and test whether best_p correlates with n_clusters.
all_findings.fix_direction: Apply within-region correction for the number of one-vs-rest tests and report a corrected region p; apply BH across regions before any genome-wide 'significant' claim. At minimum document best_p as an uncorrected minimum.

all_findings.title: Bootstrap stability validates a trivial mean-split cluster_func, not the actual hierarchical clustering it is meant to assess
all_findings.description: When enable_bootstrap is on, the cluster_func passed to Bootstrap::compute is a hand-rolled 'split by whether a read's mean distance exceeds the overall mean' 2-cluster heuristic (L138-165), explicitly commented 'In practice, this would use the same clustering method as the original'. Bootstrap then computes ARI between original_labels (true hierarchical clusters) and this mean-split's labels on resampled CpGs.
all_findings.why_wrong: Cluster stability via bootstrapped ARI is only meaningful if the re-clustering uses the SAME algorithm (hierarchical + same linkage/cut) as produced original_labels. Comparing the real clusters to a different, weaker 2-means-like splitter conflates 'is the clustering stable' with 'do the two different methods agree', understating stability and capping at 2 clusters regardless of the true NG. Mitigated by enable_bootstrap=false by default (header L37, production L1576), so impact is latent unless enabled.
all_findings.evidence: SignificanceAnalyzer.cpp:137 comment + L163 `labels[i] = (cnt>0 && sum/cnt > total_mean) ? 1 : 0;`. Bootstrap.compute ARI at Bootstrap.cpp:154 against original_labels.
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: If ever enabled, mean_ari and the stable flag (Bootstrap.cpp:190 stable = mean_ari>=0.2) reflect cross-method agreement, not stability of the reported clustering; likely biased low and 2-cluster-capped.
all_findings.quantification_method: Only relevant if a config enables bootstrap; if so, re-run passing the real HierarchicalClustering cut as cluster_func and compare mean_ari.
all_findings.fix_direction: Pass the actual clustering routine (same linkage + cut threshold + NG selection) as cluster_func, or remove the bootstrap path until wired correctly.

all_findings.title: Bootstrap 'stable' threshold (mean_ari>=0.2) and ARI denominator clamp are magic constants; early-stopping thresholds also hardcoded
all_findings.description: Bootstrap.cpp:190 hardcodes `result.stable = (result.mean_ari >= 0.2);` rather than using a config field, and the ARI denominator guard returns 1.0 ('perfect agreement') when |max_index - expected| < 1e-10 (L76). Early-stop thresholds 0.2/0.9 live in config but the stable cutoff does not.
all_findings.why_wrong: The 0.2 stability cutoff is a methodological threshold that should be configurable and justified; embedding it in code (separate from the config struct that already holds early-stop thresholds) invites drift and silent behavior. The denominator==0 → return 1.0 branch (degenerate case where both clusterings are trivial, e.g. all-one-cluster) returns 'perfect agreement' which can be misleading as a stability claim (it is agreement of two degenerate partitions, not evidence of stable structure).
all_findings.evidence: L190 `result.stable = (result.mean_ari >= 0.2);` (no config field); L76 `if (std::abs(denominator) < 1e-10) return 1.0;  // Perfect agreement`.
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: Stable/unstable calls are governed by an unexposed constant; degenerate single-cluster resamples count as ARI=1 and would inflate mean_ari.
all_findings.quantification_method: Only if bootstrap enabled: count resample iterations where the cluster_func returns a single cluster (degenerate) and how many contribute ARI=1.0 to mean_ari.
all_findings.fix_direction: Move 0.2 to BootstrapConfig (e.g. stable_min_ari); treat degenerate partitions (single cluster) as ARI undefined/excluded rather than 1.0.

all_findings.title: Greedy NaN-pruning in filter_reads_for_complete_matrix is a non-random, structure-dependent read selection prior to PERMANOVA
all_findings.description: filter_reads_for_complete_matrix iteratively removes the read with the lowest valid-degree (fewest non-NaN partners) until the submatrix has no NaN. The set of retained reads, and thus which reads enter PERMANOVA and the group sizes n_g, depends on the NaN pattern, which itself correlates with read length / coverage / region.
all_findings.why_wrong: PERMANOVA exchangeability assumes the retained reads are a representative sample of the groups. Greedy degree-based pruning preferentially drops short / low-overlap reads, which may be non-random with respect to HP or allele (e.g. ALT reads at low-coverage somatic sites are often shorter), subtly biasing group composition and the test. Ties in min_degree are broken by iteration order (first read wins, L71 strict `<`), making the kept set order-dependent. This is a soft caveat, not a clear bug, since some complete-matrix requirement is unavoidable for the SS formulas used.
all_findings.evidence: L64-75 picks `worst_read` with strict `degree < min_degree`; loop removes one read per outer iteration until no NaN remains (L41-83).
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: Group composition after filtering may differ systematically from the full read set (e.g. ALT/short reads dropped), shifting pseudo-F; magnitude depends on NaN-vs-label correlation.
all_findings.quantification_method: Per region compare HP/allele composition before vs after filter_reads (fraction of ALT/short reads dropped) using reads.tsv + distance_matrix NaN pattern; test whether dropped-read rate correlates with HP/allele.
all_findings.fix_direction: Report the number/identity of dropped reads and check label balance after filtering; consider pairwise-deletion PERMANOVA variants robust to missing distances, or a fixed deterministic tie-break documented as such.

all_findings.title: Within-CpG / within-read dependence ignored: PERMANOVA permutes whole reads (correct unit) but Fisher/chi-square global tests treat reads as independent and CpGs are correlated within reads
all_findings.description: The PERMANOVA permutation unit (whole-read label shuffle, StructureTest.cpp:191 and LabelTest valid-index shuffle) is the correct exchangeable unit and properly preserves the read-level dependence structure — this part is methodologically sound. However the parallel global association tests (Fisher-Freeman-Halton MC, chi-square at GlobalTest.cpp:83-88) treat the read x cluster table cells as independent multinomial counts; reads' cluster assignment came from correlated CpG patterns, so the effective sample size is below the read count and these parametric/MC p-values are somewhat anti-conservative.
all_findings.why_wrong: Not an error in the PERMANOVA itself (flagged as INFO to record that the permutation level is correct), but the co-reported Fisher/chi-square global p-values do not account for within-read CpG correlation or the fact that clusters are derived from the same data, so they are not exchangeable in the same rigorous sense as the PERMANOVA. When PERMANOVA and Fisher p disagree, prefer PERMANOVA's permutation p (with the NaN fix from PERMANOVA-1).
all_findings.evidence: StructureTest.cpp:191 `std::shuffle(permuted_labels.begin(), permuted_labels.end(), rng_);` (read-level, correct). GlobalTest.cpp:83 `fisher_.test_rxc_mc(table);` and L88 chi_square on raw read counts.
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: Fisher/chi-square global p-values are mildly anti-conservative vs the read-permutation PERMANOVA; the gap widens with strong within-read CpG correlation.
all_findings.quantification_method: On real regions compare global_*_fisher p vs the corresponding label PERMANOVA p; systematic Fisher<PERMANOVA would indicate the parametric anti-conservatism.
all_findings.fix_direction: Treat read-permutation PERMANOVA as the primary structure test; use Fisher/chi-square only as descriptive effect summaries, noting their independence assumption.

verified_high.title: LabelTest PERMANOVA substitutes missing (NaN) pairwise distances with 0 → 'identical reads' artifact inflates within-group cohesion and pseudo-F
verified_high.description: In the label-based PERMANOVA paths (hp_permanova at L508-517 and the actively-reported fine_p path at L644-652), the sub-distance matrix is built with `sub_dist(i,j) = std::isnan(d) ? 0.0 : d;`. Read pairs with no overlapping CpG (genuinely undefined methylation distance) are coerced to distance 0, i.e. treated as perfectly identical. StructureTest::run_permanova by contrast refuses the whole region on any NaN (StructureTest.cpp:164-172) and the Phase-3 path pre-filters reads to a complete matrix.
verified_high.why_wrong: A NaN distance means 'no shared CpG, distance undefined', not 'distance = 0'. Setting it to 0 adds spurious within-group (and between-group) similarity. Because reads of the same HP group are more likely to be co-incident in sparse short windows, NaN→0 tends to shrink ss_within more than ss_between, inflating pseudo-F and producing anti-conservative (too-small) permutation p-values. This directly affects the HP-fine PERMANOVA that MEMORY notes is used to call 'latent' HP structure (gated CV=0 but PERMANOVA significant).
verified_high.evidence: L515: `sub_dist(i, j) = std::isnan(d) ? 0.0 : d;  // Replace NaN with 0`  and identical L652 in the fine_p path. Contrast StructureTest.cpp:164-172 which returns invalid_reason="incomplete_distance_matrix" on any NaN.
verified_high.effect_hypothesis: Regions with sparse coverage (many NaN read pairs) will show inflated pseudo-F and deflated PERMANOVA p in the LabelTest paths; the bias grows with NaN fraction and could flip borderline regions from non-significant to 'latent HP structure'.
verified_high.quantification_method: From the per-region distance_matrix_*.csv count the fraction of NaN pairs; rerun fine_p PERMANOVA two ways (NaN→0 vs read-filtered-complete, as StructureTest does) on the actual HCC1395 regions and compare pseudo_f and p_value distributions (significance.json hp_permanova_p / fine_p columns). Stratify the p-shift by NaN fraction.
verified_high.fix_direction: Use the same complete-matrix read filtering as StructureTest::filter_reads_for_complete_matrix before the label PERMANOVA, or exclude NaN pairs from both ss_total and ss_within consistently (and recompute df from the retained reads). Never substitute 0 for an undefined distance.

verdict.reasoning:
The code at LabelTest.cpp:515 and :652 does literally do `sub_dist(i,j) = std::isnan(d) ? 0.0 : d;`, and the fine_p path is indeed the actively-reported one (LabelTest.cpp:80-82 copy fine_f/fine_p/fine_sig into hp_permanova_*). The reviewer's statistical reasoning (NaN = "no shared CpG, undefined" should not become distance 0; coercing to 0 spuriously inflates within-group cohesion / pseudo-F) is also sound IN PRINCIPLE. So the line is real and the contrast with StructureTest.cpp:164-172 (which refuses on any NaN) is real.

HOWEVER, the claimed runtime IMPACT is not reachable under the configuration actually used, so this is a dormant latent defect, not an active artifact:

1. The distance matrix passed to LabelTest is built by DistanceMatrix::compute() using `nan_strategy`, which defaults to MAX_DIST (include/core/Config.hpp:39, include/core/DistanceMatrix.hpp:24, include/utils/ArgParser.hpp:96-97). Under MAX_DIST, no-overlap pairs are coerced to `max_distance_value = 1.0` at DistanceMatrix.cpp:435-436 BEFORE the matrix ever reaches LabelTest. NaN only enters the matrix under the SKIP strategy (DistanceMatrix.cpp:412-413). Hence under default config the `isnan(d) ? 0.0` branch never fires — it is dead code.

2. I grepped scripts/, research/, docs/ for any `--nan-distance-strategy skip` / SKIP usage: zero hits. No production run uses SKIP. The same default-MAX_DIST `all_dist.dist_matrix` flows RegionProcessor.cpp:1439 → :859 perform_clustering_and_significance → :1581 SignificanceAnalyzer → SignificanceAnalyzer.cpp:272 LabelTest::test_all. So in every executed analysis the matrix contains 1.0 (not NaN, not 0) for no-overlap pairs.

3. The MEMORY-referenced "latent HP structure" calls (research/.../scripts/88_refined_gate_permanova.py + 86_build_display_html.py) consume upstream LabelHPPermanova values produced by the ISM binary under default MAX_DIST. So the specific worry that this NaN→0 bug corrupts the "gated CV=0 but PERMANOVA significant" latent calls does not hold for any data that was actually generated.

4. The reviewer's causal mechanism is also directionally inconsistent with reality: it argues NaN→0 shrinks distances and inflates pseudo-F, but under the config in use those same no-overlap pairs are filled with 1.0 (the OPPOSITE extreme), so the realized matrix does not exhibit the analyzed artifact at all.

5. There IS a genuine latent robustness/consistency defect: LabelTest (NaN→0) and StructureTest (NaN→refuse) disagree, and the LabelTest substitution would be statistically wrong IF anyone ran `--nan-distance-strategy skip`. Worth a defensive fix (mirror StructureTest: refuse or filter to a complete submatrix). But it is dormant.

Verdict UNCERTAIN rather than REFUTED because the line and the statistical critique are technically correct; it is the claimed severity/impact ("directly affects the HP-fine PERMANOVA ... anti-conservative p-values ... latent calls") that is unsupported under the only configuration ever used. This is a LOW-severity dormant defect, not a HIGH-severity active artifact.

verified_high.title: Dispersion (PERMDISP) p-value is a hardcoded 3-step lookup of the F-statistic, not a real F-CDF or permutation
verified_high.description: check_dispersion computes an ANOVA F on per-read pseudo-distances-to-centroid, then sets `anova_p = anova_f > 4.0 ? 0.01 : (anova_f > 2.5 ? 0.05 : 0.1)` and flags `warning = anova_p < dispersion_alpha`. There is no degrees-of-freedom-aware F distribution CDF and no permutation null; the p-value is one of three magic constants determined by two magic thresholds (2.5, 4.0).
verified_high.why_wrong: The F critical value depends on df1=k-1 and df2=N-k, which vary per region. A fixed threshold of 4.0→p=0.01 is wrong for almost every region (e.g. for df2 small the real critical F is much larger; for df2 large much smaller). This mis-flags dispersion heterogeneity. The dispersion warning feeds result.score_ambiguous (SignificanceAnalyzer.cpp:346) and the verification classification, so a wrong p contaminates whether a region is marked ambiguous. Additionally, the proper PERMDISP procedure is a permutation test on residuals, not a parametric ANOVA — the parametric assumption is itself invalid for distance-to-centroid values.
verified_high.evidence: L292: `result.anova_p = result.anova_f > 4.0 ? 0.01 : (result.anova_f > 2.5 ? 0.05 : 0.1);` consumed at SignificanceAnalyzer.cpp:346 `result.score_ambiguous = result.dispersion_warning || ...`.
verified_high.effect_hypothesis: dispersion_warning is set on a basis uncorrelated with true type-I error; regions with small n_k or many groups will be mis-flagged, perturbing score_ambiguous / verification_class counts. (Note: production main path sets enable_dispersion=false at RegionProcessor.cpp:1575, so impact is limited to the default-on analyze() path and any tool invocation leaving the default.)
verified_high.quantification_method: Compute the true parametric F p-value (boost/std incomplete beta) and a permutation PERMDISP p for the actual all_distances/group_labels per region, compare warning flips vs the lookup table; check how many regions have enable_dispersion on in shipped configs.
verified_high.fix_direction: Replace the lookup with either an F-distribution CDF using correct (k-1, N-k) df, or a proper permutation PERMDISP (shuffle residuals, recompute F). Move 2.5/4.0 out of code regardless.

verdict.reasoning:
The statistical defect is real and verified verbatim. StructureTest.cpp:292 is exactly `result.anova_p = result.anova_f > 4.0 ? 0.01 : (result.anova_f > 2.5 ? 0.05 : 0.1)` — a 3-step magic-constant lookup with two magic thresholds (2.5, 4.0), no df-aware F-CDF, and no permutation null. The critique is statistically sound: the F critical value depends on df1=k-1, df2=N-k (StructureTest.cpp:241-242,258-259 compute exactly these dfs but never use them for the p-value), so a fixed 4.0→0.01 threshold is wrong for nearly every region. This is also a known-incomplete shortcut, not intended design: the same codebase implements proper permutation nulls elsewhere (StructureTest.cpp:190-198 run_permanova; LabelTest.cpp:407,704,860), and the project's own docs explicitly request a real PERMDISP/betadisper permutation test (docs/.../20251230_sig_label.md:75 'permdisp_p'; docs/.../20260104_詳細分析特殊狀況.md). The parametric ANOVA on distance-to-centroid is itself the wrong tool — PERMDISP should permute residuals.

However, the claimed HIGH severity is overstated on the impact axis, which is the load-bearing part of the finding's why_wrong. The reviewer's harm chain is dispersion_warning -> score_ambiguous (SignificanceAnalyzer.cpp:346) -> classification. But in the production pipeline, RegionProcessor.cpp:1575 sets sig_config.enable_dispersion = false. Both consumers of check_dispersion are gated on this flag: cluster dispersion at SignificanceAnalyzer.cpp:125 (if config_.enable_dispersion) and label-level dispersion inside run_grouped_structure at SignificanceAnalyzer.cpp:263 (if config_.enable_dispersion && permanova_result.valid). With the flag false, check_dispersion is never called in production, so result.dispersion_warning and label_hp/allele_dispersion_warning remain at their default false (Stats.hpp:443; RegionProcessor.hpp:239,249,254). Therefore score_ambiguous (line 346) and the 0.5x heuristic penalty (line 403-405) receive NO contribution from this buggy p-value in the shipped run, and the label-level warnings are only ever serialized to CSV/JSON (RegionProcessor.cpp:1660,1775,1785), never feeding classification. The buggy lookup is effectively dead code in production — it only activates when enable_dispersion is flipped true (e.g. the unit-test config at tests/test_significance_analyzer.cpp:24). So the mechanism is genuine but the asserted active contamination of region ambiguity does not occur in the production pipeline. Verdict CONFIRMED (the code defect is exactly as described and statistically invalid), but severity corrected HIGH->LOW: it is a latent correctness/code-quality defect in a feature that is disabled by default, not an active HIGH-impact contaminant of results. Should be fixed (or the function removed) before enable_dispersion is ever turned on.

perReviewer.area: SIGLABEL — Significance integration & label-first vs cluster-first testing (SignificanceAnalyzer.cpp, LabelTest.cpp, StructureTest.cpp coupling, Stats.hpp result structs)
perReviewer.notes:
範圍：實際 Read 了 SignificanceAnalyzer.{cpp,hpp}, LabelTest.{cpp,hpp}, StructureTest.{cpp,hpp}, Stats.hpp, GlobalTest.cpp, 以及 test_significance_analyzer.cpp；grep 確認 multiple-testing 校正僅存在於 PerCpgAsm（per-CpG within-region BH-FDR），region/位點層級無校正（→ SIGLABEL-2）。

已查並判定為『正確/非問題』的項目（不報）：
1. PERMANOVA SS 計算：StructureTest.cpp compute_ss 用 anti-cancellation 公式（ss_between = cross_raw/n + adj_term）且 clamp 負值，數學上等價 ss_total-ss_within，正確；pseudo-F df=(k-1,n-k) 正確，perfect-separation 用 1e9 sentinel 讓 permutation 正確拒絕 null，合理。
2. permutation p 用 (n_extreme+1)/(n_perm+1) 含 observed，是正確的有偏估計（避免 p=0），各檔一致。
3. LabelTest 對 -1（excluded）標籤在 permutation 只洗 valid_label_values（L401-413）正確，未把 excluded read 混入洗牌。
4. seed 傳播：SignificanceAnalyzer init_analyzers 給各子分析器 seed+offset（+4 給 label），Determinism 測試有覆蓋，正確。
5. test_all 入口 n<min_total_reads 與 size mismatch 檢查、min_reads_per_group 群大小檢查都存在且合理。

效果量級全部留白未捏造，需 needs_rerun=true 者已標明量化檔案與指令方向（significance_summary.csv / 各 region significance.json / distance_matrix_*.csv）。最高優先：SIGLABEL-1(循環性)、SIGLABEL-2(無跨位點FDR)、SIGLABEL-6(allele-axis confound 進 OR)，三者會直接影響『N 個位點顯著 / Strong 計數 / somatic ASM』類論文宣稱的方向與量級。SIGLABEL-5/7 為 confound/口徑不一致的 HIGH-MEDIUM。test_significance_analyzer.cpp 未把任何上述 bug 釘成 expected（測試只驗 trivial strong/weak path 與 determinism），但也未覆蓋 circularity / FDR / NaN→0 / dispersion-p 近似，屬測試盲區（測試只測 happy path）。

all_findings.title: verification_class 的 cluster-first 與 label-first 兩條路徑不獨立 — 兩者皆以 HP/甲基化距離為基礎，'Strong=兩路徑一致' 是部分循環論證
all_findings.description: verification_class 宣稱是 bidirectional verification：'Strong' 表示 cluster-first 與 label-first 兩條獨立路徑都顯著。但 cluster_significant 用的是 cluster_labels × HP_family(或 ALT/REF) 的 Fisher FFH（global_hp_family.fisher_ffh），而 cluster_labels 本身是由甲基化距離矩陣階層分群得到；label_sig (any_significant) 的 hp_multistage.merged 又是用同一個甲基化距離矩陣做 HP-family 的 between/within delta test。兩條路徑的輸入都是『甲基化結構 + HP 標籤』，差別只在一個用離散 cluster 標籤跑列聯表、一個用連續距離跑 permutation。當甲基化真的有 HP 結構時，兩者高度相關而非獨立驗證；'Strong = 兩路徑一致' 因此會系統性高估，無法當成真正的交叉驗證。
all_findings.why_wrong: 宣稱的『雙向獨立驗證』要求兩條路徑用不同資訊或不同假設。此處兩路徑共用甲基化距離 + HP 標籤這同一組輸入，cluster 標籤是距離的函數，所以兩個檢定在 null 下不獨立、在 alternative 下強相關。把它命名為 Strong/獨立一致會誇大證據等級。
all_findings.evidence: L309-311: `bool cluster_significant = result.passed_gate && (result.global_alt.fisher_ffh.p_value <= 0.05 || result.global_hp_family.fisher_ffh.p_value <= 0.05);` ; L312 `bool label_sig = result.label_significant;` (= hp_multistage.merged.significant || allele delta) ; L326 `if (label_sig && cluster_significant) { ... result.verification_class = "Strong";`。cluster_labels 為甲基化距離分群結果（analyze 的入參，來自上游 hierarchical clustering），label_sig 的 merged delta 也用同一 dist_matrix（LabelTest.cpp:604 test_binary_groups(dist_matrix,...)）。
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: Strong 類別占比可能被高估、Subclone/Weak 邊界被擠壓；對 TP/FP 判別力的評估會偏樂觀（兩路徑看似一致其實是同一訊號被算兩次）。
all_findings.quantification_method: 對全 30,350 位點的 significance.json/summary，計算 cluster_significant 與 label_sig 的 2x2 共現表與 phi 係數；再用 HP-permuted null（打亂 HP 標籤但保留距離矩陣與 cluster 標籤）重跑，看 Strong 比例下降多少。資料：research/tsg_promoter_asm_reviewer/.../significance_summary.csv 與各 region 的 significance.json。
all_findings.fix_direction: (a) 文件與欄位語意改稱『concordance class』而非『獨立雙向驗證』；(b) 若要真正獨立，cluster-first 應用『非甲基化』的分群（如 read 序列/長度）或對 cluster_labels 與 label 用不同甲基化子集；(c) 至少在報告標註兩路徑共用甲基化距離、Strong 不可解讀為兩個獨立證據。

all_findings.title: 每位點跑多個顯著性檢定 + 跨上萬位點，但 region-level 完全沒有 multiple-testing 校正（只有 PerCpgAsm 內部有 FDR）
all_findings.description: 單一位點就跑了多個 p 值檢定：global_alt / global_hp / global_hp_family / global_hp_fine Fisher-FFH（Phase 1），label HP-merged delta、label allele delta、sample delta、HP fine PERMANOVA、HP-merged PERMANOVA、allele PERMANOVA（Phase 4），全部各自和 0.05 比。verification_class 與 passed_gate 取『任一顯著』(OR 邏輯，L90 與 L310 都是 `||`)，等於對多個檢定取最小 p 卻不做校正，膨脹 family-wise error。再加上工具跑全基因組數萬位點（30,350 位點），region-level 沒有任何 BH/Bonferroni（grep 確認 FDR 僅存在於 PerCpgAsm 的『單 region 內跨 CpG』校正，不涵蓋跨檢定/跨位點）。
all_findings.why_wrong: 對多個檢定用 OR 取顯著等同隱式取最小 p；在 null 下，K 個檢定至少一個 p<=0.05 的機率遠大於 0.05。跨上萬位點也會有大量假陽性。沒有跨檢定/跨位點 FDR，significant 旗標與 Strong/Weak 計數的偽陽率不受控，論文若用『N 個位點顯著』會嚴重高估。
all_findings.evidence: L90 `result.passed_gate = expanded.alt.passed_gate || expanded.hp_family.passed_gate;` ; L310-311 cluster_significant 用 `p<=0.05 || p<=0.05`；Phase 4 連跑 6 個 label 檢定各自 alpha=0.05（LabelTest config alpha=0.05, LabelTest.hpp:38）。grep `fdr|bonferroni|benjamini` 在 src/include 僅命中 PerCpgAsm.cpp（per-CpG within-region BH）與 RegionProcessor 對 per_cpg fdr 的轉貼，無 region-level 校正。
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: passed_gate / any_significant / verification_class!=Noise 的位點數被高估；TP vs FP 在『是否顯著』上的差距會因共同的假陽性 inflation 而縮小或被誤判。
all_findings.quantification_method: 對全位點輸出的各 p 值欄做 BH-FDR（跨位點，分檢定類別），比較 FDR<0.05 與 raw p<0.05 的位點數差距；並用 OR-of-K 對單一 alpha 做 Šidák/Bonferroni 等效估算每位點實際 alpha。資料：significance_summary.csv 全欄 p 值。
all_findings.fix_direction: 在 region 層加跨位點 BH-FDR（對每種檢定分開校正），並在單位點對『跨 label 維度』的多檢定明示用 min-p + 校正（如 Šidák）或預先指定 primary endpoint（HP-axis）避免事後挑最小 p。報告改用 FDR 而非 raw p 計數。

all_findings.title: label delta 的 binary delta test 是單尾且 delta<=0 直接賦 p=1，但 PERMANOVA(pseudo-F) 與 Fisher 為雙尾/全尾，三者口徑不一致地混用進同一 verification 邏輯
all_findings.description: test_binary_groups 對 delta<=0（within>=between）直接設 p=1、不跑 permutation（L161-167），且 permutation 計數用 `perm_delta >= observed_delta`（L426），是嚴格單尾（只測 between>within 方向）。但同一份結果裡 HP fine PERMANOVA 與 allele/HP PERMANOVA 用 pseudo-F（F>=obs，本質單尾但 F 對任何方向偏離都變大，等於雙向）、Fisher-FFH 是全尾。verification_class 把這些不同尾向的 significant 旗標用同一 0.05 門檻混在一起判斷。HP delta 單尾雖對『甲基化叢聚→between>within』方向合理，但與 PERMANOVA/Fisher 口徑不一致會讓不同 axis 的『顯著』不可比。
all_findings.why_wrong: 混用單尾(delta)與全尾(Fisher/pseudo-F)門檻，使 label_sig 與 cluster_significant 的 0.05 不是同一統計意義；且 delta<=0 直接 p=1 等於把『反向訊號』(within>between，可能是技術 artifact 或 anti-clustering) 全部歸為不顯著，喪失偵測異常的能力。
all_findings.evidence: L161-167: `} else { result.p_value = 1.0; result.n_permutations = 0; result.significant = false; }`（delta<=0 不跑檢定）; L426 `if (perm_delta >= observed_delta) ++n_extreme;`（單尾）。對比 StructureTest.cpp:195 `if (perm_f >= result.pseudo_f)` 與 GlobalTest Fisher-FFH 全尾。
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: 對 between>within 方向敏感、對反向不敏感；不同 axis 的 significant 不等價，verification_class 的 OR 合併把不可比門檻當可比。
all_findings.quantification_method: 統計 delta<=0 而被直接判 p=1 的位點比例（significance_summary 中 label_hp delta<=0 的列）；對這些位點補跑雙尾 permutation 看是否有反向顯著結構。資料：significance_summary.csv 的 within/between/delta 欄。
all_findings.fix_direction: 文件明示 HP delta 為單尾且只測 between>within；若要與 PERMANOVA/Fisher 並列判 Strong，統一改用 PERMANOVA 作為 HP-axis 主檢定，或對 delta 也輸出雙尾 p 供反向偵測；避免不同尾向門檻直接 OR。

all_findings.title: LabelTest 的 PERMANOVA permutation 在固定 n_valid 子集上洗牌，但每個 stage/每次 test_all 共用同一個 rng_ 且未重設 seed → 各 stage 的 permutation 序列耦合、且 test_binary_groups 對 merged/allele/sample 連續抽 rng 造成隱性相依
all_findings.description: test_all 依序呼叫 test_hp_merged → test_hp_fine_grained → test_unassigned_affinity → allele test_binary_groups → sample test_binary_groups，全部共用 rng_，且中途不 reseed。前一個 stage 消耗多少亂數取決於資料（n_permutations 固定但 shuffle 消耗的 entropy 與 n 有關），導致後續 stage 的 permutation 序列與前面 stage 的資料規模耦合。雖然 seed 固定時整體仍 deterministic（測試 Determinism 有覆蓋），但不同位點間因 stage 順序/規模不同，permutation 抽樣不是各 stage 獨立同分佈，跨位點的 p 值蒙地卡羅誤差結構不一致。屬穩健性/再現性細節，非方向性錯誤。
all_findings.why_wrong: 理想上每個 permutation 檢定應有獨立、可重置的亂數流（或至少 stage 間 reseed），以保證各檢定 p 值的 MC 噪音獨立。共用 rng 且不 reseed 使 stage 間 MC 誤差相依，雖不改期望值但增加跨 stage 比較的隱性相關。
all_findings.evidence: LabelTest 建構子只 seed 一次（L26-33）；test_all 內各 stage 都呼叫 `std::shuffle(..., rng_)`（L409, L571, L705, L862）共用同一 rng_，中間無 set_seed/reseed。SignificanceAnalyzer 只給 label_config.seed = seed+4 一次（SignificanceAnalyzer.cpp:24）。
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: 對單一位點結論影響極小（期望值不變）；主要影響跨 stage p 值 MC 噪音的獨立性，對精細 effect-size 比較或 borderline 位點的重現性有微擾。
all_findings.quantification_method: 對同一位點用不同 seed 重跑 N 次，比較各 stage p 值的變異與跨 stage 相關；若跨 stage p 值噪音相關顯著則確認耦合。資料：可用任一 region 的 dist_matrix 重跑。
all_findings.fix_direction: 每個 permutation 檢定前用 stage-specific reseed（如 seed + stage_id + region_id），或各 stage 用獨立 rng 實例，確保 MC 噪音獨立可重現。

all_findings.title: PERMANOVA permutation 把 NaN 距離替換成 0（dist=0），會人為壓低 within/between 平方和並可能膨脹 pseudo-F
all_findings.description: LabelTest 的 fine-grained / multigroup PERMANOVA 在建子距離矩陣時把 NaN 距離直接設 0：`sub_dist(i,j) = std::isnan(d) ? 0.0 : d;`。在甲基化 read-read 距離中 NaN 代表兩 read 無共同 CpG（無法比較），把它當『距離 0』= 假設它們完全相同，會系統性壓低相關配對的平方距離。由於這些 0 在 permutation 下隨標籤一起被洗（位置固定但歸屬隨機），對 observed 與 permuted SS 的影響不對稱，可能使 pseudo-F 偏高或偏低且難以解析，是 silent bias。對比 StructureTest 的主 PERMANOVA 走 filter_reads_for_complete_matrix 嚴格剔除任何含 NaN 的 read（StructureTest.cpp:30-91, run_permanova L164-172 還會 reject incomplete matrix），兩條路徑對缺值處理口徑不一致。
all_findings.why_wrong: 甲基化距離的 NaN 是『資訊缺失』非『距離為 0』。用 0 取代等於宣稱無共同 CpG 的兩 read 甲基化模式相同，違反距離度量的缺值語意，扭曲 SS_within/SS_between，且 LabelTest 路徑與 StructureTest 路徑對同一資料缺值的處理不一致，導致 hp_multistage.fine_* 與 result.permanova 不可直接比較。
all_findings.evidence: LabelTest.cpp:515 `sub_dist(i, j) = std::isnan(d) ? 0.0 : d;  // Replace NaN with 0`，同樣在 L652。對照 StructureTest.cpp:166-171 對 NaN 直接 `result.invalid_reason = "incomplete_distance_matrix"; return;`（拒絕而非填 0）。
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: 含較多 NaN 的稀疏位點，LabelTest fine PERMANOVA 的 F/p 會偏離真值（方向視缺值在 within vs between 的分佈而定）；可能讓低共覆蓋位點假性顯著或假性不顯著。
all_findings.quantification_method: 對缺值比例高的位點，比較 LabelTest fine_p 與用『complete-matrix 過濾』後重算的 PERMANOVA p；統計兩者在高 NaN 率位點的差。資料：各 region 的 distance_matrix_*.csv 的 NaN 比例 + significance.json fine_p。
all_findings.fix_direction: LabelTest PERMANOVA 改用與 StructureTest 相同的 filter_reads_for_complete_matrix（剔除含 NaN 的 read）或對 NaN 配對在 SS 計算中排除並調整分母，而非填 0；至少口徑與主 PERMANOVA 一致。

all_findings.title: ALLELE-axis (ALT vs REF) 與 HP-axis (HP-family) 在 verification 邏輯中被平行對待，但 ALLELE-axis 會被 baseline allelic methylation confound — label_sig 用 OR 合併使 confounded 軸可單獨觸發 Strong
all_findings.description: test_all 的 any_significant = hp_sig || allele_sig（LabelTest.cpp:104-106），cluster_significant 也是 global_alt(ALT/REF) OR global_hp_family（SignificanceAnalyzer.cpp:310-311）。依專案既有 memory（feedback_asm_allele_axis_baseline_confound），ALLELE-axis 的 ALT-vs-REF 甲基化差異無法區分 somatic-特異 ASM 與 germline baseline allelic methylation（het 基線），只有 HP-axis (HP1 vs HP1-1) 是 somatic-controlled。此處 allele delta（test_binary_groups allele_labels）與 allele PERMANOVA（run_grouped_structure allele_labels）被當成與 HP 同等的證據，OR 進 label_sig / cluster_significant，使一個被 confound 的軸可以單獨把位點推成 significant/Strong。
all_findings.why_wrong: 把已知會被 baseline allelic methylation confound 的 ALLELE-axis 與 somatic-controlled 的 HP-axis 等權 OR，違反『somatic ASM 必跑 germline-het null』的方法學要求。結果是 verification_class=Strong 可能僅由 confounded 的 allele 訊號驅動，無法支持 somatic ASM 宣稱。
all_findings.evidence: LabelTest.cpp:106 `result.any_significant = hp_sig || allele_sig;` ; SignificanceAnalyzer.cpp:310-311 cluster_significant 含 `result.global_alt.fisher_ffh.p_value <= 0.05 ||`；Phase 4 對 allele_labels 跑 run_grouped_structure（L303）。專案 memory feedback_asm_allele_axis_baseline_confound 明列 ALLELE-axis confounded、只有 HP-axis somatic-controlled。
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: 由 allele-only 驅動的 Strong/significant 位點在 germline-het null 下無法存活；若論文以 verification_class 計數 somatic ASM 會混入 baseline allelic methylation。
all_findings.quantification_method: 分解 significant 位點為『HP-axis 顯著』vs『僅 allele-axis 顯著』兩集合，對後者跑 germline-het 負控（如 memory 中 het null 15.2% baseline）比較。資料：significance_summary.csv 的 label_hp vs label_allele significant 欄。
all_findings.fix_direction: verification 主軸改以 HP-axis 為 primary endpoint，allele-axis 只作 secondary/需配 germline-het null 才採信；輸出明確標記 significant 是由哪個 axis 驅動，避免 allele-only 觸發 Strong。

all_findings.title: dispersion 的 ANOVA p 值用硬寫死的查表 (F>4→0.01, F>2.5→0.05, else 0.1) 取代真實 F 分佈，且此 warning 會 0.5x 懲罰 heuristic_score 並進 score_ambiguous
all_findings.description: check_dispersion 計算 anova_f 後，anova_p 不是由 F 分佈 CDF 算，而是三段硬門檻：`anova_p = anova_f > 4.0 ? 0.01 : (anova_f > 2.5 ? 0.05 : 0.1)`。這個查表與自由度(k-1, n-k)無關（不同群數/樣本數臨界值差很大），等於對所有位點用同一組 magic number 當臨界。dispersion.warning = (anova_p < dispersion_alpha=0.05) → 實際變成『anova_f > 4.0 才 warning』的硬閾值。warning 又在 compute_heuristic_score 把 score 乘 0.5（SignificanceAnalyzer.cpp:403-405）並設 score_ambiguous（L346），影響下游分類/排序。
all_findings.why_wrong: 用與自由度無關的固定數字近似 F-檢定 p 值，在群數或樣本數變動時臨界值錯誤（例如 df 小時 F=4 遠不到 0.01，df 大時 F=2.5 早就 <0.05）。這讓 dispersion warning 在不同位點有不一致的實際 alpha，且 magic number 4.0/2.5/0.01/0.05/0.1 應由 F 分佈或設定檔決定。
all_findings.evidence: StructureTest.cpp:292 `result.anova_p = result.anova_f > 4.0 ? 0.01 : (result.anova_f > 2.5 ? 0.05 : 0.1);` ; L293 `result.warning = (result.anova_p < config_.dispersion_alpha);`。下游 SignificanceAnalyzer.cpp:403 `if (result.dispersion_warning) score *= 0.5;` 與 L346 score_ambiguous。
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: dispersion warning 的觸發率與真實 PERMDISP 不符，對 heuristic_score 與 score_ambiguous 造成系統性偏差；位點群數/讀數差異大時更明顯。
all_findings.quantification_method: 對所有位點記錄 (anova_f, k, n)，用真實 F-CDF 重算 p 並重判 warning，比較與查表版的 warning 翻轉比例及對 heuristic_score 的影響。資料：significance.json 的 dispersion 欄 + n_reads/群數。
all_findings.fix_direction: 改用真實 F 分佈 CDF（含正確 df1=k-1, df2=n-k）或 permutation-based PERMDISP 算 p；magic 閾值移除或進 config。至少文件標註現為粗略近似、warning 不是嚴格 0.05 檢定。

all_findings.title: chi_square_p 直接賦值為 Fisher-FFH 的 p（placeholder），但欄位名與語意聲稱是 chi-square p — 口徑/欄位語意不符，且 chi_square_reliable 旗標可能誤導
all_findings.description: compute_from_table 計算了 chi_square 統計量與 chi_square_reliable（>20% 格 expected<5 則 false），但 chi_square_p 不是由卡方分佈算，而是 placeholder 直接抄 fisher_ffh.p_value：`result.chi_square_p = result.fisher_ffh.p_value;  // Placeholder`。任何下游若讀 chi_square_p 以為是卡方 p 值會被誤導；chi_square 統計量本身被算出但其 p 永遠等於 Fisher MC p。屬欄位語意與名稱不符。
all_findings.why_wrong: 欄位 chi_square_p 名稱承諾是卡方檢定 p 值，實際是 Fisher-FFH MC p 的別名。若報告或下游用 chi_square_p 與 fisher p 交叉比對會把同一數字當成兩個獨立檢定，或誤以為卡方近似結果。
all_findings.evidence: GlobalTest.cpp:124 `result.chi_square_p = result.fisher_ffh.p_value;  // Placeholder`，但 L86-88 確實算了 result.chi_square 統計量。Stats.hpp:187-189 欄位註解 chi_square / chi_square_p / chi_square_reliable。
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: 若無人讀 chi_square_p 則無數值影響；若報告引用會造成『重複計數同一 p』的口徑錯誤。
all_findings.quantification_method: grep 下游/輸出是否寫出 chi_square_p 欄；若有，檢查報告是否把它當獨立檢定。資料：RegionProcessor 輸出欄 + significance_summary.csv 欄。
all_findings.fix_direction: 若不實作卡方 CDF，就移除 chi_square_p 欄或重命名為 fisher_p_alias 並文件標註；要保留則用正確 df 的卡方 CDF 算 p。

all_findings.title: potential_loh 用 Laplace 平滑後的 HP ratio 判斷 (<0.1 或 >0.9)，但平滑會在小樣本把極端 ratio 拉回中間，使真正 LOH 位點漏判；且判出後 verification_class 仍照樣標 Strong（無實際降級）
all_findings.description: HP balance check 用 Laplace 平滑：`hp_ratio = (n_hp1_family + 1) / (total_hp + 2)`，再判 potential_loh = ratio<0.1 或 >0.9。小樣本時 +1/+2 平滑會把如 0/8（真 LOH）的 ratio 從 0 拉到 0.1，剛好卡在邊界外而漏判 potential_loh。更關鍵：即使 potential_loh=true，L328-333 兩個分支都把 verification_class 設成 "Strong"（註解說 'LOH_Subtype will track this' 但此函式本身沒有降級），所以 LOH 旗標在 verification_class 層級實際無作用，只靠下游 determine_loh_subtype 補。邏輯分支寫了卻無 effect，易誤導維護者以為有降級。
all_findings.why_wrong: (1) Laplace 平滑用於避免除零，但這裡 total_hp>0 才進來，平滑反而扭曲 LOH 判斷閾值，在小 N 系統性漏判極端 ratio。(2) if/else 兩分支結果相同（都 Strong），是 dead branch，意圖（LOH 降級）未實現於此處。
all_findings.evidence: L320-321 `hp_ratio = static_cast<double>(result.hp_multistage.n_hp1_family + 1) / static_cast<double>(total_hp + 2);  // Laplace smoothing` ; L322 `potential_loh = (hp_ratio < 0.1) || (hp_ratio > 0.9);` ; L328-333 兩分支皆 `result.verification_class = "Strong";`。
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: 小樣本 LOH 位點的 potential_loh 漏判率上升；verification_class 對 LOH 不敏感（無降級），下游若只看 verification_class 會把 LOH-driven Strong 與真 balanced Strong 混在一起。
all_findings.quantification_method: 對 hp1_family/hp2_family 計數的位點，比較『平滑 ratio』與『原始 ratio』判 potential_loh 的差，統計小 N 漏判數；並確認 verification_class 是否真因 LOH 改變。資料：significance_summary.csv 的 n_hp1_family/n_hp2_family/potential_loh/verification_class 欄。
all_findings.fix_direction: LOH 判斷用未平滑 ratio + 最小 N 門檻（如 total_hp>=N 才判），或用二項信賴區間判極端；若要 LOH 降級就在 verification_class 真的降一級，否則移除 dead if/else 並把語意完全交給 determine_loh_subtype。

all_findings.title: compute_delta 在 n_pairs_within==0 或 n_pairs_between==0 時設 mean=0 後才檢查，但若某群全 NaN 配對被跳過會讓 between/within 平均建立在不同有效配對集上 — within/between 不可比
all_findings.description: compute_group_distances 對每個 (i,j) 配對：label<0 跳過、NaN 跳過，否則歸 within 或 between。當甲基化稀疏時，within 與 between 兩集合被排除的 NaN 配對比例可能不同（例如同群 read 共覆蓋區段不同），導致 within_mean 與 between_mean 是在不同『有效配對子集』上算的平均，delta=between-within 把兩個不同支撐集的均值相減。permutation 雖也用同函式（一致），但 observed delta 的生物解讀（between>within）在 NaN 非隨機缺失時會被缺值結構污染。屬距離度量缺值權重問題。
all_findings.why_wrong: within 與 between 各自丟掉的 NaN 配對若非隨機（與 read 共覆蓋有關，而共覆蓋又與 HP/位置相關），兩均值不在同一可比基礎上，delta 的方向會被缺值結構而非真甲基化差異驅動。permutation 一致使用同函式只保證 p 值的內部一致，不修正 observed delta 的 confound。
all_findings.evidence: LabelTest.cpp:359-372 `double dist = dist_matrix(i,j); if (std::isnan(dist)) continue; if (group_labels[i]==group_labels[j]) {sum_within+=dist; ++n_pairs_within;} else {...between...}` ; L377-378 means。compute_delta L206-210 僅檢查 n_pairs>0，不檢查 within/between 缺值率是否平衡。
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: 在 NaN 缺失與 HP/位置相關的稀疏位點，delta 與其 permutation p 可能反映共覆蓋差異而非甲基化 ASM；方向可能被人為放大或反轉。
all_findings.quantification_method: 對每位點記錄 within vs between 配對的 NaN 排除率，相關到 delta 顯著性；對高缺值差位點用 complete-pairs only 重算 delta 比較。資料：distance_matrix_*.csv NaN 結構 + significance_summary delta/p。
all_findings.fix_direction: 在 delta 有效性檢查加『within/between 有效配對覆蓋率需相近』或限制到 complete-overlap read 子集；或對 NaN 缺值率高的位點標 low-confidence，避免 delta 被缺值結構驅動。

all_findings.title: best_dimension/dominant_dimension 以最小 p 挑選，但 HP delta(單尾、shuffle) 與 allele delta(同) 的 p 值粒度受 n_permutations=999 限制且未校正，挑最小 p 等於 post-hoc selection 偏誤
all_findings.description: test_all 以 hp_p<=allele_p 挑 dominant_dimension 並把該 axis 的 delta/p 設為 best（L115-133）。兩個 p 都是 permutation p（最小可達 1/(999+1)=0.001），在 perfect separation 時兩 axis 都會撞到 1/1000 地板而 tie，此時固定挑 hp（<=）。更一般地，挑最小 p 而不校正是 post-hoc selection，best_p_value 會系統性偏小（兩次抽最小），若下游用 best_p_value 當該位點代表 p 會高估顯著性。
all_findings.why_wrong: 對 K 個檢定取最小 p 當代表值是有偏的（min 的期望 < 單一檢定），未做 selection 校正（如 Bonferroni K=2 或取 min 後乘 2）會讓 best_p_value 偏樂觀；permutation 地板又使 tie-break 固定偏向 hp，方向選擇受演算法而非資料決定。
all_findings.evidence: L117 `if (hp_p <= allele_p) { result.dominant_dimension = "hp"; ... result.best_p_value = hp_p; }`（tie 時選 hp）；best_p_value 直接用未校正的單 axis p。p 地板 = LabelTest.cpp:432 `n_extreme / (n_permutations+1)`，n_permutations=999。
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: best_p_value 比真實『該位點任一 axis 顯著』的校正 p 偏小；dominant_dimension 在 tie 時系統性偏 hp，跨位點 axis 分佈統計會偏。
all_findings.quantification_method: 比較 best_p_value 與 min(hp_p,allele_p)*2（Bonferroni）對位點顯著數的影響；統計 hp_p==allele_p tie 的位點比例（perfect separation）。資料：significance_summary.csv best_p_value/label_hp_p/label_allele_p。
all_findings.fix_direction: best_p_value 改報 selection-adjusted p（min×K 或 Šidák），或固定 primary endpoint 不做事後挑選；tie-break 改用 effect size 或標記為 tie 而非默認 hp。

verified_high.title: verification_class 的 cluster-first 與 label-first 兩條路徑不獨立 — 兩者皆以 HP/甲基化距離為基礎，'Strong=兩路徑一致' 是部分循環論證
verified_high.description: verification_class 宣稱是 bidirectional verification：'Strong' 表示 cluster-first 與 label-first 兩條獨立路徑都顯著。但 cluster_significant 用的是 cluster_labels × HP_family(或 ALT/REF) 的 Fisher FFH（global_hp_family.fisher_ffh），而 cluster_labels 本身是由甲基化距離矩陣階層分群得到；label_sig (any_significant) 的 hp_multistage.merged 又是用同一個甲基化距離矩陣做 HP-family 的 between/within delta test。兩條路徑的輸入都是『甲基化結構 + HP 標籤』，差別只在一個用離散 cluster 標籤跑列聯表、一個用連續距離跑 permutation。當甲基化真的有 HP 結構時，兩者高度相關而非獨立驗證；'Strong = 兩路徑一致' 因此會系統性高估，無法當成真正的交叉驗證。
verified_high.why_wrong: 宣稱的『雙向獨立驗證』要求兩條路徑用不同資訊或不同假設。此處兩路徑共用甲基化距離 + HP 標籤這同一組輸入，cluster 標籤是距離的函數，所以兩個檢定在 null 下不獨立、在 alternative 下強相關。把它命名為 Strong/獨立一致會誇大證據等級。
verified_high.evidence: L309-311: `bool cluster_significant = result.passed_gate && (result.global_alt.fisher_ffh.p_value <= 0.05 || result.global_hp_family.fisher_ffh.p_value <= 0.05);` ; L312 `bool label_sig = result.label_significant;` (= hp_multistage.merged.significant || allele delta) ; L326 `if (label_sig && cluster_significant) { ... result.verification_class = "Strong";`。cluster_labels 為甲基化距離分群結果（analyze 的入參，來自上游 hierarchical clustering），label_sig 的 merged delta 也用同一 dist_matrix（LabelTest.cpp:604 test_binary_groups(dist_matrix,...)）。
verified_high.effect_hypothesis: Strong 類別占比可能被高估、Subclone/Weak 邊界被擠壓；對 TP/FP 判別力的評估會偏樂觀（兩路徑看似一致其實是同一訊號被算兩次）。
