verified_high.quantification_method: 對全 30,350 位點的 significance.json/summary，計算 cluster_significant 與 label_sig 的 2x2 共現表與 phi 係數；再用 HP-permuted null（打亂 HP 標籤但保留距離矩陣與 cluster 標籤）重跑，看 Strong 比例下降多少。資料：research/tsg_promoter_asm_reviewer/.../significance_summary.csv 與各 region 的 significance.json。
verified_high.fix_direction: (a) 文件與欄位語意改稱『concordance class』而非『獨立雙向驗證』；(b) 若要真正獨立，cluster-first 應用『非甲基化』的分群（如 read 序列/長度）或對 cluster_labels 與 label 用不同甲基化子集；(c) 至少在報告標註兩路徑共用甲基化距離、Strong 不可解讀為兩個獨立證據。

verdict.reasoning:
資料流事實全部查證屬實。cluster-first 路徑 (cluster_significant, SignificanceAnalyzer.cpp:309-311) = Fisher FFH 於列聯表 cluster_labels × {HP-family 或 ALT/REF}（GlobalTest.cpp:55-64 建表、:83 fisher_.test_rxc_mc），而 cluster_labels 正是甲基化距離階層樹的切割結果（RegionProcessor.cpp:1486-1487 build_tree(all_dist)、:1517 TreeCutter::find_optimal_clusters(tree, all_dist.dist_matrix)）。label-first 路徑 (label_sig=label_significant, :312) = hp_multistage.merged.significant，是於「同一個」dist_matrix 上做 HP 分組的 within/between 平均距離對比（LabelTest.cpp:44 test_all(dist_matrix,...)、:104 hp_sig=merged.significant、:340-378 compute_group_distances）。同一個 dist_matrix 既餵 analyze 又用來生 cluster_labels（RegionProcessor.cpp:1583 同時傳 cluster_labels 與 all_dist.dist_matrix）。程式碼註解確實寫「Bidirectional Verification」(:307) 與「Both paths agree」(:332)。

審查員的統計核心觀察方向正確：兩條檢定確實「非統計獨立」——共用距離矩陣 + HP 標籤，在 alternative 下正相關，因此「Strong = 兩路一致」不能當成兩條獨立證據，命名為「bidirectional/獨立驗證」高估了證據等級。這是合理的方法學顧慮。

但兩點使我無法 CONFIRMED 且須降 severity：
(1)「循環論證/不獨立」框架過強。兩路徑套用的是「不同算子」——離散 cluster 列聯表 vs 連續 label-conditioned 配對距離對比。程式碼正用 Subclone(cluster sig 但 label 不 sig, :335) 與 Weak(label sig 但 cluster 不 sig, :337) 兩類，這證明兩路在實務上會「dissociate」，並非共線/冗餘。若真完全循環，這兩類永不出現。故「Strong」確實攜帶增量資訊（label-blind 切割 與 label-conditioned 對比 同向），只是非「統計獨立」。
(2) 這不是 bug——無錯誤計算、無 crash、無邏輯錯誤；是命名/詮釋上把「相關證據」說成「獨立雙向驗證」的修辭過頭。且對實際研究結論的 blast radius 有限：INDEX 的頭條 ASM/LOH 結論用的是 Δβ / NGroups / PERMANOVA excess-over-null，未見依賴 verification_class「Strong」標籤。

結論：真實存在的「過度宣稱獨立性」的方法學/命名顧慮，但被誤標為「循環論證」（兩路可分離）且 severity 從 HIGH 高估（非計算錯誤、下游影響有限）。正確落點為 LOW/INFO 級的詮釋顧慮，建議把註解「Bidirectional/independent」改為「concordant (correlated) evidence」即可，不需改邏輯。

verified_high.title: 每位點跑多個顯著性檢定 + 跨上萬位點，但 region-level 完全沒有 multiple-testing 校正（只有 PerCpgAsm 內部有 FDR）
verified_high.description: 單一位點就跑了多個 p 值檢定：global_alt / global_hp / global_hp_family / global_hp_fine Fisher-FFH（Phase 1），label HP-merged delta、label allele delta、sample delta、HP fine PERMANOVA、HP-merged PERMANOVA、allele PERMANOVA（Phase 4），全部各自和 0.05 比。verification_class 與 passed_gate 取『任一顯著』(OR 邏輯，L90 與 L310 都是 `||`)，等於對多個檢定取最小 p 卻不做校正，膨脹 family-wise error。再加上工具跑全基因組數萬位點（30,350 位點），region-level 沒有任何 BH/Bonferroni（grep 確認 FDR 僅存在於 PerCpgAsm 的『單 region 內跨 CpG』校正，不涵蓋跨檢定/跨位點）。
verified_high.why_wrong: 對多個檢定用 OR 取顯著等同隱式取最小 p；在 null 下，K 個檢定至少一個 p<=0.05 的機率遠大於 0.05。跨上萬位點也會有大量假陽性。沒有跨檢定/跨位點 FDR，significant 旗標與 Strong/Weak 計數的偽陽率不受控，論文若用『N 個位點顯著』會嚴重高估。
verified_high.evidence: L90 `result.passed_gate = expanded.alt.passed_gate || expanded.hp_family.passed_gate;` ; L310-311 cluster_significant 用 `p<=0.05 || p<=0.05`；Phase 4 連跑 6 個 label 檢定各自 alpha=0.05（LabelTest config alpha=0.05, LabelTest.hpp:38）。grep `fdr|bonferroni|benjamini` 在 src/include 僅命中 PerCpgAsm.cpp（per-CpG within-region BH）與 RegionProcessor 對 per_cpg fdr 的轉貼，無 region-level 校正。
verified_high.effect_hypothesis: passed_gate / any_significant / verification_class!=Noise 的位點數被高估；TP vs FP 在『是否顯著』上的差距會因共同的假陽性 inflation 而縮小或被誤判。
verified_high.quantification_method: 對全位點輸出的各 p 值欄做 BH-FDR（跨位點，分檢定類別），比較 FDR<0.05 與 raw p<0.05 的位點數差距；並用 OR-of-K 對單一 alpha 做 Šidák/Bonferroni 等效估算每位點實際 alpha。資料：significance_summary.csv 全欄 p 值。
verified_high.fix_direction: 在 region 層加跨位點 BH-FDR（對每種檢定分開校正），並在單位點對『跨 label 維度』的多檢定明示用 min-p + 校正（如 Šidák）或預先指定 primary endpoint（HP-axis）避免事後挑最小 p。報告改用 FDR 而非 raw p 計數。

verdict.reasoning:
Technical mechanics of the finding are CONFIRMED, but the HIGH severity (implying paper-level "N significant" claims are uncorrected) is REFUTED by the downstream layer the reviewer did not inspect.

What is true (verified by reading the code):
- src/core/SignificanceAnalyzer.cpp:90 — `result.passed_gate = expanded.alt.passed_gate || expanded.hp_family.passed_gate;` is OR-logic over two tests. (Note: the gate itself is p<=0.1 per include/core/GlobalTest.hpp:29 `gating_p_threshold = 0.1` + GlobalTest.cpp:140, not 0.05 — a minor inaccuracy in the finding.)
- L309-311 — `cluster_significant = passed_gate && (global_alt.fisher_ffh.p<=0.05 || global_hp_family.fisher_ffh.p<=0.05)`, an OR of two p<=0.05 tests.
- src/core/LabelTest.cpp:106 — `any_significant = hp_sig || allele_sig` (each at alpha=0.05, LabelTest.hpp:38), feeding `label_significant` (L282).
- The four-way `verification_class` Strong/Subclone/Weak/Noise (L326-340) is derived from these OR-combined, uncorrected per-site flags.
- grep for fdr|bonferroni|benjamini in src/+include/ hits ONLY PerCpgAsm.cpp (within-region across-CpG BH) — so the C++ significance layer genuinely has no cross-test/cross-site correction. The reviewer's grep was accurate for its scope.

Why severity is overstated (the decisive omission): the reviewer scoped grep to src/include only and concluded "no region-level FDR anywhere," but the actual G6 paper pipeline applies region/genome-level multiple-testing correction in the downstream Python layer that produces the publishable claims:
- research/tsg_promoter_asm_reviewer/scripts/96_noncircular_validation.py — BH-FDR on permutation p ACROSS sites (`perm_q<=0.05`), recomputing its OWN non-circular F-stat instead of trusting the C++ LabelHPPermanova flag.
- scripts/77_meaningful_filter_iteration.py:69,120-122,227 — BH-q on GlobalP across sites per (sample,class); the "meaningful set (15391)" claim is gated by BH-q<=0.10, and I1-vs-I2 explicitly contrasts "未控 FDR" vs corrected.
- scripts/22_tp_vs_fp_stats_confirm.py:69-93 — Bonferroni over the 6 tests with explicit per-dim verdicts + a caveat that the axes are mechanistically non-independent.
- scripts/80_build_capstone_html.py:91 lists "Permutation FDR (BH-q)" as a validation method.

So the C++ raw per-site `significant`/`passed_gate`/`Strong` flags are screening/characterization gates (and yes, the OR-of-K-tests does inflate that raw flag rate — a legitimate code-level observation). But they are NOT the inferential layer behind any "N sites significant" paper claim; those are recomputed downstream with proper site-level FDR and even non-circular statistics. The finding's core inferential harm (inflated published false-positive counts) is therefore not substantiated. The OR-without-correction in C++ is real and worth a note, but at most LOW/INFO given it is a pre-screen, not the reported result.

verified_high.title: ALLELE-axis (ALT vs REF) 與 HP-axis (HP-family) 在 verification 邏輯中被平行對待，但 ALLELE-axis 會被 baseline allelic methylation confound — label_sig 用 OR 合併使 confounded 軸可單獨觸發 Strong
verified_high.description: test_all 的 any_significant = hp_sig || allele_sig（LabelTest.cpp:104-106），cluster_significant 也是 global_alt(ALT/REF) OR global_hp_family（SignificanceAnalyzer.cpp:310-311）。依專案既有 memory（feedback_asm_allele_axis_baseline_confound），ALLELE-axis 的 ALT-vs-REF 甲基化差異無法區分 somatic-特異 ASM 與 germline baseline allelic methylation（het 基線），只有 HP-axis (HP1 vs HP1-1) 是 somatic-controlled。此處 allele delta（test_binary_groups allele_labels）與 allele PERMANOVA（run_grouped_structure allele_labels）被當成與 HP 同等的證據，OR 進 label_sig / cluster_significant，使一個被 confound 的軸可以單獨把位點推成 significant/Strong。
verified_high.why_wrong: 把已知會被 baseline allelic methylation confound 的 ALLELE-axis 與 somatic-controlled 的 HP-axis 等權 OR，違反『somatic ASM 必跑 germline-het null』的方法學要求。結果是 verification_class=Strong 可能僅由 confounded 的 allele 訊號驅動，無法支持 somatic ASM 宣稱。
verified_high.evidence: LabelTest.cpp:106 `result.any_significant = hp_sig || allele_sig;` ; SignificanceAnalyzer.cpp:310-311 cluster_significant 含 `result.global_alt.fisher_ffh.p_value <= 0.05 ||`；Phase 4 對 allele_labels 跑 run_grouped_structure（L303）。專案 memory feedback_asm_allele_axis_baseline_confound 明列 ALLELE-axis confounded、只有 HP-axis somatic-controlled。
verified_high.effect_hypothesis: 由 allele-only 驅動的 Strong/significant 位點在 germline-het null 下無法存活；若論文以 verification_class 計數 somatic ASM 會混入 baseline allelic methylation。
verified_high.quantification_method: 分解 significant 位點為『HP-axis 顯著』vs『僅 allele-axis 顯著』兩集合，對後者跑 germline-het 負控（如 memory 中 het null 15.2% baseline）比較。資料：significance_summary.csv 的 label_hp vs label_allele significant 欄。
verified_high.fix_direction: verification 主軸改以 HP-axis 為 primary endpoint，allele-axis 只作 secondary/需配 germline-het null 才採信；輸出明確標記 significant 是由哪個 axis 驅動，避免 allele-only 觸發 Strong。

verdict.reasoning:
Code facts verified and accurate: LabelTest.cpp:106 `result.any_significant = hp_sig || allele_sig;` ORs HP-merged + allele significance; SignificanceAnalyzer.cpp:309-312 `cluster_significant` ORs `global_alt` (ALT/REF) with `global_hp_family`, and `label_sig = result.label_significant` (==any_significant); SignificanceAnalyzer.cpp:303 runs run_grouped_structure on allele_labels symmetrically with hp_merged_labels (L301). The cited memory (feedback_asm_allele_axis_baseline_confound) genuinely documents that ALLELE-axis ALT-vs-REF methylation is confounded by baseline allelic methylation, while only HP-axis (HP1 vs HP1-1) is somatic-controlled. So the reviewer's premise is real.

BUT the framing as a HIGH-severity code bug does not survive scrutiny, for three reasons grounded in code I read:

1) Intentional design, asserted by tests. tests/test_label_test.cpp:296 explicitly `EXPECT_TRUE(result.any_significant)` when either dimension is significant; test_significance_analyzer.cpp separately validates `allele_result` and `label_allele_permanova`. The OR-merge produces a *coarse screening* category ("some axis shows read-level structure"), which is exactly the C++ engine's job. `verification_class="Strong"` (SignificanceAnalyzer.cpp:326-333) never asserts "somatic-specific ASM."

2) The confound is fully recoverable — nothing is irreversibly collapsed. The engine preserves the complete per-axis breakdown in its output: RegionProcessor.cpp:1196-1203 writes `label_hp_permanova_{f,p,valid}` AND `label_allele_permanova_{f,p,valid}` separately; `global_alt` vs `global_hp_family` Fisher p-values are stored separately (Stats.hpp:407/427/432); `dominant_label_dimension` records "hp" vs "allele" (SignificanceAnalyzer.cpp:281). Any downstream consumer can see precisely which axis drove a "Strong" call.

3) The methodological remedy the memory prescribes (germline-het null, per-axis reporting, treat allele-axis as confounded) is a downstream-analysis discipline executed in Python using these preserved per-axis fields — not a responsibility of this C++ statistical engine. The engine correctly exposes both axes; the over-claim risk arises only if an analyst reads only the merged `verification_class`.

Net: no incorrect value is computed and no information is lost; the OR is a deliberate, test-locked screening combiner with full per-axis provenance retained. At most this is an INFO-level documentation footgun (a reader of only `verification_class` could over-interpret), not a HIGH code defect. Reviewer conflated a methodological interpretation caveat with an engine bug.

perReviewer.notes:
Scope = read-read distance matrix (DistanceMatrix.cpp/.hpp) + TreeStructure.cpp/.hpp. I traced the production default path: Config.hpp default metric = BERNOULLI (not the NHD struct default), C_min=3, binarization in RegionProcessor.cpp:1410-1423.

TreeStructure.cpp/.hpp (tree node / Newick / clade collection / deep copy): reviewed, NO distance-axis defects in scope. It is a pure tree container: create_internal computes branch_length = merge_height - child_height (correct for a dendrogram), leaf_indices merged+sorted, parent uses weak_ptr (no cycle leak), deep_copy reassigns parents, Newick recursion and clade collection are standard. Actual linkage/cut/NG-determination logic lives in HierarchicalClustering.cpp (different reviewer area), not reported here.

Verified-correct items (NOT reported): symmetry is explicitly enforced (dist(i,j)=dist(j,i) written, 443-444); NHD denominator = common valid sites (correct); L1=mean|Δ|, L2=sqrt(mean(Δ²)) both correctly normalized by common_count; CORR clamps r to [-1,1] and normalizes (1-r)/2 to [0,1]; OpenMP reduction over stats is race-free (each (i,j) written once); CSV writer emits NA for NaN; CORR min_cov<3 guard fine.

Highest-value to quantify with real data: DIST-1 (BERNOULLI semimetric self-disagreement floor on the PRODUCTION default metric — affects every PERMANOVA within-group SS), DIST-2 (intermediate-methylation sites dropped only for binary metrics; ambiguous==no-coverage sentinel collision), DIST-6 (MAX_DIST substitution for low-overlap pairs can confound ASM significance if overlap correlates with HP label). DIST-3/DIST-4 are static config-hygiene (no rerun). DIST-5/7/8 affect only non-default metrics. DIST-9 is a contract flag pointing at the upstream 5mC/5hmC collapse for the ASM_METHYL reviewer.

No build or long command run (read-only). All effect magnitudes left for the main loop to compute from output/ (significance_summary.csv, methylation.csv, distance_matrix_*.csv).

all_findings.title: Diagonal self-distance is hardcoded 0 (never computed); BERNOULLI default metric violates d(x,x)=0 for distinct identical-pattern reads — semimetric fed to PERMANOVA/clustering
all_findings.lines: 254-302 (calculate_bernoulli), 408+430-446 (compute_subset fills only i<j / j<i, diagonal left at Zero init)
all_findings.description: The production default metric is BERNOULLI (Config.hpp:40 distance_metrics = {BERNOULLI}). Its per-site disagreement is delta(p,q)=p(1-q)+(1-p)q; for two reads with the SAME intermediate methylation value p (e.g. both p=0.6), delta=2p(1-p)>0, so two reads with identical soft-methylation patterns receive a strictly positive distance. Yet compute_subset only fills the upper/lower triangle (loops j=i+1..n) and the diagonal stays at the Eigen::MatrixXd::Zero(n,n) initial value, so get_distance(i,i) always returns 0. Result: d(i,i)=0 but d(i,j)>0 for an identical-pattern distinct read — the function is a semimetric (identity-of-indiscernibles violated), not a metric.
all_findings.why_wrong: PERMANOVA pseudo-F (Anderson 2001) and hierarchical clustering assume a dissimilarity where within-cluster spread reflects genuine pattern difference. Under BERNOULLI, even perfectly concordant reads carry a baseline positive within-group distance proportional to Σ2p(1-p) (intermediate-confidence sites), inflating SS_within and shrinking pseudo-F / cluster separation in a confidence-dependent way. The test suite (test_distance_matrix.cpp:563-579 AllMetrics_DiagonalIsZero, comment lines 471-472) explicitly excludes BERNOULLI 'd(i,i)!=0 by design', but in the stored matrix d(i,i) is actually 0 — so the documented 'by design' non-zero diagonal is never realized, masking the real asymmetry between diagonal(=0) and off-diagonal(inflated).
all_findings.evidence: calculate_bernoulli: `double delta = p_i * (1.0 - p_j) + (1.0 - p_i) * p_j;` (line 281) — for p_i=p_j=p gives 2p(1-p)>0. compute_subset: `this->dist_matrix = Eigen::MatrixXd::Zero(n, n);` (408) then `for (int j = i + 1; j < n; ++j)` (431) — diagonal never assigned. Test pin: `// BERNOULLI d(i,i) != 0 by design — excluded from this test.` (test_distance_matrix.cpp:565).
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: Within-group (HP1 vs HP1) BERNOULLI distances are positively biased by an intermediate-confidence floor, attenuating PERMANOVA pseudo-F and cluster contrast; direction = makes ASM structure look weaker (conservative) rather than spuriously strong, but the magnitude scales with the fraction of intermediate-confidence (p near 0.5) CpGs per region.
all_findings.quantification_method: For a sample of regions, recompute the BERNOULLI distance of each read to a clone of itself (delta=2p(1-p), weighted) and compare to the off-diagonal min within-HP distances; quantify mean diagonal-would-be value vs mean within-group off-diagonal from distance_matrix_BERNOULLI.csv. Also re-run PERMANOVA pseudo-F with diagonal-consistent vs zero diagonal to bound the SS_within shift using existing significance_summary.csv outputs.
all_findings.fix_direction: Either (a) document BERNOULLI as a confidence-weighted dissimilarity (not metric) and confirm PERMANOVA only uses off-diagonal pairs (it does — StructureTest compute_ss iterates i<j), so the floor cancels partially; or (b) subtract the self-disagreement baseline so identical patterns map to 0 (use Jensen-Shannon / Hellinger between the two Bernoulli distributions, which are true metrics with d(x,x)=0). Remove or correct the misleading 'd(i,i)!=0 by design' test comment since the stored diagonal is 0.

all_findings.title: Intermediate-methylation CpGs are silently dropped for NHD/JACCARD (binary=-1 'Ambiguous' conflated with no-coverage), so C_min and the distance denominator differ by metric
all_findings.description: Binarization marks any covered site with binary_threshold_low < val < binary_threshold_high (default 0.2..0.8) as binary=-1 ('Ambiguous'), the SAME sentinel used for no-coverage. NHD (calculate_nhd) and Jaccard (calculate_jaccard) treat -1 as missing and exclude it from common_count. The raw_matrix keeps the intermediate value (raw=val, not NaN), so L1/L2/CORR/BERNOULLI count those sites. Consequently the effective common-coverage and the min_common_coverage (C_min=3 in production) gate operate on a metric-dependent denominator: a read pair confidently overlapping at 4 intermediate-methylation CpGs is 'valid' for BERNOULLI but 'invalid' (MAX_DIST) for NHD.
all_findings.why_wrong: Conflating 'ambiguous call' with 'no coverage' discards real informational sites and makes NHD/Jaccard distances non-comparable to the raw metrics, and makes the valid/invalid pair statistics (num_valid_pairs, avg_common_coverage) metric-dependent in a non-obvious way. For regions with many intermediate-methylation reads (common in tumor heterogeneity / partial ASM), NHD systematically sees fewer common sites and flips more pairs to MAX_DIST, distorting the read-read structure exactly where partial methylation differences matter.
all_findings.evidence: RegionProcessor.cpp: `} else { meth_mat.binary_matrix(i, j) = -1;  // Ambiguous }` (1421-1422) — same -1 as `binary_matrix(i,j) = -1;` for no coverage (1413). NHD: `if (val_i != -1 && val_j != -1) { common_count++; ... }` (DistanceMatrix.cpp:42-44). raw kept: `meth_mat.raw_matrix(i, j) = val;` (1415).
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: When NHD is selected, fraction of MAX_DIST (invalid) pairs and apparent read dissimilarity increases with the intermediate-methylation fraction of the region; this can both inflate spurious 2-group splits (MAX_DIST creates artificial bimodality) and suppress detection of partial-methylation subgroups. Direction depends on region; mainly affects robustness/comparability, not the BERNOULLI default path.
all_findings.quantification_method: Per region, count CpGs with 0.2<raw<0.8 from methylation.csv, then compare num_invalid_pairs and avg_common_coverage between distance_matrix_NHD.csv and distance_matrix_BERNOULLI.csv significance_summary stats; quantify how many ASM-significant regions change PERMANOVA verdict when NHD vs BERNOULLI is used.
all_findings.fix_direction: Use distinct sentinels for 'no coverage' vs 'ambiguous call', and decide deliberately: either keep ambiguous as informative (let NHD compare the soft call) or document that NHD/Jaccard intentionally restrict to high-confidence sites. At minimum, report common_count per metric so C_min is interpretable. Note BERNOULLI default already avoids this by using raw values.

all_findings.title: Dead config flag: use_binary_matrix / distance_use_binary is set but never read — binary-vs-raw is hardcoded by metric type
all_findings.description: DistanceConfig.use_binary_matrix (default true) and Config.distance_use_binary are plumbed from CLI into distance_config_ (RegionProcessor.cpp:427) but calculate_distance_impl never consults the flag: NHD/JACCARD always read mat.binary_matrix and L1/L2/CORR/BERNOULLI always read mat.raw_matrix, hardcoded by the switch on config.metric. The flag has no effect anywhere (grep confirms only set sites, no read sites except the assignment).
all_findings.why_wrong: A user setting --distance... to force binary or raw representation silently does nothing, and the documented semantics 'Use binary matrix (true) or raw matrix (false)' are false. This is a reproducibility/provenance hazard: config recorded in run metadata implies a control that does not exist, and the default 'true' contradicts the production default metric BERNOULLI which uses raw values.
all_findings.evidence: grep use_binary_matrix → only Config.hpp:50, DistanceMatrix.hpp:26, RegionProcessor.cpp:427 (assignment) — no read site. switch hardcodes: NHD `mat.binary_matrix.row(row_i)` (311), BERNOULLI `mat.raw_matrix.row(row_i)` (342).
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: No numerical effect on current results (flag inert), but invalidates any claim that runs were controlled by this option; risk if a future reader assumes BERNOULLI was binarized.
all_findings.quantification_method: Static — confirm via grep that no code branch reads the flag; no rerun needed.
all_findings.fix_direction: Either wire the flag (e.g. allow raw-valued NHD via thresholding choice) or remove it from Config/DistanceConfig/CLI to avoid a phantom control. Update the doc comment.

all_findings.title: DistanceConfig struct default metric (NHD) disagrees with production default (BERNOULLI) — silent default divergence between unit tests and pipeline
all_findings.description: DistanceConfig defaults to metric=NHD and min_common_coverage=5 (DistanceMatrix.hpp:22-23), but the production AnalysisConfig defaults to distance_metrics={BERNOULLI} and min_common_coverage=3 (Config.hpp:37,40). Unit tests (test_distance_matrix.cpp) almost all exercise NHD and never assert the production default metric is BERNOULLI. The metric-selection logic in RegionProcessor (418-422) picks distance_metrics_[0] and only falls back to NHD if the list is empty.
all_findings.why_wrong: Two independent default sources for the same parameter invite drift: a developer reading DistanceConfig/the test suite would reasonably believe NHD (a true 0/1 Hamming) is the operative metric, while the paper's read-read distance axis is actually computed with the confidence-weighted BERNOULLI semimetric (DIST-1). The test suite's coverage of the actual production path (BERNOULLI end-to-end via RegionProcessor) is thin — only 3 BERNOULLI oracle-value tests at the function level, none through the default Config path.
all_findings.evidence: `DistanceMetricType metric = DistanceMetricType::NHD;` (DistanceMatrix.hpp:22) and `int min_common_coverage = 5;` (23) vs `std::vector<DistanceMetricType> distance_metrics = {DistanceMetricType::BERNOULLI};` (Config.hpp:40), `int min_common_coverage = 3;` (Config.hpp:37).
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: No direct numerical effect, but raises the chance that analysis/methods text describes NHD/Hamming while results use BERNOULLI; also C_min=3 (vs 5) is more permissive than the struct default, admitting low-overlap pairs whose distances are noisier.
all_findings.quantification_method: Static cross-check of Config.hpp vs DistanceMatrix.hpp defaults and grep of which metric string appears in produced distance_matrix_*.csv filenames in output/ to confirm BERNOULLI is the one consumed downstream.
all_findings.fix_direction: Make the struct default match production (set DistanceConfig.metric=BERNOULLI, min_common_coverage=3) or centralize defaults in one place; add an end-to-end test that runs the default Config path and asserts the metric used is BERNOULLI.

all_findings.title: Jaccard with include_unmeth=true is actually the Simple Matching Coefficient (Hamming), not Jaccard — mislabeled metric
all_findings.description: When jaccard_include_unmeth=true, the function increments intersection whenever val_i==val_j (both 0 OR both 1) and increments union_size for every valid pair, giving index = matches/total = Simple Matching Coefficient; distance = 1 - SMC = proportion of disagreements = exactly the NHD/Hamming on binary data. This is not the Jaccard coefficient, which by definition excludes the negative-negative (0,0) co-absence cell.
all_findings.why_wrong: The function/comment (lines 178-183) claims 'Jaccard = 1 - |A∩B|/|A∪B|' with A,B = methylated sites, but the include_unmeth branch silently switches to a different, co-absence-counting coefficient and still reports it as JACCARD in metric_to_string and CSV filenames. A reader comparing 'Jaccard' distances across configs would unknowingly compare two structurally different metrics (asymmetric Jaccard vs symmetric SMC). Default is false, so production default Jaccard path is correct, but the option is a labeling trap.
all_findings.evidence: `if (include_unmeth) { if (val_i == val_j) { intersection++; } union_size++; }` (203-208) → 1 - intersection/union = 1 - matches/total = disagreement fraction = SMC complement, not Jaccard.
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: Only affects runs that opt into include_unmeth; for those, 'Jaccard' distances equal binary Hamming and would compress distances for sparsely-methylated read pairs (co-absence inflates similarity). No effect on default runs.
all_findings.quantification_method: Static — derive algebraically (done) that the include_unmeth branch equals 1 - SMC; if any run used the flag, compare its distance_matrix_JACCARD.csv to NHD on the same binary matrix to confirm equality.
all_findings.fix_direction: Rename the include_unmeth variant (e.g. SMC / matching) or document explicitly that include_unmeth converts the metric to Simple Matching, and prevent it from sharing the JACCARD label in output filenames.

all_findings.title: MAX_DIST fallback for low-overlap pairs injects an artificial maximal distance that can create spurious bimodal structure in clustering/PERMANOVA
all_findings.description: Pairs with common_count < C_min get dist = max_distance_value (1.0 for normalized metrics) under the default NanDistanceStrategy::MAX_DIST. This replaces 'unknown / insufficient evidence' with 'maximally dissimilar'. Reads with little overlap (short reads, region edges, sparse coverage) are thus pushed to the far corner of the distance space rather than excluded, which can manufacture an apparent second cluster (everything-vs-low-overlap split) that has nothing to do with methylation pattern.
all_findings.why_wrong: Insufficient overlap is missing data, not maximal dissimilarity; coding it as the largest possible distance biases hierarchical clustering toward splitting off low-overlap reads and inflates PERMANOVA SS_between if low-overlap reads happen to align with a haplotype label (e.g. one HP has shorter reads / lower coverage). Because BERNOULLI/NHD distances are in [0,1], 1.0 is the extreme, so these substituted values dominate the upper tail of the distance distribution. The alternative SKIP strategy yields NaN, which PERMANOVA then rejects wholesale (StructureTest aborts on any NaN, StructureTest.cpp:166), so users are effectively pushed to MAX_DIST.
all_findings.evidence: `double nan_val = config.max_distance_value;` (411) and `if (dist < 0) { dist = nan_val; tl_invalid_pairs++; }` (435-437). SKIP path: `if (config.nan_strategy == NanDistanceStrategy::SKIP) { nan_val = NAN; }` (412-414) → downstream StructureTest sets valid=false on any NaN (StructureTest.cpp:166).
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: If low-overlap reads correlate with HP/allele label (coverage or read-length asymmetry between haplotypes), MAX_DIST substitution inflates between-group SS and can produce false-positive ASM significance; if uncorrelated, it adds noise and can create spurious extra clusters. Direction is region-specific and confound-prone.
all_findings.quantification_method: Per region, read num_invalid_pairs / total pairs from significance_summary.csv; for high-invalid-fraction regions, test whether invalid-pair membership is associated with HP label (chi-square on read-level overlap vs HP) and re-run PERMANOVA with low-overlap reads excluded vs MAX_DIST-substituted to bound the SS_between change.
all_findings.fix_direction: Prefer excluding chronically low-overlap reads up front (StructureTest already has filter_reads_for_complete_matrix) rather than substituting MAX_DIST; or use a neutral substitute (e.g. the observed median distance) and flag affected pairs. Document the substitution and report the fraction of MAX_DIST pairs per region alongside the verdict.

all_findings.title: CORR (Pearson) distance is not a metric (triangle inequality violated) and zero-variance reads are forced to max distance 1.0, inconsistent with its [0,1] normalization
all_findings.description: calculate_corr returns (1-r)/2 ∈ [0,1]. Pearson-correlation distance is well known to violate the triangle inequality, so labeling/using it interchangeably with the true metrics (L1/L2/NHD) for hierarchical clustering (where UPGMA/Ward implicitly assume meaningful additive distances) is methodologically loose. Additionally, when either read has zero variance over the common sites (sum_sq < 1e-10, e.g. a fully-methylated read), the function returns 1.0 (max distance) — but on the (1-r)/2 scale an 'undefined correlation' has no natural value, and 1.0 corresponds to r=-1 (perfect anti-correlation), over-penalizing a constant read as maximally dissimilar from everything.
all_findings.why_wrong: Treating an undefined correlation as r=-1 (max distance) biases constant/flat reads (common: reads fully methylated or fully unmethylated across the region) to the far edge of the distance space, which — like DIST-6 — can spuriously cluster them together or split them off. Combined with the non-metric nature, CORR-based clustering trees are not guaranteed to reflect a consistent geometry.
all_findings.evidence: `if (sum_sq_i < 1e-10 || sum_sq_j < 1e-10) { return 1.0; }` (162-164) and `return (1.0 - corr) / 2.0;` (174). corr=0 (uncorrelated) maps to 0.5, so 1.0 == r=-1, i.e. zero-variance reads are coded as perfectly anti-correlated.
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: Affects only CORR-metric runs (not BERNOULLI default). Flat reads get distance 1.0 from all others, potentially forming an artificial group or distorting Ward linkage; non-metric distances can reorder merges vs a true metric.
all_findings.quantification_method: Static for the metric property; empirically, if CORR runs exist, count reads with zero variance per region (from methylation.csv) and inspect their position in distance_matrix_CORR.csv vs cluster assignment.
all_findings.fix_direction: For zero-variance reads return NaN/invalid (true 'undefined') rather than 1.0, and document CORR as a non-metric dissimilarity unsuitable for Ward/UPGMA if metric assumptions are claimed. Prefer L2/BERNOULLI when a metric is required.

all_findings.title: BERNOULLI confidence weighting can leave sum_weights≈0 → entire pair flagged invalid (MAX_DIST) even with ample overlap, when all common sites are near p=0.5
all_findings.description: For BERNOULLI, if every common site has p near 0.5 in at least one read, the confidence weights w_k=2|p_i-0.5|*2|p_j-0.5| all collapse to ~0; sum_weights<1e-9 then returns -1.0 (invalid) → MAX_DIST under the default strategy, despite common_count >= C_min. So a read pair with plentiful but low-confidence overlap is recoded as maximally dissimilar.
all_findings.why_wrong: Low-confidence overlap (all intermediate methylation) is again 'uncertain', not 'maximally different'; routing it to MAX_DIST (DIST-6) injects an extreme distance. This is a corner case but matters for regions dominated by intermediate methylation (partial/heterogeneous ASM), exactly the biologically interesting regime, where it would push such reads to the cluster periphery.
all_findings.evidence: `if (sum_weights < 1e-9) { return -1.0; }` (296-297) — returns the same invalid sentinel as insufficient coverage, then compute_subset converts -1 to max_distance_value.
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: Rare in practice (requires near-uniform p≈0.5), but where it triggers it converts 'no confident signal' into 'extreme distance', a direction that can both fabricate structure and mask true partial-methylation similarity.
all_findings.quantification_method: Count BERNOULLI pairs with common_count>=C_min but flagged invalid (compare per-region num_invalid_pairs to NHD/raw expectation); inspect whether such regions are intermediate-methylation dominated via methylation.csv.
all_findings.fix_direction: Distinguish 'low total weight' from 'insufficient coverage': return NaN/exclude or fall back to unweighted mean disagreement when sum_weights is tiny, rather than the MAX_DIST sentinel.

all_findings.title: Raw metrics (L1/L2/CORR/BERNOULLI) consume raw_matrix probabilities with no [0,1] guard — distance axis silently inherits any 5mC/5hmC collapse defect from MatrixBuilder
all_findings.description: The raw metrics assume raw_matrix entries are valid probabilities in [0,1] (BERNOULLI's delta and weight, and the [0,1] output claim, rely on p in [0,1]). The distance code performs no clamping/validation; correctness depends entirely on the upstream MatrixBuilder 5mC/5hmC collapse producing a single calibrated probability per CpG. If the collapse ever emits values >1 or sums two mod channels, BERNOULLI delta/weight and the documented [0,1] range silently break (weight 2|p-0.5| grows >1, delta can exceed 1).
all_findings.why_wrong: This is a contract/robustness gap rather than a confirmed bug in this file: the distance layer trusts an upstream invariant (single per-site probability in [0,1]) that is established in MatrixBuilder (out of this scope, ASM_METHYL area). Flagging so the upstream collapse is audited for the 5mC/5hmC max-collapse known-issue, since the read-read distance axis is the paper's primary claim and depends on it.
all_findings.evidence: BERNOULLI: `double w_i = weight_func(p_i);` with weight_func=`2.0*std::abs(p-0.5)` (262-275) and `delta = p_i*(1-p_j)+(1-p_i)*p_j` (281) — both assume p in [0,1]; no assert/clamp. raw_matrix is consumed verbatim from MatrixBuilder via RegionProcessor build (RegionProcessor.cpp:1410-1415).
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: No effect if upstream invariant holds; if 5mC/5hmC collapse is miscalibrated (the cross-cutting MSA max-collapse concern), all raw-metric distances are silently distorted with no metric-side trip-wire.
all_findings.quantification_method: Add a min/max scan of raw_matrix values written to methylation.csv to confirm all in [0,1]; cross-reference with the ASM_METHYL reviewer's audit of the 5mC/5hmC collapse in MatrixBuilder.
all_findings.fix_direction: Add a debug assert/clamp that raw probabilities are in [0,1] at the metric boundary, and document the per-site probability contract the distance layer relies on.

perReviewer.area: CLUSTER — 階層分群與子群/NG 判定（HierarchicalClustering.cpp / SubcloneAnalyzer.cpp + headers）
perReviewer.notes:
生產主路徑（RegionProcessor::perform_clustering_and_significance, line 1486-1689）為：build_tree(預設 UPGMA) → find_optimal_clusters(silhouette, k∈[2, min(6,N/2)]) → 不平衡則 +1 → 匯出 best_k 為 result.n_clusters。

最高優先（影響生產 NG 與 n_clusters 欄）：CLUSTER-1（silhouette 丟單例偏好大 k，HIGH，需重跑量化）、CLUSTER-4（強制 min_k=2 + 無 silhouette 下限門檻使每 region 必 >=2 群，MEDIUM）、CLUSTER-3（cut_by_num_clusters 可能回傳 >k 致 n_clusters 與實際 label 群數不符，MEDIUM）。

非預設路徑：CLUSTER-2（Ward 公式用成對平方距離平均近似質心距離且非 Lance-Williams，僅 --linkage WARD 觸發，預設 UPGMA 不受影響，MEDIUM）。

SubcloneAnalyzer 是 cross-region 的『閾值 if/else 偽分群』而非真 clustering（hpp 註解宣稱 cluster 但實作沒有），CLUSTER-6 點出 magic-number 閾值未進 config + n_subclones=max_id+1 會含空群/語意錯位（MEDIUM, 需重跑）。

CLUSTER-5（UPGMA merge_records slot 重用致 linkage_matrix.csv 與 scipy 格式不等價且與 build_generic 路徑不一致，LOW）需確認是否有 Python 下游真的把 linkage_matrix.csv 餵 scipy。

CLUSTER-7：整條 silhouette/Ward/cut 生產路徑無單元測試，現有 26 測試只測 trivial 完美分離 UPGMA 4-leaf，把『能跑出樹』當通過（LOW，測試覆蓋缺口）。

嚴格遵守紀律：未捏造任何 effect 量級，所有 needs_rerun=true 的 finding 都標明應查的檔（distance_matrix_[METRIC].csv / significance_summary.csv / per-region significance.json 的 optimal_k/n_clusters 欄）與重算方法（scipy/sklearn 對拍）。確認過的正確邏輯（如 UPGMA Lance-Williams 主體、build_generic single/complete 的 min/max linkage、height 單調性強制 line 113-114/288-289、cut_by_distance 在單調樹下 BFS 標號正確）未報為問題。

all_findings.title: Silhouette 選 k 時靜默丟棄單例群（count_a==0），系統性偏好把離群 read 切成單例的較大 k
all_findings.description: find_optimal_clusters 用平均 silhouette 選最佳 k，是 RegionProcessor 生產路徑決定每個 region 分幾群（best_k → result.n_clusters，line 1517/1689）的唯一機制。但 silhouette 累加只在 `count_a > 0 && b_i < max` 時計入（line 533）。當某 read 是它所屬群的唯一成員時 count_a==0、a_i 留 0，該 read 被直接從 silhouette 平均剔除（valid_count 不加），而非依 scipy/sklearn 慣例賦 s=0。
all_findings.why_wrong: 剔除單例使「把離群 read 隔離成單例」的切法不付出 silhouette 代價：被隔離的點本應拿 s=0 拉低平均，但這裡完全不算，於是平均 silhouette 只由剩下的『乾淨』群決定 → 系統性偏好產生單例的較大 k。read-level 甲基化矩陣常有少數覆蓋差/MM-ML 缺值多的 outlier read，最容易被切成單例，導致 n_clusters 被高估、虛增『>=2 個 methylation-defined 子群』的判定。
all_findings.evidence: line 511 `if (count_a > 0) a_i /= count_a;` 之後 line 533 `if (count_a > 0 && b_i < std::numeric_limits<double>::max()) { double s_i = (b_i - a_i)/std::max(a_i,b_i); total_silhouette += s_i; valid_count++; }` — count_a==0 的單例既不貢獻 s 也不進 valid_count，等於從平均中消失。
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: best_k 偏大、區域被判為多子群的比例升高；對下游 PERMANOVA/Fisher 的 cluster_labels 與 n_clusters 欄位造成偏差。方向：高估 NG。
all_findings.quantification_method: 對全 region 輸出（significance_summary.csv / per-region significance.json 的 optimal_k 與 n_clusters 欄）統計含單例群的 region 比例；再以 scipy.cluster + sklearn.silhouette_samples（單例 s=0 慣例）對同一 distance_matrix_*.csv 重算 best_k，比較分佈差。檔案：各 Region 的 distance_matrix_[METRIC].csv + significance_summary.csv。
all_findings.fix_direction: 單例群依慣例賦 s_i=0 並計入 valid_count（valid_count 應為 n，不論 count_a）；或在 silhouette 選 k 前先以 min_cluster_size 過濾候選 k（目前 min_cluster_size 檢查在 line 1540 才做，且在 best_k 已選定之後）。

all_findings.title: Ward linkage 距離公式用『平均成對平方距離』近似質心平方距離，且非 Lance-Williams 遞推 — 與宣稱的最小變異 Ward 不符
all_findings.description: build_ward 的 compute_distance 把 Ward 增量近似為 weight*avg_sq_dist，其中 avg_sq_dist = (Σ_{i∈a,j∈b} d(i,j)^2)/(|a||b|)（成對平方距離平均），weight=(na*nb)/(na+nb)。註解自己寫『Here we approximate using average inter-cluster distance』。
all_findings.why_wrong: 真正的 Ward 準則用的是兩群『質心之間』的平方距離 ‖c_a − c_b‖²，而非成對平方距離的平均。兩者差一項與群內離散度相關的偏移（avg pairwise sq dist = ‖c_a−c_b‖² + var_a + var_b 類項），所以這個公式不是 Ward 而是某種放大過的 average-linkage 變體。此外它每步用 build_generic 對成對元素全掃 O(|a||b|)（非 Lance-Williams 遞推），數值會隨群變大被群內變異污染。hpp line 20 與 cpp line 199 都宣稱『minimum variance / Ward』，名實不符；且 Ward 假設輸入為歐氏距離，但本工具距離矩陣是甲基化 pattern 距離（Hamming/Jaccard 類，未必歐氏可嵌入），即使公式對也違反 Ward 前提。
all_findings.evidence: line 215 `double avg_sq_dist = sum / (cluster_a.size() * cluster_b.size());` line 220 `return weight * avg_sq_dist;` 與註解 line 206 `// Here we approximate using average inter-cluster distance`。
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: 若使用者以 --linkage WARD 跑，得到的樹拓樸與真 Ward 不同 → 影響 cut/silhouette 出的 NG 與 cluster_labels。預設 UPGMA（Config.hpp:66）故生產主路徑不受影響，因此標 MEDIUM。
all_findings.quantification_method: 取一個 region 的 distance_matrix_*.csv，分別用本工具 WARD 與 scipy linkage(method='ward', 需 condensed 距離且 metric 為歐氏) 比較 merge 順序/height；並核對非歐氏距離下 Ward 是否合法。
all_findings.fix_direction: 若要支援 Ward：改用標準 Lance-Williams Ward 遞推（與 UPGMA 同一框架，係數 (ni+nk)/(ni+nj+nk) 等），並在文件明示需歐氏距離；否則從 enum/字串解析移除 WARD 或在非歐氏距離下 refuse。

all_findings.title: cut_by_num_clusters 取得 cluster 數的方式對非連續 label 失效，且只回傳 >=num_clusters 的第一個切高，可能回傳 != num_clusters
all_findings.description: cut_by_num_clusters 從高到低試每個內部節點高度 h，呼叫 cut_by_distance 後用 `*max_element(labels)+1` 當群數（line 466），第一個使 n_clusters>=num_clusters 的 h 就 break 並回傳 cut_by_distance(tree, h*2)。
all_findings.why_wrong: (1) `max_element+1` 假設 cut_by_distance 給出連續 0..k-1 的 label，這在 BFS 標號下成立，但若未來標號有洞會錯算群數。(2) 更實質的問題：迴圈在 n_clusters>=num_clusters 第一次成立就停，回傳的群數可能嚴格大於 num_clusters（例如多個內部節點同高度造成一次跳過目標值），呼叫端（find_optimal_clusters line 493、RegionProcessor line 1552 next_k）預期拿到剛好 k 群，但拿到 >k。find_optimal_clusters 後續用實際 labels 算 silhouette 尚可吸收，但 RegionProcessor line 1689 `result.n_clusters = best_k` 匯出的是請求值 best_k，而非實際群數 → n_clusters 欄可能與 cluster_labels 實際群數不一致。
all_findings.evidence: line 465-471 `auto test_labels = cut_by_distance(tree, h*2.0 + 0.0001); int n_clusters = *max_element(test_labels...)+1; if (n_clusters >= num_clusters) { cut_height = h*2.0; break; }`，line 1689 `result.n_clusters = best_k;`（best_k 為請求 k 非實算群數）。
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: 在有 tie 高度或不平衡樹時，匯出的 n_clusters 與實際 cluster_labels 的 distinct 群數對不上 → 下游以 n_clusters 為分母/分類的統計偏差。
all_findings.quantification_method: 在 RegionProcessor 匯出處比對 best_k 與 `set(cluster_labels).size()`；掃 significance_summary.csv 找 n_clusters 與實際 label 群數不符的 region 計數。
all_findings.fix_direction: 回傳前以實際 distinct label 數重設 n_clusters（result.n_clusters = 實算群數），或在 cut_by_num_clusters 內二分到剛好等於 num_clusters；對 tie 高度做穩定處理。

all_findings.title: find_optimal_clusters 的 silhouette 把 a(i)/b(i) 用『所有成對距離平均』而非僅群內/最近群，且 max_k 受 read 數/2 截斷，最小 k=2 強制至少分兩群
all_findings.description: min_k 被夾在 >=2（line 485），生產呼叫 find_optimal_clusters(...,2,min(6,N/2))（RegionProcessor line 1517-1518）。silhouette 對每個 i 掃全部 j 算 a_i（同群平均）與 b_i（最近其他群平均），實作本身對 a/b 定義是對的，但 (a) 強制 min_k=2 表示即使資料其實只有 1 個自然群，也一定回傳 >=2 群並宣告分群；(b) max_k=min(6,N/2) 的 N/2 上限與後面 min_cluster_size=max(3,N/20)（line 1540）是兩套不一致的群數/群大小約束。
all_findings.why_wrong: 工具核心命題是『判斷 reads 是否分成 >=2 個 methylation-defined 子群』。但 find_optimal_clusters 從不評估 k=1（無『不分群』選項），永遠輸出 >=2 群並計算 silhouette 選最佳，等於預設答案就是『有子群』。是否真有 >=2 子群的判定被推給下游顯著性檢定，但 n_clusters 欄與 cluster_labels 本身已內建 >=2 的偏差。silhouette 也沒有設『最低 silhouette 門檻』來否決弱分群。
all_findings.evidence: line 485 `if (min_k < 2) min_k = 2;` line 488 `double best_score = -2.0;`（任何 k>=2 的 silhouette 都會被接受，無下限門檻）；RegionProcessor line 1517 `find_optimal_clusters(tree, all_dist.dist_matrix, 2, std::min(6, (int)read_list.size()/2));`。
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: 每個有效 region 都被指派 >=2 群，n_clusters 永遠 >=2；『是否有子群結構』的真陽率被高估，需靠 PERMANOVA/Fisher 才能 down-weight。
all_findings.quantification_method: 統計 significance_summary.csv 中 n_clusters==1 的 region 數（預期為 0，證實永遠 >=2）；對照 cluster_permanova_p / global p 看多少 best_k>=2 的 region 其實未通過顯著性。
all_findings.fix_direction: 允許 k=1（評估 silhouette 無意義時的 null），或加最低平均 silhouette 門檻才宣告分群；明確區分『分群結果』與『分群是否顯著』，避免 n_clusters 內建 >=2 偏差。

all_findings.title: UPGMA merge_records 的 cluster_i/cluster_j 存的是被重用的矩陣 slot 索引，非 scipy 慣例的累積 cluster id — linkage_matrix.csv 語意錯誤
all_findings.description: build_upgma 採 in-place slot 重用（合併後把 merged 節點放回 slot min_i，line 136-137），但 MergeRecord 記 `record.cluster_i = min_i; record.cluster_j = min_j`（line 120-121）即原始 slot 索引。註解（line 65/98 之 build_generic 同欄）宣稱『similar to scipy linkage matrix』。scipy 的 linkage matrix 第 1/2 欄是『被合併的兩個 cluster 的累積 id』（單例為 0..N-1，第 m 次合併產生 id N+m），而非被重用的 slot。
all_findings.why_wrong: UPGMA 的 cluster_i/cluster_j 永遠是原始 0..N-1 的 row 索引（因 slot 重用），無法表達『合併產生的中間 cluster 又被合併』的層級關係，與 scipy 格式不等價。下游若有人把 linkage_matrix.csv 當 scipy 格式餵入（如 Python 重畫 dendrogram / fcluster）會得到錯誤拓樸。build_generic 路徑（single/complete/ward）反而是 push 新節點、cluster_i/j=當前 vector 索引，與 UPGMA 不一致，兩種 linkage 法輸出的 linkage_matrix.csv 語意不同。
all_findings.evidence: line 120-123 `record.cluster_i = min_i; record.cluster_j = min_j; record.distance = min_dist; record.new_cluster_id = next_node_id;` 配合 line 136 `nodes[min_i] = merged;`（slot 重用），對比 build_generic line 297-300 用成長中的 nodes 索引；TreeWriter.cpp line 83 直接輸出 record.cluster_i/cluster_j。
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: linkage_matrix.csv 不可被當 scipy linkage 直接使用；若有 Python 下游這樣用會畫錯/分錯群。對 C++ 內部 cut（用 Tree 結構非 merge_records）無影響，故標 LOW。
all_findings.quantification_method: 檢查是否有 scripts/*.py 讀 linkage_matrix.csv 餵 scipy.cluster.hierarchy（grep linkage_matrix）；若有則該分析受影響。
all_findings.fix_direction: 統一 merge_records 語意：UPGMA 與 build_generic 都記錄累積 cluster id（單例 0..N-1，合併產生 N+m），對齊 scipy；或在 linkage_matrix.csv 文件明示非 scipy 格式。

all_findings.title: SubcloneAnalyzer.assign_subclones 用固定 magic-number 閾值的硬規則分配，且 n_subclones 由 max(id)+1 推得會漏算空群並與固定 4 群命名表錯位
all_findings.description: assign_subclones 非真分群，而是用三個寫死閾值（LOH_HP_RATIO_THRESHOLD=0.1、HIGH_HP_ASM_THRESHOLD=0.05、HIGH_SAMPLE_ASM_THRESHOLD=0.1，line 16-18）的 if/else 把 region 硬分到固定 id {0,1,2,3}。analyze() 又用 `max_id = *max_element(assignments); n_subclones = max_id+1`（line 38-39）。
all_findings.why_wrong: (1) 閾值全寫死於 .cpp（與 expected_coverage=75 同類問題），未進 config；HIGH_HP_ASM_THRESHOLD=0.05 與全工具 Δβ 量級（memory 記載多數 region |Δβ|<0.10）相比偏低，會把大量 region 歸到 group 1。(2) n_subclones=max_id+1 的推法：若實際只出現 id {0,2,3}（無任何 high_hp_asm-only region），max_id=3 → n_subclones=4，compute_summaries 會建 4 群含一個空 group 1；反之若資料中最大用到的 id=2（無 group 3），n_subclones=3 但 group 命名表（write_report line 228-233）的索引 2 是 'LOH Regions'、索引 3 是 'Tumor-Specific' — id→名稱靠固定陣列，一旦中間 id 缺席，max_id+1 與語意名稱會對不上人類預期（group 數虛報或實際語意群數被低估）。(3) 註解（hpp line 100-105 / SubcloneAnalyzer.hpp）宣稱『Within each stratum, cluster by (hp_asm_delta, sample_asm_delta, hp_fine_f)』，但實作完全沒有任何 clustering，只是閾值 if/else — 名實不符。
all_findings.evidence: line 16-18 三個 static constexpr 閾值；line 112-124 純 if/else 指派固定 id 2/3/1/0；line 38 `int max_id = *std::max_element(assignments.begin(), assignments.end()); result.n_subclones = max_id + 1;`；SubcloneAnalyzer.hpp line 103 `3. Within each stratum, cluster by ...` 與實作不符。
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: 報告中『Number of subclone groups』可能因 id 稀疏而虛報（含空群）或語意群數低估；閾值寫死使結果不可調且對 Δβ 量級敏感。
all_findings.quantification_method: 對一個樣本跑 SubcloneAnalyzer，檢查 assignments 的 distinct id 集合與 n_subclones（看是否含空群 n_regions==0）；對 HIGH_HP_ASM_THRESHOLD 做敏感度掃描（0.05/0.10/0.15）看 group 1 region 數變化。
all_findings.fix_direction: 閾值移入 Config；n_subclones 改為實際非空群數或固定 4 並明確標空群；修正 hpp 註解（移除『cluster by』改為『threshold-based stratification』）；若真要 cluster 則接 HierarchicalClustering。

all_findings.title: clustering 整條 NG/silhouette/Ward 生產路徑無單元測試覆蓋，現有測試只測 trivial 4-leaf 完美分離 UPGMA
all_findings.description: 26 個測試中，WardMethod/CompleteLinkage/AllMethodsProduceTrees 只斷言『tree 非空、num_leaves 正確、root height>0』（line 195-209），完全不驗證 merge 順序或 linkage 值正確性。TreeCutter 測試只覆蓋 UPGMA 在完美分離 4x4（A-B、C-D 各距 2.0）的切割（line 264-302）。生產路徑核心 find_optimal_clusters（silhouette 選 k）完全沒有任何測試。
all_findings.why_wrong: CLUSTER-1（silhouette 丟單例）、CLUSTER-2（Ward 公式近似）、CLUSTER-3（cut_by_num 可能回 >k）這些影響 n_clusters 的 bug 都落在沒測試的程式碼上 → 既有測試把『能跑出樹』當成功，等於把潛在錯誤行為釘為 acceptable。WardMethod 測試尤其只證明『不 crash』，無法捕捉 line 215-220 的公式錯誤。
all_findings.evidence: line 191-197 `TEST_F(...WardMethod) { ... ASSERT_FALSE(tree.empty()); EXPECT_EQ(tree.num_leaves(), 6); }`（無 linkage 值驗證）；grep 確認 tests 內無 find_optimal_clusters / silhouette 字串。
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: 無；屬測試覆蓋缺口，不直接改數字，但使上述 bug 不被回歸捕捉。
all_findings.quantification_method: N/A（測試覆蓋類）。可加：對已知 silhouette 答案的小資料集驗 find_optimal_clusters 回傳 k；含單例情境驗 silhouette；Ward 對歐氏小資料比 scipy。
all_findings.fix_direction: 補 find_optimal_clusters 在『1 自然群』『含 outlier 單例』『3 等大群』情境的 k 期望值測試；Ward 與 scipy 對拍；cut_by_num_clusters 在 tie 高度回傳剛好 k 的測試。

verified_high.title: Silhouette 選 k 時靜默丟棄單例群（count_a==0），系統性偏好把離群 read 切成單例的較大 k
verified_high.description: find_optimal_clusters 用平均 silhouette 選最佳 k，是 RegionProcessor 生產路徑決定每個 region 分幾群（best_k → result.n_clusters，line 1517/1689）的唯一機制。但 silhouette 累加只在 `count_a > 0 && b_i < max` 時計入（line 533）。當某 read 是它所屬群的唯一成員時 count_a==0、a_i 留 0，該 read 被直接從 silhouette 平均剔除（valid_count 不加），而非依 scipy/sklearn 慣例賦 s=0。
verified_high.why_wrong: 剔除單例使「把離群 read 隔離成單例」的切法不付出 silhouette 代價：被隔離的點本應拿 s=0 拉低平均，但這裡完全不算，於是平均 silhouette 只由剩下的『乾淨』群決定 → 系統性偏好產生單例的較大 k。read-level 甲基化矩陣常有少數覆蓋差/MM-ML 缺值多的 outlier read，最容易被切成單例，導致 n_clusters 被高估、虛增『>=2 個 methylation-defined 子群』的判定。
verified_high.evidence: line 511 `if (count_a > 0) a_i /= count_a;` 之後 line 533 `if (count_a > 0 && b_i < std::numeric_limits<double>::max()) { double s_i = (b_i - a_i)/std::max(a_i,b_i); total_silhouette += s_i; valid_count++; }` — count_a==0 的單例既不貢獻 s 也不進 valid_count，等於從平均中消失。
verified_high.effect_hypothesis: best_k 偏大、區域被判為多子群的比例升高；對下游 PERMANOVA/Fisher 的 cluster_labels 與 n_clusters 欄位造成偏差。方向：高估 NG。
verified_high.quantification_method: 對全 region 輸出（significance_summary.csv / per-region significance.json 的 optimal_k 與 n_clusters 欄）統計含單例群的 region 比例；再以 scipy.cluster + sklearn.silhouette_samples（單例 s=0 慣例）對同一 distance_matrix_*.csv 重算 best_k，比較分佈差。檔案：各 Region 的 distance_matrix_[METRIC].csv + significance_summary.csv。
verified_high.fix_direction: 單例群依慣例賦 s_i=0 並計入 valid_count（valid_count 應為 n，不論 count_a）；或在 silhouette 選 k 前先以 min_cluster_size 過濾候選 k（目前 min_cluster_size 檢查在 line 1540 才做，且在 best_k 已選定之後）。

verdict.reasoning:
The bug as a code-level fact is real and verified. HierarchicalClustering.cpp:511 `if (count_a > 0) a_i /= count_a;` and :533 `if (count_a > 0 && b_i < numeric_limits::max())` together mean a read that is the sole member of its cluster (count_a==0) is dropped from BOTH total_silhouette and valid_count (line 540 `avg = total/valid_count`), instead of being assigned s_i=0 per scikit-learn/scipy convention. With agglomerative cutting (cut_by_num_clusters lines 431-475, which isolates last-merging outliers when k increases), singletons genuinely arise. Relative to the s=0 convention, dropping a singleton lets the remaining (typically positive) silhouettes dominate the average — so partitions that isolate an outlier into a singleton avoid the s=0 penalty that would pull the mean down. The directional reasoning ("bias toward larger k that produces singletons") is therefore technically sound. The production path is confirmed end-to-end: RegionProcessor.cpp:1517 calls find_optimal_clusters → :1689 result.n_clusters = best_k, and cluster_labels feeds GlobalTest contingency tables (GlobalTest.cpp:46-52 n_rows = n_clusters). No test covers this case (tests/test_hierarchical_clustering.cpp has no find_optimal_clusters/silhouette test).

HOWEVER the claimed severity (HIGH) and the claimed downstream consequence are overstated, for reasons I verified: (1) k is hard-capped at max_k = min(6, read_list.size()/2) (RegionProcessor.cpp:1518), so the "larger k" inflation is bounded (≤6, only ≥12 reads). (2) The load-bearing HP/allele discrimination is NOT silhouette-k-driven in the way claimed: GlobalTest crosses cluster_labels with full_labels and the Cochran reliability gate (GlobalTest.cpp:109-128, expected≥5) sets cramers_v_reliable=false when rows are sparse; RegionProcessor.cpp:1592-1596 then gates `CramersV = reliable ? v : 0`. A singleton-inflated k makes contingency rows SPARSER → reliability fails MORE → reported cramers_v is SUPPRESSED to 0, the opposite of the finding's claimed "虛增 ≥2 子群判定". (3) The actual methylation-subgroup discrimination analyses in research/tsg_promoter_asm_reviewer/scripts/ (≈20 scripts, e.g. 24/25/26/27/29/30/36/37/38) hardcode AgglomerativeClustering(n_clusters=2) and do not consume the C++ silhouette n_clusters at all, so the blast radius on "≥2 methylation-defined subgroups" judgments is far smaller than asserted. (4) Downstream unbalanced logic (RegionProcessor.cpp:1540-1566) only ever increases k, so it neither mitigates nor is itself the protection — it just shows the pipeline tolerates uneven clusters. Net: a genuine convention-deviation / untested-edge-case defect that biases reported n_clusters upward in a bounded way, but the asserted high-impact consequence (systematically inflating subgroup verdicts) is partly contradicted by the Cochran gate and decoupled from the actual discrimination scripts.

perReviewer.area: ASM — per-CpG ASM 與甲基化解析 (PerCpgAsm.cpp / MethylationParser.cpp / MatrixBuilder.cpp / NormalBaseline.cpp + RegionProcessor.cpp 的 signed Δβ 路徑)
perReviewer.notes:
兩項任務已知待確認的實測結論：(a) 'De Waele 2020' 誤引【已修】—— 現行 PerCpgAsm.cpp:6 已是 Orjuela 2020，git blame 證實由今日 commit 891e04b 修正（原 5b78f1a 為 De Waele）。記為 ASM-11(INFO)，建議再掃 docs/HTML 殘留。(b) 'Level1 5mC+5hmC 雙列計數使 Δβ 砍半'【在此 C++ binary 不成立，但發現相反問題】—— MethylationParser 只解析 'C+m?'，C+h?(5hmC) 機率從不被讀取（只用來跳 ml_offset），故此 binary 沒有雙列、沒有砍半，而是『5hmC 完全漏掉』，signed Δβ 是 5mC-only（ASM-3）。文件記載的 -0.054 雙列砍半 artifact 屬 MSA/Python 路徑，非此編譯產物。

最重要的兩條（建議主迴圈優先量化）：ASM-1（signed Δβ 用 cell-weighted pooled grand-mean 而非 per-CpG 等權平均，coverage 不均會偏甚至 Simpson 反轉）與 ASM-2（raw tumor/combined signed Δβ 走 HP1-family vs HP2-family ALLELE 軸、被 baseline allelic methylation confound；只有 hp_signed_residual = tumor-normal 才是 somatic-controlled）。兩者皆需用真實 significance_summary.csv + region methylation.csv 量化（指令/檔案見各 finding 的 quantification_method）。皆嚴禁在此填 effect 量級。

額外脈絡：論文 per-region Δβ 的真正來源是 RegionProcessor.cpp:987-1008 的 compute_signed_hp_delta（用 meth_mat.raw_matrix + tumor−normal 標量相減），不是 PerCpgAsm.cpp 的 per-CpG Fisher delta（後者算完即丟棄，ASM-8）。NormalBaseline 的 residual matrix API 為 dead code（ASM-10），somatic 控制只在 signed delta 層做標量相減（line 880-883 註解解釋 residual 對 distance 是 identity）。單元測試 test_per_cpg_asm.cpp:281-299 的 FullPipeline_MixedHP_Tags 用 assertion 把 '1-1→family0 / 2-1→family1' 的併入行為釘成 expected，等於把 ASM-2 的 allele-axis 合併行為當作正確規格固定（測試層面強化了該口徑風險）。本分區未涵蓋 SignificanceAnalyzer / DistanceMatrix / Bootstrap 的 PERMANOVA/label-test/ARI 細節（屬其他分區）。

all_findings.title: signed Δβ 用 cell-weighted pooled grand-mean 而非 per-CpG 平均，coverage 不均會 Simpson-paradox 偏移
all_findings.description: compute_signed_hp_delta (論文 tumor/normal/combined_hp_signed_delta 的真正來源) 把每個 (read,CpG) cell 的甲基化機率累加進 hp1_sum/hp2_sum，並除以 cell 數 (hp1_count/hp2_count 計的是 cell 不是 read)，回傳 (hp1_sum/hp1_count) - (hp2_sum/hp2_count)。這是『所有 cell 的 pooled grand mean 差』，不是『各 CpG 的 Δβ(CpG) 再對 CpG 平均』。HP1 與 HP2 是不同 reads、覆蓋不同 CpG 子集，coverage profile 不同 → pooled mean 會被高覆蓋 CpG 與覆蓋多 CpG 的 read 主導，把 per-CpG 甲基化差與 per-CpG 覆蓋不均混在一起。
all_findings.why_wrong: per-CpG ASM 的正確估計是 mean_over_CpG( mean_HP1(CpG) - mean_HP2(CpG) )（對 CpG 等權）。pooled cell mean 在各 CpG baseline 甲基化不同 + HP1/HP2 在各 CpG 覆蓋不同時，等於對 CpG 做 coverage-weighted 平均，方向可被 Simpson's paradox 反轉（與本 repo 既有 feedback_L2_collider_bias / pooled_ols_residualization_trap 同類陷阱）。
all_findings.evidence: for (int idx:indices){ int hp=hp_merged_labels[idx]; ... for(int j=0;j<cols;++j){ double val=raw_matrix(idx,j); if(isnan(val))continue; if(hp==0){hp1_sum+=val;++hp1_count;} else {hp2_sum+=val;++hp2_count;} } } ... return (hp1_sum/hp1_count)-(hp2_sum/hp2_count);  // hp1_count = #cells, 非 #reads, 非 #CpGs
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: 在 HP1/HP2 覆蓋的 CpG 集合差異大、或各 CpG baseline 甲基化異質的位點，signed Δβ 的量值（甚至方向）可能與 per-CpG-averaged Δβ 不一致；對覆蓋均勻、全 CpG 都被兩 HP 覆蓋的位點影響小。
all_findings.quantification_method: 對同一批位點，從 methylation.csv / raw_matrix 重算兩種口徑：(A) 現行 pooled cell mean 差；(B) per-CpG Δβ(CpG)=mean_HP1-mean_HP2 後對 CpG 等權平均（只取兩 HP 都有覆蓋的 CpG）。比較 BRCA2/ZAR1L 等 canonical 位點與全基因組 strong-ASM 集的 |A-B| 分佈與 sign-flip 比例。資料：significance_summary.csv 的 tumor_hp_signed_delta 欄 + 各 region methylation.csv。
all_findings.fix_direction: 改成兩段式：先對每個 CpG 算 mean_HP1(CpG)、mean_HP2(CpG)（各需 >=min_reads 覆蓋），再對有效 CpG 取等權平均得 Δβ；或同時輸出兩口徑供 confound 對照。

all_findings.title: signed Δβ 與 per-CpG Fisher 走 HP1-family vs HP2-family（ALLELE/germline 軸），非 somatic-controlled HP-axis；'1-1'/'2-1' 被併入母 family
all_findings.description: hp_merged_labels 與 PerCpgAsm 的 hp_labels 都把 {"1","HP1","1-1"}→family0、{"2","HP2","2-1"}→family1。因此 tumor_hp_signed_delta / per-CpG Fisher 量的是 HP1-family vs HP2-family = germline-haplotype/ALLELE 軸，把 somatic 子單倍型 '1-1' 併入 '1'。專案自己的 memory(feedback_asm_allele_axis_baseline_confound) 已定案 ALLELE/HP1-vs-HP2 軸被 baseline allelic/imprinted 甲基化 confound、非 somatic-specific。
all_findings.why_wrong: 文件/論文把 per-region signed Δβ 描述為 'HP-axis (HP1 vs HP1-1, somatic-controlled)'，但程式算的是 HP1-vs-HP2(family) raw delta；唯一 somatic-controlled 的量是 hp_signed_residual = tumor_signed_delta - normal_signed_delta（line 1021）。若報告/HTML 直接引用 tumor_hp_signed_delta 或 combined_hp_signed_delta 當 'somatic ASM Δβ'，即把 confounded 的 allele-axis 值當 somatic 量。
all_findings.evidence: if (hp=="1"||hp=="HP1"||hp=="1-1") hp_merged_labels[i]=0; else if (hp=="2"||hp=="HP2"||hp=="2-1") hp_merged_labels[i]=1;  // '1-1' 併入 family0；signed delta 與 Fisher 皆用此 label
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: raw tumor/combined signed Δβ 攜帶 germline allelic methylation baseline，方向/量值不等於 somatic 殘差；只有 hp_signed_residual 排除了 normal baseline。
all_findings.quantification_method: 對 canonical 位點同時讀 significance_summary.csv 的 tumor_hp_signed_delta、normal_hp_signed_delta、hp_signed_residual，比較三者方向與量值；並對 germline-het null（normal 也有 HP 差的位點集）檢查 raw delta 與 residual 的差距，對齊 memory 中 het null 15.2% vs HP-axis residual 7.2% 的口徑。
all_findings.fix_direction: 報告引用 ASM Δβ 一律用 hp_signed_residual（somatic-controlled）而非 raw tumor/combined signed delta；或新增真正的 fine-axis（HP1 vs HP1-1 in-tumor）計算，不要把 '1-1' 併進 '1'。對外口徑明確標 '此軸 = HP1-family vs HP2-family, 含 germline ASM baseline'。

all_findings.title: 5hmC 完全未解析（parser 只抓 C+m?），signed Δβ 是 5mC-only 非 max-collapse(any-mod)
all_findings.description: parse_read 只把 block 比對 "C+m?"（line 60-63 target="C+m?"; line 66 parse_mm_tag(...,"C+m?")），C+h?(5hmC) block 只被用來累加 ml_offset 跳過、其機率從不被讀取。下游 raw_matrix 因此只含 5mC 機率，compute_signed_hp_delta 的 Δβ 與 per-CpG Fisher 都是 5mC-only。文件期望的是 '5mC/5hmC max-collapse any-mod'。
all_findings.why_wrong: 在 5hmC 比例不可忽略的位點（gene body / 某些調控區），把 P(5mC) 當 'modified probability' 會系統性低估該位點的甲基化（漏掉 5hmC 那部分修飾），且若 HP1/HP2 的 5hmC 分佈不同，Δβ 會偏。注意：這與 claim(b) 描述的『5mC+5hmC 雙列重複計數使 Δβ 砍半』相反 —— 此 C++ binary 沒有雙列、沒有砍半，而是『漏掉 5hmC』。文件記載的 -0.054 雙列砍半 artifact 屬 MSA/Python 路徑非此 binary。
all_findings.evidence: const char* target="C+m?"; ... bool is_target = (block_end-block_start>=4) && memcmp(block_start,target,4)==0; if(is_target){deltas=parse_mm_tag(mm_str,"C+m?"); ...} else { /* 只累加 ml_offset 跳過 C+h? 機率，從不讀取 */ }
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: 在 5hmC 富集位點甲基化被低估、Δβ 可能偏（方向視 HP1/HP2 5hmC 不對稱）；在 5hmC≈0 的位點無影響。
all_findings.quantification_method: 從原始 BAM 對 canonical 位點抽 C+h? 的 ML 機率分佈，計算 max(P5mC,P5hmC) 與 P5mC-only 在 read×CpG 的差，重算 Δβ 比較。資料：tagged BAM 的 MM/ML tag（如 HCC1395 *5mCG_5hmCG_tagged.bam）。
all_findings.fix_direction: parse_read 同時解析 C+h? block 的 ML，per-base 取 max(P5mC,P5hmC)（any-mod max-collapse）再寫進 raw_matrix；或明確在文件/欄位名標註此 binary 為 5mC-only 並評估是否需重跑。

all_findings.title: per-CpG Fisher 二值化用 raw>0.5 硬切，與 binary_matrix 的 0.2/0.8(中間=missing) 口徑不一致
all_findings.description: PerCpgAsm 的 per-CpG Fisher 用 raw_matrix(idx,j)>0.5 把每個覆蓋 cell 二分 meth/unmeth（無模糊區，prob=0.4 算 unmeth、0.6 算 meth）。但同一份矩陣的 binary_matrix（餵 NME / epipoly / distance）用 >=0.8 為 1、<=0.2 為 0、中間 (0.2,0.8) → -1(missing)。兩種二值化規則並存於同一分析。
all_findings.why_wrong: Fisher 與 NME/epipoly 對『同一個 CpG 的同一條 read』可能給出不同的 call（Fisher 把 0.3 當 unmeth 進 2x2，NME 把它當 missing 丟掉），導致 Fisher 的 n_tested 與 NME/epipoly 的 valid CpG 集合不一致、且 Fisher 把低信心 ONT call 全當確定 call 進檢定（不尊重 ONT 機率的不確定性，p 值偏樂觀）。
all_findings.evidence: // Fisher: if (val > 0.5) hp1_meth++; else hp1_unmeth++;   vs   // binary_matrix: if(val>=high)1; else if(val<=low)0; else -1(Ambiguous)
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: 在 ONT 機率多落在 0.2-0.8 中間帶的位點，Fisher frac_sig 可能偏高（強行二分增加 contrast）；對機率多在 0/1 兩端的位點無差。
all_findings.quantification_method: 對若干 region 統計 raw_matrix 在 (0.2,0.8) 中間帶的 cell 比例，並比較用 >0.5 vs 用 binary_matrix(0/1，丟 ambiguous) 重算 per-CpG 2x2 的 frac_sig 差。資料：region methylation.csv。
all_findings.fix_direction: Fisher 與 NME/epipoly 用同一套二值化（建議用 binary_matrix 的 0/1 並丟 ambiguous，或對 0.2-0.8 cell 一致處理）；或在 Fisher 也套用 ambiguous-exclusion 與 confidence 過濾。

all_findings.title: per-CpG Fisher frac_sig / BH-FDR 把空間自相關的 CpG 當獨立檢定，p 與 frac_sig 偏樂觀
all_findings.description: per-CpG Fisher 對每個 CpG 獨立跑 2x2，再用 bh_fdr_correction 跨 CpG 校正，輸出 fisher_n_sig / frac_sig。單一 CpG 的 2x2 內 reads 是獨立的（OK），但相鄰 CpG 的甲基化高度空間自相關（同一條 read 跨 CpG 共享、CpG 間 LD-like 相關），BH-FDR 假設獨立或 PRDS，read 間/CpG 間相依未處理。
all_findings.why_wrong: CpG 間正相關使有效檢定數 << n_tested，BH 以 m=n_tested 當分母會（在正相關下）偏保守於 family-wise 但 frac_sig 作為『顯著 CpG 比例』仍把相關訊號當獨立計數，誇大 region 的 ASM 證據量；且把 region 當 n_tested 個獨立 CpG 報 frac_sig 會讓 high-coverage/long-region 位點系統性看起來更顯著。
all_findings.evidence: for(int j=0;j<n_cpgs;++j){ ... FisherResult fr=fisher.test_2x2(table); raw_pvalues[j]=fr.p_value; ...} std::vector<double> fdr=bh_fdr_correction(raw_pvalues); for(...) if(fdr[j]<0.05) n_sig++; result.fisher_frac_sig = n_sig/n_tested;  // CpG 視為獨立
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: frac_sig 與 max_neg_log_fdr 對 region 級 ASM 證據量偏樂觀，且與 CpG 數/覆蓋共變（confound region length）；不影響單一 CpG 內的 read 獨立性。
all_findings.quantification_method: 對代表性位點以 read-level permutation（打亂 HP label 重算整 region 的 frac_sig 建 null）檢驗 observed frac_sig 是否超出 null；比較 frac_sig 與 n_tested/coverage 的相關。資料：region methylation.csv + read HP label。
all_findings.fix_direction: region 級顯著性改用尊重相依的 null（HP-label permutation 或 block-permutation），不要直接把 BH frac_sig 當獨立證據量；或在報告標註 frac_sig 為 within-region 描述量、跨位點比較需 permutation 校正。

all_findings.title: normal 'overall_mean' 為 per-CpG-mean 等權平均，而 signed Δβ 為 cell-weighted，兩者 'mean methylation' 口徑不一致
all_findings.description: build_normal_baseline 的 overall_mean = mean of per_cpg_mean（對 CpG 等權，line 76），而 compute_signed_hp_delta 的 HP mean 是 cell-weighted pooled（ASM-1）。normal_baseline_mean(等權-CpG) 與 normal_hp_signed_delta(cell-weighted) 是不同口徑的 mean，並列於同一 summary 易誤讀。
all_findings.why_wrong: 同一報告中『normal 甲基化均值』與『HP signed delta』採不同加權，跨欄比較/相減（如人工推導）會引入口徑不一致的偏差；雖 hp_signed_residual 內部 tumor/normal 用同一函式所以自洽。
all_findings.evidence: NormalBaseline: baseline.overall_mean = total_mean_sum / valid_cpg_count;  // 對 CpG 等權  vs  compute_signed_hp_delta: (hp1_sum/hp1_count) // cell-weighted
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: 僅在覆蓋高度不均時兩口徑數值不同；不影響 hp_signed_residual 自洽性。
all_findings.quantification_method: 對若干位點比較 overall_mean(等權-CpG) 與 cell-weighted grand mean，量化差距。資料：region methylation.csv。
all_findings.fix_direction: 統一全 pipeline 的 'mean methylation' 加權（建議全部 per-CpG 等權）；或在欄位文件明標各欄加權方式。

all_findings.title: min_reads_per_group 預設 5（hpp）vs 呼叫端硬寫 5，且 Fisher 的 per-CpG 有效樣本可遠低於此（hp_total>=1 即測）
all_findings.description: group 級門檻 min_reads_per_group=5 是『整個 HP family 的 read 數』，但 per-CpG Fisher 只要該 CpG 兩 family 各 >=1 條覆蓋(hp1_total>=1 && hp2_total>=1, line 295)就跑 2x2。因此可能在 1-vs-1、2-vs-1 的極稀疏 2x2 上跑 Fisher 並計入 frac_sig，這類表 power≈0、p 受 zero-cell 主導。
all_findings.why_wrong: per-CpG 有效覆蓋與 group-level 門檻脫鉤：group 有 5 條 read 不代表每個 CpG 都有 >=N 條覆蓋。稀疏 2x2(如 a=1,b=0,c=0,d=1)雖 Fisher 仍給合法 p，但這些 CpG 進入 n_tested 與 frac_sig 分母/分子會稀釋或扭曲 region 級指標。
all_findings.evidence: if (hp1_total < 1 || hp2_total < 1) continue;  // 每 CpG 只要各 >=1 就測，與 group 級 min_reads_per_group=5 脫鉤
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: 在低覆蓋 CpG 多的位點，n_tested 含大量近-零-power 的稀疏表，frac_sig 的分母被稀釋（多半 p~1）使 frac_sig 偏低，或個別 zero-cell 表貢獻 false 顯著；視覆蓋分佈而定。
all_findings.quantification_method: 統計 per-CpG 的 (hp1_total,hp2_total) 分佈，看多少 tested CpG 的 min(total)<3/<5，並比較加 per-CpG 覆蓋門檻後 frac_sig 變化。資料：region methylation.csv。
all_findings.fix_direction: per-CpG Fisher 加 per-CpG 最小覆蓋門檻（如兩 family 各 >=3 或 >=5 才計入 n_tested）；或把 min_reads_per_group 提為可配置常數而非呼叫端硬寫 5。

all_findings.title: PerCpgAsm 算出的 per-CpG signed delta 計算後即丟棄，未匯出（result 無 Δβ 欄）
all_findings.description: compute_per_cpg_asm 在 line 307-310 算了 deltas[j]=hp1_frac-hp2_frac（per-CpG 二項比例差），但 PerCpgAsmResult 沒有任何 delta 欄位，deltas[] 出函式即銷毀。只匯出 n_sig/frac_sig/max_neg_log_fdr/NME/epipoly。論文 Δβ 因此並非來自此函式（而是 RegionProcessor 的 compute_signed_hp_delta，口徑不同，見 ASM-1）。
all_findings.why_wrong: 易誤以為『per-CpG Fisher 的 Δβ』有被使用；實際被丟棄。兩個不同的 Δβ 定義（此處 binary 比例差 vs RegionProcessor 的 raw 機率均值差）並存且只用後者，增加口徑混淆風險。
all_findings.evidence: deltas[j] = hp1_frac - hp2_frac; n_tested++;  // deltas 為 local，PerCpgAsmResult 無對應欄位 → 函式結束即丟
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: 無數值影響（dead computation）；僅口徑/可追溯性風險。
all_findings.quantification_method: N/A（靜態事實）。
all_findings.fix_direction: 若需要 per-CpG Fisher 的方向，匯出該 delta；否則移除 dead 計算並在文件釐清唯一 Δβ 來源 = compute_signed_hp_delta。

all_findings.title: MethylationParser 只支援 'C+m?'(? 模式) tag，'.'/隱式模式或無 ? 旗標的 MM 會靜默回空
all_findings.description: target 寫死 "C+m?"，memcmp 4 bytes 完全比對。SAM MM 規格允許 'C+m'(隱式)、'C+m.'(. 模式) 等變體；非 'C+m?' 的 read 會 found_target=false → 回空 calls，該 read 在矩陣全 missing，不會報錯。
all_findings.why_wrong: 若某些樣本/工具版本（非 dorado ?-mode）輸出 'C+m' 或 'C+m.'，這些 read 的甲基化被靜默丟棄，造成覆蓋下降且無告警；HP1/HP2 若 tag 模式不同則 Δβ 偏。多數 dorado/modkit 現用 ?-mode 故影響有限。
all_findings.evidence: const char* target = "C+m?"; const size_t tlen = 4; bool is_target = (block_end-block_start>=tlen) && memcmp(block_start,target,tlen)==0;
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: 在非 ?-mode BAM 上整批 read 無甲基化 → matrix 空；在 ?-mode BAM（本專案主用）上無影響。
all_findings.quantification_method: 對輸入 BAM 抽 MM tag 前綴統計 'C+m?' vs 'C+m' vs 'C+m.' 比例（samtools view + 抽 MM:Z），確認皆為 ?-mode。資料：tagged BAM。
all_findings.fix_direction: 放寬比對為 'C+m' 前綴並接受 ?/./空旗標；或在 parse 失敗（有 MM tag 但無 C+m? block）時計數告警以便偵測模式不符。

all_findings.title: compute_residual_matrix 與 is_cpg_site 為 dead code（已被 tumor-normal 減法/inline 取代）
all_findings.description: NormalBaseline.cpp 的 compute_residual_matrix 在 RegionProcessor 從未被呼叫（line 880-883 註解明言 residual 減法對 distance 是 identity 不可行，改用 tumor_delta - normal_delta）。MethylationParser::is_cpg_site 也未被呼叫（CpG 檢查在 line 139/178 手動 inline）。
all_findings.why_wrong: 非錯誤，但留著的 residual API 易誤導讀者以為 per-CpG ASM 走 normal-residualized matrix；實際只在 signed delta 層做 tumor-normal 標量相減。
all_findings.evidence: grep compute_residual_matrix src/core/RegionProcessor.cpp → 0 命中；grep is_cpg_site → 只有定義行與 'Simple is_cpg_site inline' 註解
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: 無數值影響。

verified_high.title: signed Δβ 用 cell-weighted pooled grand-mean 而非 per-CpG 平均，coverage 不均會 Simpson-paradox 偏移
verified_high.description: compute_signed_hp_delta (論文 tumor/normal/combined_hp_signed_delta 的真正來源) 把每個 (read,CpG) cell 的甲基化機率累加進 hp1_sum/hp2_sum，並除以 cell 數 (hp1_count/hp2_count 計的是 cell 不是 read)，回傳 (hp1_sum/hp1_count) - (hp2_sum/hp2_count)。這是『所有 cell 的 pooled grand mean 差』，不是『各 CpG 的 Δβ(CpG) 再對 CpG 平均』。HP1 與 HP2 是不同 reads、覆蓋不同 CpG 子集，coverage profile 不同 → pooled mean 會被高覆蓋 CpG 與覆蓋多 CpG 的 read 主導，把 per-CpG 甲基化差與 per-CpG 覆蓋不均混在一起。
verified_high.why_wrong: per-CpG ASM 的正確估計是 mean_over_CpG( mean_HP1(CpG) - mean_HP2(CpG) )（對 CpG 等權）。pooled cell mean 在各 CpG baseline 甲基化不同 + HP1/HP2 在各 CpG 覆蓋不同時，等於對 CpG 做 coverage-weighted 平均，方向可被 Simpson's paradox 反轉（與本 repo 既有 feedback_L2_collider_bias / pooled_ols_residualization_trap 同類陷阱）。
verified_high.evidence: for (int idx:indices){ int hp=hp_merged_labels[idx]; ... for(int j=0;j<cols;++j){ double val=raw_matrix(idx,j); if(isnan(val))continue; if(hp==0){hp1_sum+=val;++hp1_count;} else {hp2_sum+=val;++hp2_count;} } } ... return (hp1_sum/hp1_count)-(hp2_sum/hp2_count);  // hp1_count = #cells, 非 #reads, 非 #CpGs
verified_high.effect_hypothesis: 在 HP1/HP2 覆蓋的 CpG 集合差異大、或各 CpG baseline 甲基化異質的位點，signed Δβ 的量值（甚至方向）可能與 per-CpG-averaged Δβ 不一致；對覆蓋均勻、全 CpG 都被兩 HP 覆蓋的位點影響小。
verified_high.quantification_method: 對同一批位點，從 methylation.csv / raw_matrix 重算兩種口徑：(A) 現行 pooled cell mean 差；(B) per-CpG Δβ(CpG)=mean_HP1-mean_HP2 後對 CpG 等權平均（只取兩 HP 都有覆蓋的 CpG）。比較 BRCA2/ZAR1L 等 canonical 位點與全基因組 strong-ASM 集的 |A-B| 分佈與 sign-flip 比例。資料：significance_summary.csv 的 tumor_hp_signed_delta 欄 + 各 region methylation.csv。
verified_high.fix_direction: 改成兩段式：先對每個 CpG 算 mean_HP1(CpG)、mean_HP2(CpG)（各需 >=min_reads 覆蓋），再對有效 CpG 取等權平均得 Δβ；或同時輸出兩口徑供 confound 對照。

verdict.reasoning:
The finding has a CORRECT math observation but a FALSE provenance/impact claim, so its load-bearing severity premise is refuted.

VERIFIED AS CORRECT (the mechanical claim): RegionProcessor.cpp:987-1006 — compute_signed_hp_delta does accumulate every non-NaN (read,CpG) cell into hp1_sum/hp2_sum, increments hp1_count/hp2_count per CELL (lines 997-1001), and returns (hp1_sum/hp1_count)-(hp2_sum/hp2_count) (line 1006). I confirmed raw_matrix is read×CpG with NaN for no-coverage (build_methylation_matrix:1408-1423, val<0 → NAN), so HP1 vs HP2 reads genuinely cover different CpG subsets at different depths → this is a coverage-weighted pooled grand-mean, structurally Simpson-vulnerable, not the CpG-equal-weight estimator mean_over_CpG(frac_HP1−frac_HP2). The correct per-CpG estimator demonstrably EXISTS separately in PerCpgAsm.cpp:274-313 (deltas[j]=hp1_frac−hp2_frac per CpG), proving the codebase already knows the right way. So as a code/methodology nit on this field, the finding is accurate.

REFUTED (the impact claim — 'true source of the paper's tumor/normal/combined_hp_signed_delta Δβ', claimed HIGH): The paper's headline ASM Δβ does NOT come from this C++ field. Memory project_zar1l_brca2_asm_verification documents the official BRCA2 Δβ=−0.122 (n=197 CpG, p=6.62e-10) as derived from the MSA Level-1 + Python per-CpG pipeline, verified against asm_dualaxis_tp.tsv / script03. That pipeline (research/tsg_promoter_asm_reviewer/scripts/48_perpos_reanalysis.py:120-141) builds hp_signed_delta_largest from per-CpG MSA records' mean_delta over n_paired_cpg CpGs — i.e. the CpG-equal-weight approach the finding endorses, feeding master_perpos.tsv and all H2/H3/CN-confound analyses (scripts 30/31/43). Critically, the C++-specific column names combined_hp_signed_delta / tumor_hp_signed_delta / hp_signed_residual are grep-ABSENT from every paper ASM-reviewer script and the method_comparison docs (confirmed empty grep). The C++ field is a secondary CSV diagnostic column (RegionProcessor.cpp:1242-1246, labeled 'Signed HP methylation delta (direction-aware)') not wired into any published Δβ.

NET: real but minor code-quality imperfection in an unused-by-paper diagnostic field. The math is right; the 'true source of paper Δβ' premise that justifies HIGH is wrong. UNCERTAIN rather than REFUTED because the code defect itself is genuine and could mislead if this column is ever adopted — but its current published-result impact is effectively nil.

verified_high.title: signed Δβ 與 per-CpG Fisher 走 HP1-family vs HP2-family（ALLELE/germline 軸），非 somatic-controlled HP-axis；'1-1'/'2-1' 被併入母 family
verified_high.description: hp_merged_labels 與 PerCpgAsm 的 hp_labels 都把 {"1","HP1","1-1"}→family0、{"2","HP2","2-1"}→family1。因此 tumor_hp_signed_delta / per-CpG Fisher 量的是 HP1-family vs HP2-family = germline-haplotype/ALLELE 軸，把 somatic 子單倍型 '1-1' 併入 '1'。專案自己的 memory(feedback_asm_allele_axis_baseline_confound) 已定案 ALLELE/HP1-vs-HP2 軸被 baseline allelic/imprinted 甲基化 confound、非 somatic-specific。
verified_high.why_wrong: 文件/論文把 per-region signed Δβ 描述為 'HP-axis (HP1 vs HP1-1, somatic-controlled)'，但程式算的是 HP1-vs-HP2(family) raw delta；唯一 somatic-controlled 的量是 hp_signed_residual = tumor_signed_delta - normal_signed_delta（line 1021）。若報告/HTML 直接引用 tumor_hp_signed_delta 或 combined_hp_signed_delta 當 'somatic ASM Δβ'，即把 confounded 的 allele-axis 值當 somatic 量。
verified_high.evidence: if (hp=="1"||hp=="HP1"||hp=="1-1") hp_merged_labels[i]=0; else if (hp=="2"||hp=="HP2"||hp=="2-1") hp_merged_labels[i]=1;  // '1-1' 併入 family0；signed delta 與 Fisher 皆用此 label
verified_high.effect_hypothesis: raw tumor/combined signed Δβ 攜帶 germline allelic methylation baseline，方向/量值不等於 somatic 殘差；只有 hp_signed_residual 排除了 normal baseline。
verified_high.quantification_method: 對 canonical 位點同時讀 significance_summary.csv 的 tumor_hp_signed_delta、normal_hp_signed_delta、hp_signed_residual，比較三者方向與量值；並對 germline-het null（normal 也有 HP 差的位點集）檢查 raw delta 與 residual 的差距，對齊 memory 中 het null 15.2% vs HP-axis residual 7.2% 的口徑。
verified_high.fix_direction: 報告引用 ASM Δβ 一律用 hp_signed_residual（somatic-controlled）而非 raw tumor/combined signed delta；或新增真正的 fine-axis（HP1 vs HP1-1 in-tumor）計算，不要把 '1-1' 併進 '1'。對外口徑明確標 '此軸 = HP1-family vs HP2-family, 含 germline ASM baseline'。

verdict.reasoning:
FACTUAL CORE CONFIRMED, BUG FRAMING/SEVERITY OVERSTATED.

Verified the merge code verbatim. RegionProcessor.cpp:903-906 maps {"1","HP1","1-1"}->0 and {"2","HP2","2-1"}->1; PerCpgAsm.cpp:244-249 does the identical merge into hp1_indices/hp2_indices. Consequently the C++ per-CpG Fisher (PerCpgAsm.cpp:279-310, delta = hp1_frac - hp2_frac over the families) and compute_signed_hp_delta (RegionProcessor.cpp:987-1010, feeding tumor_hp_signed_delta/normal_hp_signed_delta/combined_hp_signed_delta) all measure HP1-family vs HP2-family = the germline/ALLELE axis, with '1-1' folded into '1'. The finding's evidence line is literally correct.

But it is NOT a code bug, and the headline somatic number is not contaminated:

1) The C++ fields are NAMED EXACTLY what they compute. include/core/RegionProcessor.hpp:93-97 documents hp_merged_delta as "(HP1+HP1-1) vs (HP2+HP2-1)" and the count fields as "HP1-family"; the CSV header (RegionProcessor.cpp:1084,1108-1109) emits HP1FamilyN/HPMergedDelta/Tumor_HP_Signed_Delta. The genuine somatic-controlled HP1-vs-HP1-1 quantity is exported SEPARATELY as the fine-grained distances hp_fine_d_hp1_hp1s (RegionProcessor.hpp:109, CSV "HPFineD_HP1_HP1S"). So nothing in the code mislabels the family-merge as "HP1 vs HP1-1".

2) Within the residual path, the merge is acceptable: hp_signed_residual = tumor_signed - normal_signed (line 1021) subtracts the germline-allelic baseline, which is exactly the somatic-controlled quantity (the finding itself concedes this).

3) The actual load-bearing headline (BRCA2 promoter HP-axis Delta-beta=-0.122 with cis residual d_within=-0.023, perm p=0.022) was NOT produced by the confounded C++ family path. It comes from research/tsg_promoter_asm_reviewer/scripts/34_control_loci_cohesion_cistest.py:108-127, whose cis_test() uses A=normal HP1 {"1"}, B=tumor HP1 {"1"}, C=tumor HP1-1 {"1-1"} and computes d_somatic_C_minus_B / d_cis / d_drift — a true HP1-vs-HP1-1 three-way comparison that never merges 1-1. So the published somatic Delta-beta is clean.

WHERE THE FINDING HAS REAL MERIT (the salvageable part): the RESEARCH DOCS over-generalize. docs/method_comparison/.../01_ism_method_spec_from_source.md is internally contradictory — line 50-51 correctly says "HP1-family = 1 + 1-1 -> group 0", yet line 89 claims "HP-axis = HP1 vs HP1-1 (somatic-controlled)"; 03_method_comparison_matrix.md:40 and 06_benchmark_plan_phaseB.md:66 brand ISM's HP-axis as "HP1 vs HP1-1 somatic-controlled" as a blanket claim. Because the C++ per-CpG Fisher and signed-delta ALSO carry the "HP-axis" name but compute the family/ALLELE axis (which the project's own memory feedback_asm_allele_axis_baseline_confound flags as baseline-allelic/imprinting confounded), any FUTURE report that cites Tumor_HP_Signed_Delta / HPMergedDelta / the C++ per-CpG Fisher as the "somatic-controlled HP-axis" would conflate the confounded allele axis with the somatic axis. That is a genuine labeling/conflation hazard worth a doc-level note — but it is conditional ("if reports directly cite..."), the existing headline does not trip it, and the code is correctly named. Hence UNCERTAIN (real underlying observation, but mischaracterized as a HIGH code bug) and severity reduced to MEDIUM.

perReviewer.area: REGION — RegionProcessor orchestration layer (gating + CramersV reliability gate + feature aggregation + coverage normalization)
perReviewer.notes:
已查核項目與結論：

1) expected_coverage hardcode 75.0：確認 compute_coverage_multiple 預設參數 75.0（hpp:522）+ Pass-1 result.diploid_coverage_used=75.0（cpp:1695）。**但這非 bug**：兩段式設計下 Pass 2（cpp:678-705）會用 KDE mode（estimate_diploid_coverage, cpp:78-162）或 user --expected-coverage 覆寫成 per-sample 值。test_diploid_coverage.cpp:70-118 證實 KDE 真有啟用且能正確估 ~75x/90x 樣本不誤判 fallback。task brief 的『KDE未啟用/全樣本共用 default』疑慮在現行碼**不成立**——僅在 <100 有效 region 時 fallback 75.0（有 LOG_WARN）。故未列為 finding，僅記錄已澄清。memory project_expected_coverage_baseline_bug 描述的舊狀態似已修復。

2) 核心確認：CramersV 口徑分裂為**真實 latent 問題**（REGION-1，與 memory project_asm_locus_display_and_cramersv_reliability_gate 完全吻合）：result.cramers_v 取 reliable-gated max（cpp:1592-1596），寫進 CSV + 驅動 is_significant；significance.json 卻寫 raw（cpp:1732-1752）。下游讀不同檔得不同 V，造成 762 MISSED 中 487 latent 的位點數分歧。

3) passed_gate 用 raw V（GlobalTest.cpp:141），is_significant 又疊 gated V（cpp:1145）→ 同布林兩口徑（REGION-2）。

4) global_p = min(p_alt,p_hp,p_hp_family) 未做 multiple-testing 校正（REGION-3）；全基因組層 is_significant 用 raw 0.05 無 FDR。

5) signed HP delta 以 cell grand-mean 而非 per-CpG-paired，CpG-composition 可 confound（REGION-5）。

6) normal unphased reads 併入 cluster-first 距離矩陣與全域檢定，塑形叢集 + 改列聯表邊際（REGION-6，需 rerun 量化）。

未列為 finding 的查核：unbalanced-cluster 邏輯（列 REGION-7 LOW）、compute_hp_ratio epsilon（列 REGION-8 LOW）。test_diploid_coverage.cpp 未把 bug 釘成 expected（測試合理）。

跨分區交叉引用（非本區職責，供 STATS/CLUSTER reviewer）：GlobalTest::apply_gating 的 v_pass 用 raw cramers_v；MathUtils::cramers_v 的 reliable=low_expected_ratio<=0.2（Cochran 變體，非嚴格『最小期望格>=5』全格）；列聯表把每條 read 當獨立觀測（over-dispersion / read 內 CpG 相依 + read 間相依未處理）——Fisher/chi-square p 會低估，此屬 STATS 分區但會與本區 global_p/CramersV 口徑交互。

all_findings.title: CramersV 口徑分裂：significance.json 寫原始值、summary CSV / is_significant 用 reliability-gated 值（同一位點兩個 V）
all_findings.description: result.cramers_v 取 reliable-gated 的三維 max：`v_alt = global_alt.cramers_v_reliable ? cramers_v : 0.0`（同樣 hp、hp_family），再 std::max。此 gated 值寫進 significance_summary.csv 的 CramersV 欄（line 1159）並驅動 is_significant（line 1145 `r.cramers_v >= 0.1`）。但同一位點的 per-region significance.json（line 1732/1738/1744/1752）寫的是 **未 gate 的原始 sig_result.global_alt.cramers_v**。所以稀疏列聯表（Cochran low-expected-ratio>0.2，MathUtils.cpp:200）位點在 CSV 得 CV=0、在 significance.json 得原始（可能 0.4+）。下游不同腳本讀不同檔 → 同位點兩個答案。
all_findings.why_wrong: 同一統計量在兩個輸出檔有不同口徑，且無欄位標示哪個是 gated。讀 significance.json 的腳本會把 Cochran-unreliable 的高 CramersV 當真值（稀疏表的 CramersV 本就被高估），讀 CSV 的腳本會把同位點當 CV=0。memory project_asm_locus_display_and_cramersv_reliability_gate 已記錄『summary CramersV=reliable?v:0 vs significance.json 原始值，稀疏表差很大』『762 MISSED 中 487 latent gated CV=0 但 PERMANOVA 顯著』——正是此口徑差造成的位點數分歧。
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: 稀疏列聯表位點（小 N 或極不平衡 HP/allele 分組）在 CSV 被歸 CV=0 而非顯著，significance.json 卻保留高 raw V；兩檔位點計數不一致，characterization 統計（如 strong-ASM 位點數、reliable 顯著率）依讀哪個檔而異。
all_findings.quantification_method: 對某樣本 output：join significance_summary.csv 的 CramersV 與各 region significance.json 的 global_*.cramers_v（同 anchor_key），統計 (a) CSV CramersV==0 但 json raw>=0.1 的位點數，(b) 這些位點 PERMANOVA p<=0.05 的比例。用 scripts/ 既有 88_*.py 的 gate 邏輯比對。需真實 output 目錄。
all_findings.fix_direction: 二選一統一口徑：(A) significance.json 也寫 gated 值 + 額外加 `cramers_v_reliable` 旗標欄，讓下游自行決定；(B) 兩處都寫 raw V + 並列 reliable 旗標，is_significant 改用 `(raw_V>=0.1 && reliable)`。最小修正＝在 significance.json 每個 global_* 區塊加 `"cramers_v_reliable": bool`，並在 CSV 加同名欄，消除歧義。

all_findings.title: passed_gating 用『原始 CramersV』判 gate，但 is_significant 又疊加『gated CramersV>=0.1』→ 兩個 CramersV 口徑在同一布林式裡打架
all_findings.description: passed_gating 來自 SignificanceAnalyzer.passed_gate = alt.passed_gate || hp_family.passed_gate（SignificanceAnalyzer.cpp:90），而 GlobalTest::apply_gating（GlobalTest.cpp:140-142）的 v_pass 用 **原始** result.cramers_v >= min_cramers_v(0.1)，未經 cramers_v_reliable gate。is_significant（1143-1146）= passed_gating && p<=0.05 && r.cramers_v(=gated max)>=0.1 && reads>=20。於是同一條件裡 passed_gating 含『raw V>=0.1』、後段又要求『gated V>=0.1』。對 raw V>=0.1 但 reliable=false 的稀疏位點：passed_gating=true 但 r.cramers_v=0 → is_significant=false。矛盾不會崩潰但語意混亂，且 passed_gating 已先放行（local + structure test 都跑了，line 94/99），最後又被 gated V 擋下。
all_findings.why_wrong: 一個分類布林同時依賴未 gate 與已 gate 的 CramersV，使『passed_gating』與『is_significant』的 CramersV 門檻不一致。對 reviewer 而言『通過 gating 卻不顯著且 V=0』難以解讀；對下游若有人只看 passed_gating（如 SubcloneAnalyzer 入選或 PERMANOVA 觸發）會納入 reliable=false 的稀疏位點。
all_findings.evidence:
GlobalTest.cpp:141  bool v_pass = (result.cramers_v >= config_.min_cramers_v);  // raw V
RegionProcessor.cpp:1145  (r.cramers_v >= 0.1) &&   // gated V (max of reliable?v:0)
RegionProcessor.cpp:1143  bool is_significant = r.passed_gating && (r.global_p_value <= 0.05) && ...
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: 稀疏-but-rawV-high 位點：跑了 local/structure/PERMANOVA（消耗 + 進 cluster_structure 輸出）卻在 is_significant 被歸 false；若任何下游用 passed_gating 而非 is_significant，會把這些位點當『有結構』。方向影響 characterization 的顯著位點集合邊界。
all_findings.quantification_method: 統計某樣本 results 內 passed_gating==true && cramers_v==0 的位點數；檢查這些位點是否進入 subclone_structure.txt / 是否被任何 script 以 passed_gating 篩選。grep scripts/ 用 PassedGating 欄的消費者。
all_findings.fix_direction: 統一 gate 的 CramersV 口徑：GlobalTest::apply_gating 的 v_pass 改用 reliable-gated V（或讓 is_significant 不再額外加 gated V 門檻，改信 passed_gating + p）。確保 passed_gating 與 is_significant 的 effect-size 條件一致。

all_findings.title: global_p_value = min(p_alt, p_hp, p_hp_family) 對三個維度取最小 p 卻未做 multiple-testing 校正
