all_findings.description: result.global_p_value = std::min({p_alt, p_hp, p_hp_family})，取 3 個獨立檢定維度（allele / HP merged / HP family）的最小 p，然後 is_significant 用 `global_p_value <= 0.05`。對每位點同時測 3 個 label 維度取 min-p 等於做了 3 次比較取最顯著，未 Bonferroni/maxT 校正 → 單位點 type-I error 被放大。此外跨數萬位點（全基因組）整體也無 FDR 控制（is_significant 直接用 0.05 raw）。
all_findings.why_wrong: 取多維度 min-p 而以 0.05 判顯著，會系統性高估顯著位點數（family-wise error 未控）。對『顯著 ASM 位點比例』『TP vs FP 顯著率差』這類 characterization 結論，min-p 的膨脹對 TP/FP 不一定對稱（HP 維度在不同集合 power 不同），可能偏移率差方向或量級。
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: 顯著位點數較『單一預設維度檢定』偏多；跨全基因組無 FDR → 期望假陽性位點數 ≈ 0.05×N_tested×(min-of-3 膨脹因子)。對 TP/FP 顯著率差的影響取決於兩類在三維 p 的相關結構，方向需實測。
all_findings.quantification_method: 對某樣本：(a) 比較『min-of-3 p<=0.05』與『單一 hp_family p<=0.05』的顯著位點數；(b) 對 N_tested 套 BH-FDR 重算顯著集合，看與 raw 0.05 的差。用 significance_summary.csv 的 GlobalP/GlobalP_HPFamily 欄即可，無需重跑 binary。
all_findings.fix_direction: 若刻意要 disjunction 檢定（『任一維度顯著即顯著』），對 min-p 套 Bonferroni（×有效維度數 或 maxT permutation null）；全基因組層級對 is_significant 改用 BH-FDR 而非 raw 0.05。至少在報告口徑文件標明 global_p 是 min-of-3 未校正。

all_findings.title: header 文件註解錯述 gating 條件（『global_p <= 0.1』）— 實際是 p AND CramersV 雙重 gate
all_findings.description: passed_gating 欄位註解寫 `Whether passed gating (global_p <= 0.1)`，暗示單一 p 門檻 0.1。但實際 gate（GlobalTest.cpp:138-142）是 dual gate：p_pass(p<=gating_p_threshold=0.1) AND v_pass(cramers_v>=min_cramers_v=0.1)，再 alt OR hp_family（SignificanceAnalyzer.cpp:90）。註解漏掉 effect-size 維度與 OR 邏輯。
all_findings.why_wrong: 研究員/審稿讀 header 會以為 passed_gating 只是 p<=0.1 的弱篩，低估了它同時要求 raw CramersV>=0.1；對解讀 passed_gating 與 is_significant 的關係（REGION-2）造成誤導。
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: 無數值影響（純註解），但增加誤讀風險。
all_findings.quantification_method: N/A（文件正確性）。
all_findings.fix_direction: 註解改為 `passed gating: (FFH p<=0.1 AND CramersV>=0.1) on alt-axis OR hp-family-axis`。

all_findings.title: signed HP methylation delta 以『read×CpG cell』為單位求 grand-mean，HP1/HP2 兩組 CpG 覆蓋組成不同時會被 confound
all_findings.description: compute_signed_hp_delta 對每個 read idx 的每個非 NaN cell 累加 sum 並 ++count（per-cell，非 per-read），最後回 `hp1_sum/hp1_count - hp2_sum/hp2_count`。註解稱 mean(HP1_meth) - mean(HP2_meth)，但實際是『該 HP 群所有 read×CpG 非缺值 cell 的算術平均』。若 HP1 與 HP2 兩群覆蓋的 CpG 位置集合不同（不同 read 跨不同 CpG），且各 CpG 基線甲基化不同，則此 grand-mean 差 = 真 ASM + CpG-composition 失衡。read×CpG cell 也非獨立（read 內 CpG 相依、read 間相依），任何據此差值的 SE/檢定都會低估。
all_findings.why_wrong: 以 cell 為單位 pool 把不同 CpG 位置與不同 read 等權混合；當 HP1/HP2 的 CpG 覆蓋不對稱（長度/位置偏差），位置間基線甲基化差會洩入 signed delta，混淆 allele-specific 訊號。這正是 ASM 估計需 per-CpG 配對（同位置 HP1 vs HP2）而非 grand-mean 的原因。
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: 當兩 HP 群 CpG 覆蓋不對稱時，combined/tumor/normal signed delta 偏離真 per-CpG-paired ASM；偏移方向取決於哪群覆蓋高基線 CpG 較多。hp_signed_residual（tumor−normal）部分抵銷共享 CpG-composition，但若 tumor/normal 覆蓋集不同則殘留。
all_findings.quantification_method: 對若干位點：用 raw_matrix 算 (a) 現行 grand-mean delta；(b) per-CpG paired delta = mean over CpG j of [mean_HP1(j) − mean_HP2(j)]（只取兩群都有覆蓋的 j）。比較兩者差，並看差是否與『HP1/HP2 CpG 覆蓋集 Jaccard』相關。需 region 的 methylation.csv。
all_findings.fix_direction: 改為 per-CpG paired delta：對每個兩群皆有覆蓋的 CpG j 算 mean_HP1(j)−mean_HP2(j)，再對 j 平均（或加權 coverage）；或至少在欄位文件標明這是 cell-grand-mean 而非 per-CpG-paired，避免下游當『純 allele 效應』。

all_findings.title: normal（unphased hp=0）reads 併入腫瘤距離矩陣與 cluster-first 全域檢定，膨脹一個 cluster 並改變列聯表邊際
all_findings.description: normal reads 在 line 808 merge 進 tumor matrix_builder 後 finalize；之後 distance matrix（833-854）、clustering（857-860）、cluster-first 全域檢定（1583 用 cluster_labels + full_labels）都包含 normal reads。normal read 的 hp_tag="0"（unphased），在 HP 檢定會被當 UNKNOWN 排除（masked），但它們仍進入『叢集』：normal 多半甲基化基線型 → 可能被分到同一 cluster，使 cluster_labels 的群組大小與 cluster×allele/HP 列聯表邊際被 normal 數量左右。allele 維度 normal read 通常 alt_support=REF 或 UNKNOWN，也會改變 cluster×allele 表。
all_findings.why_wrong: cluster-first 全域檢定的 null 假設是『叢集與 label 獨立』，但叢集形狀已被 normal reads 主導；normal 的 allele/HP 不是 somatic 結構訊號卻計入列聯表，混淆『somatic ASM』判讀。HP-axis 設計（HP1 vs HP1-1, somatic-controlled）的純度被 unphased normal 稀釋；ALLELE-axis 更被 normal 的 REF 富集放大（baseline allelic methylation confound，對齊 memory feedback_asm_allele_axis_baseline_confound）。
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: 含 normal 的 cluster-first 檢定 vs 純 tumor，顯著位點集合與 CramersV/p 會移動；normal 越多影響越大。對 paired 模式（有 normal BAM）的 ASM 顯著率與率差量級有方向性影響，且 ALLELE-axis 比 HP-axis 受影響更大。
all_findings.quantification_method: 對 paired 樣本若干位點：重算 cluster-first 全域檢定 (a) 含 normal、(b) 僅 is_tumor 子矩陣，比 CramersV/p/best_k；統計含 normal 後 cluster 大小是否由 normal 主導（normal 在最大 cluster 佔比）。用 region 的 methylation.csv + reads.tsv（含 is_tumor/hp）。
all_findings.fix_direction: 釐清設計意圖：若 cluster-first 全域檢定意在 somatic 結構，應在 tumor-only 子矩陣上跑 cluster + 全域檢定（normal 僅供 NormalBaseline 與 hp_residual 的 tumor−normal 相減，如 884-983 已做）；或在 full_labels 將 normal read 標為一獨立『sample』維度並從 cluster×HP/allele 列聯表排除（masked），而非讓其進叢集塑形。

all_findings.title: unbalanced-cluster 修正只嘗試 k+1 一次，且失敗時仍保留含小群的原 best_k（singleton/小群進檢定）
all_findings.description: 偵測到 cluster 不平衡（任一群 < min_cluster_size = max(3, N/20)）時，只試 best_k+1 一次；若 +1 後有 >=2 個 substantial cluster 就接受 +1（但仍可能含小群），否則完全不動、保留原 best_k（已知不平衡）。沒有迭代到更高 k、也沒有把小群 read 合併/標記，這些 <min_cluster_size 的小群（含 singleton）仍以原 label 進 cluster-first 列聯表與 PERMANOVA。
all_findings.why_wrong: 含 singleton/極小群的 cluster_labels 進列聯表會製造低期望格（觸發 REGION-1 的 reliable=false），也讓 PERMANOVA 的群內離散估計不穩。修正邏輯非對稱（接受可能仍不平衡的 +1，或退回已知不平衡的原值），未根治小群問題。
all_findings.evidence:
L1540: int min_cluster_size = std::max(3, static_cast<int>(read_list.size()) / 20);
L1550: if (unbalanced && best_k < 5) { int next_k = best_k + 1; ... if (substantial_clusters >= 2) { best_k = next_k; cluster_labels = next_labels; } }
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: 部分位點以含小群的叢集進檢定 → 列聯表稀疏（推升 CramersV unreliable 比例，間接放大 REGION-1 的口徑分歧位點數）；PERMANOVA pseudo-F 在小群下偏不穩。
all_findings.quantification_method: 統計某樣本 results 中『最小 cluster < min_cluster_size』的位點比例，及這些位點 cramers_v_reliable=false 的比例（用 significance.json 各 global_* 的 reliable 旗標或反推自 CSV CramersV==0）。
all_findings.fix_direction: 迭代提高 k 直到全群 >=min_cluster_size 或達上限；或將 <min_cluster_size 的小群 read 併入最近 cluster / 標為 noise 並從列聯表排除，避免低期望格與不穩 PERMANOVA。

all_findings.title: compute_hp_ratio 用非對稱 epsilon (+0.001/+0.002) 平滑，雙群皆 0 時回 ~0.5 被判非 LOH（邊界語意）
all_findings.description: compute_hp_ratio = (hp1+0.001)/(hp1+hp2+0.002)，避免除零。當 hp1=hp2=0（無 HP-tagged read，常見於 TO/unphased）時回 0.001/0.002=0.5 → is_potential_loh(0.5)=false。即『完全沒有 HP 分型資訊』被當成『HP 平衡、非 LOH』。雖不會崩潰，但把『缺資料』與『真平衡』混為一談（potential_loh=false 進 quality_score 的 loh_penalty 判斷與 loh_subtype）。
all_findings.why_wrong: 缺值(0,0)與真平衡(50,50)都映射到 ratio≈0.5、potential_loh=false，無法區分；對 paired 模式 loh_penalty(25 分) 的施加正確，但對下游若以 potential_loh=false 解讀為『確認非 LOH』則為偽陰（其實是無資訊）。
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: 無 HP 資訊的位點 potential_loh 一律 false；對 quality_score/loh_subtype 分佈有小幅影響（這些位點不吃 loh_penalty）。對核心 ASM 率差結論影響極小（HP 檢定本就 invalid）。
all_findings.quantification_method: 統計 hp_merged_n_hp1==0 && hp_merged_n_hp2==0 的位點數及其 potential_loh 值；確認下游無腳本把 potential_loh=false 當『confirmed non-LOH』。
all_findings.fix_direction: 在 hp1+hp2==0 時回特殊值或令 potential_loh 為 NA/unknown，與真平衡區分；或在 ratio 計算前 guard `if (n_total==0) return NaN`。

verified_high.title: CramersV 口徑分裂：significance.json 寫原始值、summary CSV / is_significant 用 reliability-gated 值（同一位點兩個 V）
verified_high.description: result.cramers_v 取 reliable-gated 的三維 max：`v_alt = global_alt.cramers_v_reliable ? cramers_v : 0.0`（同樣 hp、hp_family），再 std::max。此 gated 值寫進 significance_summary.csv 的 CramersV 欄（line 1159）並驅動 is_significant（line 1145 `r.cramers_v >= 0.1`）。但同一位點的 per-region significance.json（line 1732/1738/1744/1752）寫的是 **未 gate 的原始 sig_result.global_alt.cramers_v**。所以稀疏列聯表（Cochran low-expected-ratio>0.2，MathUtils.cpp:200）位點在 CSV 得 CV=0、在 significance.json 得原始（可能 0.4+）。下游不同腳本讀不同檔 → 同位點兩個答案。
verified_high.why_wrong: 同一統計量在兩個輸出檔有不同口徑，且無欄位標示哪個是 gated。讀 significance.json 的腳本會把 Cochran-unreliable 的高 CramersV 當真值（稀疏表的 CramersV 本就被高估），讀 CSV 的腳本會把同位點當 CV=0。memory project_asm_locus_display_and_cramersv_reliability_gate 已記錄『summary CramersV=reliable?v:0 vs significance.json 原始值，稀疏表差很大』『762 MISSED 中 487 latent gated CV=0 但 PERMANOVA 顯著』——正是此口徑差造成的位點數分歧。
verified_high.effect_hypothesis: 稀疏列聯表位點（小 N 或極不平衡 HP/allele 分組）在 CSV 被歸 CV=0 而非顯著，significance.json 卻保留高 raw V；兩檔位點計數不一致，characterization 統計（如 strong-ASM 位點數、reliable 顯著率）依讀哪個檔而異。
verified_high.quantification_method: 對某樣本 output：join significance_summary.csv 的 CramersV 與各 region significance.json 的 global_*.cramers_v（同 anchor_key），統計 (a) CSV CramersV==0 但 json raw>=0.1 的位點數，(b) 這些位點 PERMANOVA p<=0.05 的比例。用 scripts/ 既有 88_*.py 的 gate 邏輯比對。需真實 output 目錄。
verified_high.fix_direction: 二選一統一口徑：(A) significance.json 也寫 gated 值 + 額外加 `cramers_v_reliable` 旗標欄，讓下游自行決定；(B) 兩處都寫 raw V + 並列 reliable 旗標，is_significant 改用 `(raw_V>=0.1 && reliable)`。最小修正＝在 significance.json 每個 global_* 區塊加 `"cramers_v_reliable": bool`，並在 CSV 加同名欄，消除歧義。

verdict.reasoning:
All factual claims verified against actual source. (1) RegionProcessor.cpp:1592-1596 — result.cramers_v = std::max of reliability-gated values, e.g. `v_alt = sig_result.global_alt.cramers_v_reliable ? sig_result.global_alt.cramers_v : 0.0`. (2) Line 1159 CSV writes `r.cramers_v` = this gated value. (3) Line 1143-1146 `is_significant` is driven by `(r.cramers_v >= 0.1)`, i.e. the gated value. (4) Lines 1732/1738/1744/1752 in the significance.json block write `sig_result.global_alt.cramers_v` (and .global_hp / .global_hp_family / .global_hp_fine) RAW, with no reliability gate. (5) The Cochran gate is exactly as described — MathUtils.cpp:191-200: a cell is low-expected if expected `< 5.0`, and `is_reliable = (low_expected_ratio <= 0.2)`. (6) I scanned the entire json-writing block (lines 1718-1789): it emits raw cramers_v but does NOT serialize the `cramers_v_reliable` flag (the flag exists in Stats.hpp:193 but is never written to json), so a consumer reading only the json cannot tell the value is Cochran-unreliable. So the "same locus → two different CramersV / no field marking which is gated" claim is literally true.

The divergence is also realized in the real workflow, not hypothetical: research/tsg_promoter_asm_reviewer/scripts/86_build_display_html.py:40-41 reads the gated `CramersV` column from significance_summary.csv, while scripts/92_run_overstrict_raw.sh deliberately reruns the binary keeping ONLY clustering/significance.json "to obtain RAW CramersV", and script 89/86 explicitly document `CramersV=reliable?v:0` and that 487 latent MISSED loci have raw CramersV≥0.3 but gated 0. This matches memory project_asm_locus_display_and_cramersv_reliability_gate.

Severity downgrade HIGH→LOW. My refutation partially succeeds: this is not a computational error and not silent corruption — both numbers are individually correct, and the split is a defensible design (significance.json is a raw per-region statistical dump that also emits raw p_value/PERMANOVA/dispersion = evidence layer; gating is a decision-layer applied only at the aggregate CSV/is_significant verdict). The team understood and intentionally exploited the distinction (script 92's entire purpose), so no one was actually misled. What remains genuine is a provenance/labeling gap: the json carries raw (Cochran-unreliable, hence inflated for sparse 2xN tables) CramersV with no `cramers_v_reliable` companion field, so a naive json-only consumer could read a sparse-table-inflated V as truth. That is a real consistency/documentation hazard worth a one-field fix (serialize cramers_v_reliable into the json, or rename one channel), but it is interpretive risk, not a logic bug — LOW, not HIGH.

perReviewer.area: IOREAD — read parsing / SNV / LOH annotation / config / IO (src/core/ReadParser.cpp, ReadAggregator.cpp, BamReader.cpp, SomaticSnv.cpp, LohBedAnnotator.cpp, Config.cpp, src/io/RegionWriter.cpp, TreeWriter.cpp, src/utils/FastaReader.cpp, Logger.cpp, src/main.cpp; cross-read RegionProcessor.cpp, RegionBounds.hpp, MethylationParser.cpp, ArgParser.hpp for coordinate/flow tracing)
perReviewer.notes:
Scope: I audited read parsing, SNV loading, LOH BED annotation, config/CLI, and IO writers, tracing coordinate conventions across htslib's three systems (sam_itr_querys 1-based, faidx 0-based, bam core.pos 0-based).

KEY VERIFIED-CORRECT items (checked and deliberately NOT reported):
- HP tag parsing (ReadParser.cpp:121-154): integer (1/2/11/21/33) and string (Z/H) forms handled; HP=0/unknown default correct; germline_hp_only demotion of 11/21/33→"0" matches the documented self-phasing fallback and is unit-tested (test_read_parser.cpp). Per-read getVote concept is in a different module (judgeHaplotype/longphase), not here.
- FLAG filtering (ReadParser.cpp:31-42): secondary/supplementary/duplicate/unmapped all excluded; no_filter mode still drops these structurally (ReadAggregator.cpp:37-42). Correct.
- MAPQ comes from b->core.qual (ReadParser.cpp:87,115); the 'MAPQ always 60' is a property of the Dorado-aligned data (a real analysis blind spot for NM/supp confound tests) but NOT a code bug — not reported.
- SNV 1-based→0-based conversion in determine_alt_support (ReadParser.cpp:172-175) with pos==0/overflow guards: correct. CIGAR walk (M/=/X consume both, I/S consume seq, D/N consume ref, H nothing) is correct; SNV-in-deletion → UNKNOWN correct.
- LohBedAnnotator overlaps(): 1-based ISM pos→0-based (pos-1) then half-open [start,end) test against BED — this is the CORRECT BED convention, no off-by-one here. The ONLY LOH issue is the overlapping-interval binary-search gap (IOREAD-2).
- BamReader RAII/move semantics and error handling (ret<-1 clears reads) correct.
- MatrixBuilder reassigns read_id by reads_.size() (overrides the read_count passed from ReadAggregator) and re-numbers on merge — so the read_count-as-read_id in ReadAggregator is harmless.
- VCF loading: PASS filter check, bcf_is_snp + n_allele==2 (biallelic SNP only) correct.

The headline finding is IOREAD-1: a genuine BAM-vs-FASTA coordinate-convention mismatch (1-based region_start fed to faidx which expects 0-based). It is partially masked because MethylationParser's ref_offset uses the same 1-based ref_start_pos, so the two off-by-ones cancel for interior CpGs — but the ref window is still 1bp short/shifted at the edge, and the cancellation is coincidental. I could NOT locate the htslib faidx.h header within the repo/bounded filesystem search to quote the declaration line directly; the 0-based-inclusive semantics of faidx_fetch_seq are from documented htslib behavior, which the FastaReader.cpp:50 comment itself corroborates ('expects 0-based start'). Recommend the main loop confirm IOREAD-1 empirically by comparing cpg_sites.tsv against an independent samtools faidx extraction for one region (no long rerun needed). All effect magnitudes left unquantified per instructions — I describe direction + the exact file/command to quantify.

all_findings.title: FASTA reference window fetched with a 1-based start treated as 0-based → ref_seq is shifted +1bp and 1bp shorter vs the BAM read window
all_findings.description: RegionBounds is documented (RegionBounds.hpp:24-25 '1-based, inclusive') and compute_region_bounds produces region_start=max(1,snv_pos-w), region_end=snv_pos+w using snv.pos which is 1-based (SomaticSnv.cpp:167 'snv.pos = rec->pos + 1'). RegionProcessor passes these SAME 1-based coordinates to both bam_reader.fetch_reads (BamReader.cpp:81-86 builds 'chr:start-end' for sam_itr_querys, which is 1-based-inclusive → correct) AND to fasta_reader.fetch_sequence (RegionProcessor.cpp:780). But FastaReader::fetch_sequence calls faidx_fetch_seq(fai, chr, start, end-1) (FastaReader.cpp:52) whose comment claims 'expects 0-based start'. htslib faidx_fetch_seq treats p_beg_i/p_end_i as 0-based inclusive. So a 1-based region_start is passed where a 0-based coordinate is expected.
all_findings.why_wrong: The reference sequence returned spans 0-based [region_start, region_end-1] (i.e. 1-based [region_start+1, region_end]) instead of the intended 1-based-inclusive window [region_start, region_end]. Net effect: ref_seq is shifted +1bp downstream and 1bp shorter than the BAM read window fetched for the same region. This breaks the alignment between the read window and the reference window at the window edges.
all_findings.evidence: FastaReader.cpp:50-52: '// faidx_fetch_seq expects 0-based start and (end-1) for inclusive end\n int len = 0;\n char* seq = faidx_fetch_seq(fai_, chr.c_str(), start, end - 1, &len);' — called from RegionProcessor.cpp:780 'std::string ref_seq = fasta_reader.fetch_sequence(chr_name, region_start, region_end);' where region_start=bounds.start is 1-based (RegionBounds.hpp:24). Meanwhile fetch_reads gets the same region_start as a 1-based itr query (BamReader.cpp:81-86).
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: CpG sites located within ~1bp of the window's downstream/upstream edge can be mis-validated or dropped in MethylationParser's CpG check (MethylationParser.cpp:138-139,176-178), because ref_seq is offset. Because MethylationParser computes ref_offset = ref_pos_0based - ref_start_pos with ref_start_pos = region_start (also 1-based, RegionProcessor.cpp:791), the +1 FASTA shift and the +1 indexing offset CANCEL for interior positions — so most CpG calls are unaffected — but the window is still 1bp short on one edge, so the last CpG(s) at the boundary may be lost, and the cancellation is coincidental/fragile rather than designed.
all_findings.quantification_method: Pick one region from an existing output run; compare cpg_sites.tsv positions against an independent samtools faidx extraction of the SAME 1-based window vs the (window-1) window; count CpG sites present in the correct window but missing from output (expected: 0-1 per region edge). Alternatively add a unit test fetching a known sequence at a known 1-based coordinate and assert ref_seq[0] equals the base at that 1-based position.
all_findings.fix_direction: Decide ONE coordinate convention. If RegionBounds stays 1-based-inclusive, call faidx_fetch_seq(fai, chr, start-1, end-1) (convert to 0-based) and pass ref_start_pos = region_start-1 (0-based) to ReadAggregator/MethylationParser so ref_offset = ref_pos_0based - (region_start-1) stays correct. Add a unit test asserting ref_seq[0] == reference base at the intended 1-based start.

all_findings.title: LohBedAnnotator::find_overlap only checks the single nearest-by-start region → misses overlapping/nested LOH intervals
all_findings.description: find_overlap does upper_bound on start, then steps back exactly ONE region and tests containment [start,end). If two BED regions overlap (e.g. region A start=100 end=500 and region B start=200 end=300) and the query pos_0based=450 falls inside A but A is not the region immediately before the upper_bound result, the function returns nullptr even though pos is covered by A.
all_findings.why_wrong: Binary-search-then-single-step-back only works for strictly non-overlapping, sorted intervals. The loader (load(), lines 59-68) does not merge or assert non-overlap; it sorts by (start, end) but allows arbitrary overlap/nesting. For any pos covered by an earlier-starting, later-ending region that is shadowed by an intervening region with a smaller end, overlap detection fails.
all_findings.evidence: LohBedAnnotator.cpp:107-120: 'auto upper = std::upper_bound(vec.begin(), vec.end(), pos_0based, [](int32_t p, const BedRegion& r){ return p < r.start; }); if (upper == vec.begin()) return nullptr; --upper; if (pos_0based >= upper->start && pos_0based < upper->end) return &(*upper); return nullptr;' — only the single region at --upper is tested.
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: loh_bed_overlap (RegionProcessor.cpp:1707) and loh classification (LohSource BED_ONLY/BOTH, LohBedAnnotator.cpp:88-95) can be FALSE NEGATIVE for SNVs inside nested/overlapping LOH segments → undercounts LOH-annotated sites. Direction: under-annotation of LOH. Magnitude depends on whether the input LOH BED (LongPhase output) actually contains overlapping intervals; if LongPhase emits a strict segmentation, impact is zero.
all_findings.quantification_method: Run `bedtools merge` vs raw on the LOH BED used; if merged region count < raw count there are overlaps. Then count SNVs whose pos falls in a shadowed region. If the BED is verified non-overlapping, downgrade to LOW.
all_findings.fix_direction: Either (a) assert/merge overlapping intervals at load time, or (b) replace the single-step-back with a proper interval scan: from the upper_bound position, walk backwards while region.start <= pos and test each for end>pos (or use an interval tree). Add a unit test with two nested LOH intervals.

all_findings.title: Tumor/normal reads de-duplicated in separate seen_read_names sets → same read name across BAMs not collapsed; cross-BAM merge can double-count a read
all_findings.description: ReadAggregator::aggregate creates a fresh local seen_read_names set per call (line 21). RegionProcessor calls aggregate() TWICE — once for tumor (line 791), once for normal (line 804) — then merges the two MatrixBuilders (line 808). De-duplication is therefore only within a single BAM, not across the tumor+normal union.
all_findings.why_wrong: If the same QNAME exists in both the tumor and normal BAM for the region (possible when normal and tumor are aligned from overlapping libraries, or when the same read name collides), both copies survive the merge and appear as two matrix rows with identical read_name. Read-read distance / clustering then sees a spurious near-duplicate pair, inflating cluster cohesion and any HP/ALLELE structure test that treats rows as independent.
all_findings.evidence: ReadAggregator.cpp:21 'std::unordered_set<std::string> seen_read_names;' (local). Line 57-60 dedup. RegionProcessor.cpp:804-808: 'auto normal_agg = ReadAggregator(agg_config).aggregate(normal_reads, ...); ... agg.matrix_builder.merge(normal_agg.matrix_builder);' — no cross-set dedup before merge.
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: Usually negligible (tumor/normal QNAMEs rarely collide), but where they do, adds correlated duplicate rows → mild over-dispersion / inflated within-group similarity in distance matrix and PERMANOVA. Direction: spuriously stronger clustering. Note: normal reads also get hp_tag forced; but the duplicate-row risk is the concern.
all_findings.quantification_method: For a paired run, intersect read_name sets of tumor vs normal per region (grep reads.tsv is_tumor==1 vs ==0 read_name columns) and count collisions. If zero across regions, downgrade to INFO.
all_findings.fix_direction: Thread a shared seen_read_names across both aggregate() calls (e.g. dedup at merge time in MatrixBuilder::merge by read_name), or document that tumor/normal QNAME spaces are assumed disjoint and assert it.

all_findings.title: Somatic VAF read only from FORMAT/AF; silently defaults to 0.0 when AF is in INFO or absent
all_findings.description: load_from_vcf extracts tumor VAF via bcf_get_format_float(hdr, rec, 'AF', ...). If the AF tag lives in INFO (common in some ClairS-TO / merged VCF variants) rather than FORMAT, n_ret<=0 and tumor_vaf silently stays 0.0, with no warning. somatic_conf is then 0 for every variant.
all_findings.why_wrong: somatic_conf=0 silently for an entire VCF whose AF is in INFO. Any downstream analysis or report that uses somatic_conf / VAF (e.g. low-AF TP stratification) would treat all variants as VAF=0 without any error surfaced. Matches the known 'merged_dataset AF pitfall' caution in project memory (AF field semantics vary by source).
all_findings.evidence: SomaticSnv.cpp:147-154: 'float* af_ptr = NULL; int n_af = 0; int n_ret = bcf_get_format_float(hdr, rec, "AF", &af_ptr, &n_af); if (n_ret > 0 && af_ptr) { tumor_vaf = af_ptr[0]; }' — no else/warning; tumor_vaf init 0.0f at line 146.
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: If the production VCF carries AF only in INFO, every somatic_conf written to the SNV TSV (SomaticSnv.cpp:75) is 0 → silently breaks any VAF-conditioned analysis. Direction: VAF feature becomes a constant 0. No effect if production VCF genuinely uses FORMAT/AF (ClairS-TO single-sample does emit FORMAT/AF).
all_findings.quantification_method: grep the somatic_snvs TSV column 'somatic_conf' / inspect bcftools query -f '%INFO/AF\t[%AF]\n' on the production VCF to confirm AF location; if all somatic_conf==0 while bcftools shows nonzero INFO/AF, confirmed.
all_findings.fix_direction: Try FORMAT/AF, fall back to INFO/AF (bcf_get_info_float), and emit a one-time WARN if neither found instead of silently defaulting to 0.0.

all_findings.title: Read-length filter uses query length (bam_cigar2qlen, includes soft-clips) not aligned reference span
all_findings.description: should_keep_with_reason computes read_len = bam_cigar2qlen(n_cigar, cigar) and compares to min_read_length (default 1000, Config.hpp:30). bam_cigar2qlen returns the number of query-consuming bases (M/I/S/=/X), which INCLUDES soft-clipped bases. A read with a long soft-clip but short aligned span passes the 1000bp filter despite contributing little aligned methylation signal to the window.
all_findings.why_wrong: For a windowed region analysis the relevant length is the aligned reference span (bam_endpos - pos) or the in-window aligned length, not the raw query length. Soft-clip-heavy chimeric/adapter reads can satisfy min_read_length while covering few in-window CpGs.
all_findings.evidence: ReadParser.cpp:50-52: 'int read_len = bam_cigar2qlen(b->core.n_cigar, bam_get_cigar(b)); if (read_len < config_.min_read_length) { reasons |= FilterReason::SHORT_READ; }'. bam_cigar2qlen counts S/I/M/=/X (query-consuming), so soft-clips inflate read_len.
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: Mildly admits soft-clip-padded reads that should arguably be filtered; effect is small for ONT (long aligned reads dominate) and conservative (keeps more reads). Direction: slightly more permissive than intended.
all_findings.quantification_method: Compare count of reads passing with bam_cigar2qlen vs bam_endpos-pos on one region's reads.tsv (align_end-align_start vs filter outcome); count reads where query_len>=1000 but aligned_span<1000.
all_findings.fix_direction: If the intent is aligned length, use bam_cigar2rlen or (bam_endpos(b)-b->core.pos). If query length is intended, document it explicitly. Add a unit test with a soft-clip-heavy read.

all_findings.title: Coordinate convention (BAM 1-based fetch vs FASTA 0-based fetch vs ref_offset) is untested; tests only exercise HP-tag path with pos==0 short-circuit
all_findings.description: Every BAM record in test_read_parser.cpp is built with no CIGAR/SEQ and the test deliberately uses SomaticSnv with pos==0 to short-circuit determine_alt_support (comment lines 24-26, 75). So the CIGAR-walk offset logic, the SNV 1-based→0-based conversion (ReadParser.cpp:175), and the BAM-fetch-vs-FASTA-fetch coordinate consistency (IOREAD-1) are never exercised by a unit test.
all_findings.why_wrong: The most error-prone parts of this module — coordinate conversions across htslib's three conventions (sam_itr_querys 1-based, faidx 0-based, bam core.pos 0-based) and CIGAR offset computation — have zero test coverage. A regression in any of them would pass CI. This is the classic 'tests only cover the trivial path' gap.
all_findings.evidence: test_read_parser.cpp:24-26 '// alt-support branch short-circuits when anchor_snv.pos == 0 so the skeletal record is sufficient'; line 75 'SomaticSnv snv{}; // pos == 0 short-circuits alt-support evaluation'; make_bam_with_hp_int passes '0, nullptr,  // cigar' (line 34). No test constructs a real CIGAR + ref_seq + nonzero snv.pos to assert the resolved base.
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: Not a runtime bug itself, but means IOREAD-1 and the SNV-base resolution could be silently wrong/regressed. Direction: hides coordinate bugs from CI.
all_findings.quantification_method: N/A (coverage gap). Add a test: build a read with CIGAR e.g. 10M, known SEQ, a SomaticSnv at a known 1-based pos inside it, supply matching ref_seq + ref_start_pos, assert AltSupport and (separately) that MethylationParser resolves a known CpG to the correct genomic coordinate.
all_findings.fix_direction: Add unit tests covering: (1) determine_alt_support with real CIGAR (M/I/D/S) returning ALT/REF/UNKNOWN, (2) FastaReader.fetch_sequence returning the base at a known 1-based coordinate, (3) round-trip CpG coordinate through MethylationParser.

all_findings.title: ReadFilterConfig.require_mm_ml hard-forced true in RegionProcessor (not CLI-overridable); silently drops all reads lacking MM/ML even in no-filter contexts
all_findings.description: filter_config_.require_mm_ml is hard-set to true (RegionProcessor.cpp:414) and there is no CLI flag to disable it (ArgParser.hpp exposes min-mapq/length/base-quality/germline-hp-only but NOT require_mm_ml). Reads without MM/ML tags are filtered as MISSING_MM_TAG/MISSING_ML_TAG (ReadParser.cpp:56-65). This interacts with no_filter mode: in ReadAggregator no_filter path (lines 37-42) only FLAG-based structural filters are applied, but the require_mm_ml filter is part of should_keep used in the normal path.
all_findings.why_wrong: A genuinely unmethylated/older basecall BAM without modification tags would yield zero kept reads with no obvious diagnostic beyond filtered-read reasons, and the user cannot override it from the CLI. For a tool whose primary axis is read-read methylation distance this default is defensible, but the lack of any override + silent whole-region emptying is a usability/robustness gap.
all_findings.evidence: RegionProcessor.cpp:411-415 sets min_mapq/min_read_length/min_base_quality/require_mm_ml=true/germline_hp_only but require_mm_ml is the only one not surfaced as a CLI option in ArgParser.hpp (no app.add_flag for require_mm_ml anywhere in the file).
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: On a BAM lacking MM/ML tags, every region returns 0 reads → empty matrices, and the cause is only visible in filtered-reads debug output. Direction: silent empty output on tag-less input.
all_findings.quantification_method: N/A static. Confirm by grepping ArgParser.hpp for 'require_mm_ml' (absent) and noting RegionProcessor hard-sets it.
all_findings.fix_direction: Expose --require-mm-ml/--no-require-mm-ml CLI flag and/or emit a WARN when a region is emptied entirely due to missing MM/ML tags.

all_findings.title: expected_coverage magic default 0.0 (auto-KDE) is config-correct, but min_mapq/min_read_length defaults differ between Config and ReadFilterConfig headers (latent drift risk)
all_findings.description: Two independent default blocks exist for the same filter thresholds: Config (min_mapq=20, min_read_length=1000, min_base_quality=20) and ReadFilterConfig (same values). They currently agree AND RegionProcessor explicitly copies Config→filter_config_ (lines 411-413), so behavior is correct today. But the duplicated literals are a drift hazard: editing one header's default without the other would not change behavior (because RegionProcessor copies Config), silently making the ReadFilterConfig default dead — a maintenance trap. Separately, expected_coverage default 0.0 (=auto KDE) is a documented sentinel, not the hardcoded 75.0 flagged elsewhere in project memory — that 75.0 lives in a different module (baseline), not in these IO files.
all_findings.why_wrong: Not a current bug. Duplicated source-of-truth for filter defaults across Config.hpp and ReadParser.hpp invites future inconsistency; the ReadFilterConfig literals are effectively shadowed by RegionProcessor's copy, so a reader could be misled into thinking editing ReadParser.hpp changes the pipeline default (it does not for the main path).
all_findings.evidence: Config.hpp:29-31 'int min_mapq = 20; int min_read_length = 1000; int min_base_quality = 20;'; ReadParser.hpp:16-18 same literals; RegionProcessor.cpp:411-413 copies Config values over, making ReadFilterConfig's own defaults moot for the production path. Config.hpp:56 'double expected_coverage = 0.0; ///< 0 = auto-estimate via KDE mode'.
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: Zero runtime effect now; risk is a future silent default mismatch. The expected_coverage=75.0 baseline bug noted in memory is NOT in these IO files (correctly defaulted to 0.0 here).
all_findings.quantification_method: N/A (static / maintainability).
all_findings.fix_direction: Have ReadFilterConfig defaults reference Config defaults (single source) or add a comment that RegionProcessor.cpp is authoritative for the production path; keep a static_assert/test that the two default sets agree.

perReviewer.area: HEADERS — hardcoded constants / magic numbers / default parameters / struct invariants in include/core/*.hpp
perReviewer.notes:
分區 = HEADERS（常數/magic number/預設參數/struct 不變量），不重複稽核演算法邏輯（交其他 reviewer）。

最高優先：HEADERS-1（expected_coverage 75.0 散落，對應 MEMORY.md 已記之 infra bug，HIGH）。其餘多為跨檔預設不一致（HEADERS-4 C_min 3vs5、HEADERS-5 度量 BERNOULLI vs NHD、HEADERS-7 min_reads 3vs5）與應進 config 的門檻（HEADERS-6 gating_p=0.1 等），生產路徑多被 Config 覆寫故 runtime 影響有限，主要傷害在測試代表性/可重現性/可調參性。

已查無問題項（不報以免噪音）：
- FilterReason bitfield（uint16_t, 1<<0..1<<11，無溢位，operator| 正確）— 正確。
- LogLevel enum 含 -1（FATAL），is_debug() 用 >= LOG_DEBUG — 邏輯正確。
- MathUtils LOG_FACTORIAL_TABLE_SIZE=1025（n<=1024 查表，>1024 Stirling）— size 與註解一致，無 off-by-one（索引 0..1024）。
- RegionBounds：start=max(1,...) / width=end-start+1（inclusive 兩端），1-based 約定一致，無 off-by-one。
- binary_methyl_high/low（0.8/0.2）Config 與 DistanceConfig 一致 — 無分歧。
- FisherExact MC min=2000/max=10000 + Wilson CI + Haldane-Anscombe +0.5 修正（MathUtils）— 設計合理。
- ContingencyTable2x2/RxC 預設全 =0，is_valid 檢查 grand_total>0 — 不變量完整。
- PerCpgAsm.hpp:8 引用『DAMEfinder, pycoMeth』只列工具名無作者年份；對應 .cpp:6 已是正確的 Orjuela 2020（MEMORY 記之 De Waele 誤引已修），故 header 無誤引，不報為 citation finding。

需主迴圈用真實資料量化者：HEADERS-1（各樣本 diploid_coverage_used==75.0 fallback 比例 + coverage_category 位移）、HEADERS-6（gating_p sensitivity 對 verification_class 分佈）。

all_findings.title: expected_coverage 寫死 75.0 散落 6+ 處（Config 預設 0.0 但自由函式/RegionResult ctor/Stats 註解皆 75.0），CNV 分類與 coverage_multiple 全繫於此
all_findings.description: diploid coverage baseline 75.0x 以 magic number 形式散落多檔：compute_coverage_multiple(int, double expected_coverage = 75.0) (RegionProcessor.hpp:522)、RegionResult ctor diploid_coverage_used(75.0) (l.328)、DiploidEstimate 註解 fallback 75.0 (l.525)、Stats.hpp QualityFlags 註解『normalized to expected 75x』『NumReads/75.0』(l.525-526)。Config::expected_coverage 預設 0.0(=auto KDE)，但所有 fallback 與函式預設參數寫死 75.0。
all_findings.why_wrong: coverage_multiple = num_reads/expected_coverage，再以 0.5/0.8/1.2/1.5/2.0 倍門檻切 CNV_Loss/Low/Normal/Elevated/Gain/High_Copy 與 LOH 判定。75.0 是樣本特定值——7 樣本實際 diploid coverage 不同。若 KDE 估計失敗 fallback 到全域 75.0，所有 coverage_category/CNV/quality_score 對該樣本系統性偏移。此即 MEMORY.md 記錄之 expected_coverage hardcoded 75.0 infra bug。
all_findings.evidence: RegionProcessor.hpp:522 `double compute_coverage_multiple(int num_reads, double expected_coverage = 75.0);` ; RegionProcessor.hpp:328 `diploid_coverage_used(75.0),` ; Stats.hpp:526 `double coverage_multiple = 1.0;     // NumReads/75.0`
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: 當 KDE auto-estimate 未啟用或 fallback 觸發時，coverage_category 與 CNV gain/loss 計數對非~75x 樣本系統性錯分；下游 LOH_subtype/quality_score/quality_tier 連動偏移
all_findings.quantification_method: 對每樣本比較 estimate_diploid_coverage() 實際估值 vs 75.0；統計 RegionResult.diploid_coverage_used 欄位中 ==75.0(fallback)的比例；重算 coverage_multiple 與 coverage_category 看分佈位移。檔案：output 各 region significance_summary.csv 的 coverage 相關欄；指令 grep diploid_coverage_used 各樣本 TSV
all_findings.fix_direction: 建立單一 constexpr/config 來源（如 Config::diploid_coverage_fallback），移除自由函式預設參數 75.0 與 ctor 寫死值；fallback 值與 KDE 估計皆從 Config 取；Stats.hpp 註解改為引用 config 而非寫死 75.0

all_findings.title: MethylCall 預設建構子把 probability 初始化為 0.0f（=未甲基化），缺值若漏排除會被當『確定未甲基化』而非 NaN
all_findings.description: struct MethylCall 預設 ctor `MethylCall() : ref_pos(0), probability(0.0f)`。整個 pipeline 約定缺值=NaN(-1.0)（見 MethylationMatrix.hpp:22『NaN for missing』、MatrixBuilder.hpp:27『-1.0 = no coverage』）。但 MethylCall 本身的缺值哨兵是 probability=0.0f，與 0.0=『高信心未甲基化』在數值上無法區分。
all_findings.why_wrong: binary call 門檻 binary_methyl_low=0.2：probability=0.0 會被判為 unmethylated(0)。若任何路徑產生 default-constructed MethylCall（例如解析失敗回傳預設物件、或 vector resize 預填）後未被過濾，缺值會悄悄變成『未甲基化』而非排除，使該 read×CpG 的甲基化率向 0 偏，影響 Δβ(HP1-HP2)、距離矩陣與 binary entropy/epipoly。0.0f 應改為 NaN 哨兵或 ref_pos<0 標記缺值。
all_findings.evidence: MethylationParser.hpp:18 `MethylCall() : ref_pos(0), probability(0.0f) {}`；MatrixBuilder.hpp:27 `// -1.0: This read does not cover this CpG site (using -1 to represent NaN)`
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: 若 default MethylCall 漏入矩陣，受影響 cell 的甲基化被當 0（未甲基化），使該 read 的甲基化 pattern 偏向 unmethylated，方向使 Δβ 與距離被稀釋
all_findings.quantification_method: 靜態追 parse_read 是否可能回傳含 default-constructed 元素的 vector；動態：在 add_read 加 assert probability!=0.0f||is_real，統計觸發次數；或檢查 matrix 中 0.0 與 NaN 的比例是否異常。檔案：MethylationParser.cpp parse_read 回傳路徑
all_findings.fix_direction: 預設 ctor 改 probability(std::numeric_limits<float>::quiet_NaN()) 或加 valid 旗標；任何用 probability 前先檢查非 NaN；確保解析失敗不回傳 default 物件而是空 vector

all_findings.title: 重複的 ClusterStats struct（Clustering.hpp vs Stats.hpp 同 namespace 不同欄位）= ODR 地雷；Clustering.hpp 目前無人 include（dead）但未來 include 即衝突
all_findings.description: InterSubMod namespace 內有兩個同名 struct ClusterStats，欄位完全不同：Clustering.hpp 版有 count_hp_unknown/p_value_hp/p_value_somatic 且成員『無預設初始化』(int cluster_id; int size; ...)；Stats.hpp 版有 count_hp1_1/count_hp2_1/.../FisherResult 多欄且全有 =0 預設。實際使用的是 Stats.hpp 版（LocalTest.cpp/LocalTest.hpp）。grep 確認目前無任何 .cpp include Clustering.hpp（僅含 ClusteringResult 但無人引用）。
all_findings.why_wrong: 兩個同名 type 在同一 namespace = One Definition Rule 違反，目前因 Clustering.hpp 從未被 include 而未爆。一旦有人 include Clustering.hpp 與 Stats.hpp 於同一 TU，編譯期 redefinition error；若分屬不同 TU 連結則 UB。更糟：Clustering.hpp 的 ClusterStats 成員『無預設值』(cluster_id/size/count_* 全未初始化)，若被誤用會讀到垃圾值。屬 struct 不變量風險（未初始化 + 重名）。
all_findings.evidence: Clustering.hpp:13 `struct ClusterStats {` 內 `int cluster_id; int size;`（無 =0）；Stats.hpp:209 `struct ClusterStats {` 內 `int cluster_id = -1; int size = 0;`（有預設）。grep：無 .cpp include Clustering.hpp
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: 目前無 runtime 影響（dead header）；風險是未來引用導致編譯失敗或讀未初始化記憶體
all_findings.quantification_method: 靜態確認：grep -rn 'include.*Clustering.hpp' 已證實 0 個生產引用；無需重跑資料
all_findings.fix_direction: 刪除 Clustering.hpp（dead code）或將其 ClusterStats/ClusteringResult 重新命名（如 LegacyClusterStats）並補全預設初始化；統一只保留 Stats.hpp 版

all_findings.title: min_common_coverage (C_min) 預設值不一致：Config=3 vs DistanceConfig=5 vs DistanceMatrix=5
all_findings.description: 距離計算的最小共同 CpG 門檻 C_min 三處預設不同：Config::min_common_coverage=3（生產入口）、DistanceConfig::min_common_coverage=5、DistanceMatrix::min_common_coverage=5。生產路徑 RegionProcessor.cpp:424 `distance_config_.min_common_coverage = config.min_common_coverage` 會用 Config 的 3 覆寫掉 DistanceConfig 的 5，所以生產跑 C_min=3。但任何直接建構 DistanceConfig/DistanceMatrix 而不經 Config（單元測試、直接 API、未來新呼叫點）會默默用 C_min=5。
all_findings.why_wrong: C_min 決定一對 read 需多少共同 CpG 才算有效距離（否則套 MAX_DIST 或 SKIP）。3 vs 5 會改變 num_valid_pairs/num_invalid_pairs、進而改變距離矩陣稀疏度、分群與 PERMANOVA 樣本數。預設值分歧使『直接用 DistanceConfig 的測試』與『生產』算出不同距離矩陣，破壞可重現性與測試代表性。
all_findings.evidence: Config.hpp:37 `int min_common_coverage = 3;  ///< ... (C_min)`；DistanceMatrix.hpp:23 `int min_common_coverage = 5;  ///< ... (C_min)`；RegionProcessor.cpp:424 `distance_config_.min_common_coverage = config.min_common_coverage;`
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: 生產=3 統一；風險在非生產路徑（測試/直接 API）默默用 5，導致 valid pair 數與距離結構與生產不一致——測試無法代表生產行為
all_findings.quantification_method: 靜態：確認所有 DistanceConfig 建構點是否皆經 Config 覆寫；動態：以 C_min=3 vs 5 對同 region 重算 num_valid_pairs/num_invalid_pairs 差異（distance_matrix stats 檔）
all_findings.fix_direction: 三處統一同一預設值（建議統一為生產實際用的 3，或集中到單一 constexpr）；DistanceConfig/DistanceMatrix 預設改 3 以對齊 Config，避免測試/生產分歧

all_findings.title: 距離度量預設不一致：Config 預設 BERNOULLI，DistanceConfig 預設 NHD
all_findings.description: Config::distance_metrics 預設 {BERNOULLI}，但 DistanceConfig::metric 預設 NHD。生產路徑 RegionProcessor.cpp:419 用 distance_metrics_[0] 覆寫，故生產跑 BERNOULLI；但直接建構 DistanceConfig 的任何路徑（測試、回退分支 l.421 在 metrics 為空時設 NHD）會用 NHD。
all_findings.why_wrong: 不同度量（BERNOULLI 機率距離 vs NHD normalized Hamming）給出不同距離矩陣與分群結果。預設分歧使非生產路徑默默用 NHD，與宣稱主度量 BERNOULLI 不一致，影響測試代表性與『直接用 DistanceCalculator』的呼叫者。
all_findings.evidence: Config.hpp:40 `std::vector<DistanceMetricType> distance_metrics = {DistanceMetricType::BERNOULLI};`；DistanceMatrix.hpp:22 `DistanceMetricType metric = DistanceMetricType::NHD;`
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: 非生產路徑默默套 NHD 而非 BERNOULLI，方向使測試距離矩陣與生產不同
all_findings.quantification_method: 靜態確認所有 DistanceConfig 使用點是否皆覆寫 metric；無需重跑
all_findings.fix_direction: DistanceConfig::metric 預設改為與 Config 一致（BERNOULLI），或集中度量預設到單一來源

all_findings.title: 統計 gating/穩定性門檻寫死在 header 預設值（gating_p=0.1, min_cramers_v=0.1, chi2_valid_ratio=0.8, ari_stable>=0.2, bootstrap early-stop 0.2/0.9）未進 config
all_findings.description: 多個影響結論的判定門檻以 struct 預設常數寫死：GlobalTestConfig gating_p_threshold=0.1 / min_cramers_v=0.1 / chi_square_min_valid_ratio=0.8；BootstrapResult.stable 註解『True if mean_ari >= 0.2』；BootstrapConfig early_stop_low=0.2 / early_stop_high=0.9。這些是 ASM 顯著性 gating（gating_p>0.1 即跳過 local/structure 測試）與 cluster 穩定性閾值，直接決定哪些位點被判 Strong/Subclone/Weak/Noise。
all_findings.why_wrong: gating_p_threshold=0.1 比常見 alpha=0.05 寬鬆一倍，且寫死無法做 sensitivity analysis；min_cramers_v=0.1 effect-size gate 與 ARI>=0.2 stable 門檻皆為任意 magic number，未文件化選擇依據。寫死在 header 預設值使調參需改 code 重編，且若不同分析階段建立不同 GlobalTestConfig，門檻可能不一致。屬『應進 config 卻寫死的閾值』。
all_findings.evidence: GlobalTest.hpp:29 `double gating_p_threshold = 0.1;`；GlobalTest.hpp:32 `double min_cramers_v = 0.1;`；Stats.hpp:282 `bool stable = true;  // True if mean_ari >= 0.2`
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: gating_p=0.1（非 0.05）使更多位點通過 gate 進下游測試，方向使 passed_gate/Strong 計數偏多；ARI>=0.2 寬鬆 stable 門檻使弱結構也標 stable
all_findings.quantification_method: sensitivity：以 gating_p ∈{0.05,0.1} 與 cramers_v gate ∈{0,0.1} 重跑統計，比較 verification_class 分佈與 passed_gate 比例；檔案 significance_summary.csv
all_findings.fix_direction: 將 gating_p_threshold/min_cramers_v/chi_square_min_valid_ratio/ari stable 門檻提升為 Config 可調參數並文件化預設依據；確保全 pipeline 用同一組門檻

all_findings.title: min_reads_per_group / 最小 read 門檻在各 header 預設分歧（3 vs 5），同一統計家族用不同最小樣本數
all_findings.description: 各統計模組的最小組內 read/最小樣本門檻預設不一致：GlobalTest::test_hp_fine min_reads_per_group=3、LabelTestConfig min_reads_per_group=3、StructureTestConfig min_reads_for_permanova=5、compute_per_cpg_asm min_reads_per_group=5、build_normal_baseline min_normal_reads=5/min_cpg_coverage=3。同一份 region 的不同子測試套不同最小樣本門檻。
all_findings.why_wrong: HP fine-grained test 用 3、PERMANOVA 用 5、per-CpG ASM 用 5——意味同一 region 在某測試有效、在另一測試被排除，造成欄位間覆蓋率不一致與『某些 metric 有值、某些 NaN』的不對稱。3 vs 5 也影響小群被排除的閾值，進而改變 n_valid_groups 與 fine_n_groups。屬預設不一致 + 應集中管理的門檻。
all_findings.evidence: GlobalTest.hpp:78 `int min_reads_per_group = 3`；StructureTest.hpp:32 `int min_reads_for_permanova = 5;`；PerCpgAsm.hpp:66 `int min_reads_per_group = 5`
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: 不同最小門檻使各 metric 的有效 region 集合不同，跨欄位比較（如 fine_f vs per_cpg_frac_sig）在邊界 region 不可比
all_findings.quantification_method: 統計各 metric 的 valid/NaN 比例在 read 數 3-5 邊界的 region；確認門檻分歧造成的覆蓋差。檔案 RegionResult TSV 各 *_valid 欄
all_findings.fix_direction: 集中最小樣本門檻到 Config 或單一常數組，文件化每測試為何用 3 或 5；對齊同家族測試的最小門檻

all_findings.title: MethylCall(uint32_t pos,...) 建構子參數型別與 int32_t ref_pos 欄位不符（signed/unsigned narrowing）
all_findings.description: struct MethylCall 欄位 `int32_t ref_pos`（l.15），但雙參數 ctor 簽名為 `MethylCall(uint32_t pos, float prob) : ref_pos(pos)`（l.20）。uint32_t → int32_t 的隱式轉換對正常基因組座標（< 2^31）無害，但型別不一致且若 pos 來源曾為大 uint 會 wrap 成負。
all_findings.why_wrong: hg38 座標遠小於 2^31，實務無溢位，但 (a) ctor 參數型別與欄位型別不一致是 struct 不變量瑕疵；(b) 與 MethylationParser 內部 build_seq_to_ref_map 回傳 int32_t（含 -1 哨兵）的型別約定不一致；(c) -Wconversion 下會告警。屬型別/單位細節。
all_findings.evidence: MethylationParser.hpp:15 `int32_t ref_pos;`；MethylationParser.hpp:20 `MethylCall(uint32_t pos, float prob) : ref_pos(pos), probability(prob) {}`
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: 正常座標範圍無 runtime 影響；僅型別一致性與潛在 -Wconversion 告警
all_findings.quantification_method: 靜態：-Wconversion 編譯告警計數；無需重跑
all_findings.fix_direction: ctor 參數改 int32_t pos 與欄位型別一致；或欄位改 uint32_t 並全程用無號座標（但需保留 -1 缺值哨兵則應維持 int32_t + 改 ctor 參數）

all_findings.title: CoverageCategory / QualityTier 邊界門檻同時寫在 enum 文件註解與 RegionProcessor.cpp 邏輯，雙來源易漂移
all_findings.description: CoverageCategory enum 註解硬編碼分界（<0.5x / 0.5-0.8 / 0.8-1.2 / 1.2-1.5 / 1.5-2.0 / >2.0，Stats.hpp:482-489）與 QualityTier（>=70/40-69/<40，l.508-512），同一組門檻又寫在 RegionProcessor.cpp:170-180 的 if-else 與 quality_score 計算。兩處為各自獨立的字面常數，非共用單一來源。
all_findings.why_wrong: 邊界門檻在 header 註解與 .cpp 邏輯各寫一份，改其一忘改另一即文件與行為漂移（讀者依 enum 註解理解，實際行為依 .cpp）。例如若 .cpp 的 <=1.2 改為 <1.2，註解仍寫 0.8-1.2 會誤導。屬應集中的分類門檻常數。
all_findings.evidence: Stats.hpp:484 `CNV_LOSS_CANDIDATE = 0,  // < 0.5x expected coverage`；RegionProcessor.cpp:170 `if (coverage_multiple < 0.5) {`（兩處各自寫死 0.5）
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: 目前一致則無 runtime 影響；風險是未來單邊修改造成 enum 註解（文件）與分類邏輯不符
all_findings.quantification_method: 靜態 diff：核對 Stats.hpp 註解門檻與 RegionProcessor.cpp 邏輯門檻是否逐一相符；無需重跑
all_findings.fix_direction: 將 CoverageCategory/QualityTier 邊界提為 constexpr 常數（單一來源），enum 註解與 .cpp 分類皆引用之；或在 Stats.hpp 提供 classify_coverage(double, config) 由邏輯與註解共用

all_findings.title: n_permutations=999 與 min_branch_length=1e-6 等模擬/數值 magic number 寫死於 header 預設
all_findings.description: permutation/MC 數與數值 epsilon 以 magic number 寫死預設：permutation n=999（LabelTest/StructureTest）、bootstrap n_iterations=200、Fisher MC min=2000/max=10000、ClusteringConfig min_branch_length=1e-6。n=999 是 permutation p 的常規（最小可達 p=0.001），但與 bootstrap 200、Fisher MC 2000/10000 並列時，各測試的 Monte Carlo 解析度不一致（permutation p 下限 1e-3、Fisher MC p 下限約 1e-4），多重比較校正時 p 的可達精度不對齊。
all_findings.why_wrong: n_permutations=999 使任何 permutation p 最小為 0.001，若後續對數千位點做 BH-FDR，p 的離散下限會限制可偵測的最小 FDR；而 Fisher MC 上限 10000 給更細 p。各測試 MC 解析度不一致是方法學細節（非錯誤），但寫死預設使無法針對需要更高解析度的位點提高 permutation 數。屬風格/可配置性 INFO。
all_findings.evidence: LabelTest.hpp:31 `int n_permutations = 999;`；FisherExact.hpp:28 `int min_mc_samples = 2000;`；HierarchicalClustering.hpp:36 `double min_branch_length = 1e-6;`
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: permutation p 下限 1e-3 限制最小可報 p；對需極小 p 的強訊號位點 p 被截在 0.001（保守方向，不會假陽性）
all_findings.quantification_method: 統計各 permanova/label p 欄達到下限 1/(n+1) 的位點比例；若大量位點 p=0.001 表示解析度受限。檔案 significance_summary.csv 的 *_p 欄
all_findings.fix_direction: 將 n_permutations/n_iterations/MC bounds 提為 Config 可調；文件化 permutation p 下限與 FDR 互動；對齊各測試的 MC 解析度或在報告標註

verified_high.title: expected_coverage 寫死 75.0 散落 6+ 處（Config 預設 0.0 但自由函式/RegionResult ctor/Stats 註解皆 75.0），CNV 分類與 coverage_multiple 全繫於此
verified_high.description: diploid coverage baseline 75.0x 以 magic number 形式散落多檔：compute_coverage_multiple(int, double expected_coverage = 75.0) (RegionProcessor.hpp:522)、RegionResult ctor diploid_coverage_used(75.0) (l.328)、DiploidEstimate 註解 fallback 75.0 (l.525)、Stats.hpp QualityFlags 註解『normalized to expected 75x』『NumReads/75.0』(l.525-526)。Config::expected_coverage 預設 0.0(=auto KDE)，但所有 fallback 與函式預設參數寫死 75.0。
verified_high.why_wrong: coverage_multiple = num_reads/expected_coverage，再以 0.5/0.8/1.2/1.5/2.0 倍門檻切 CNV_Loss/Low/Normal/Elevated/Gain/High_Copy 與 LOH 判定。75.0 是樣本特定值——7 樣本實際 diploid coverage 不同。若 KDE 估計失敗 fallback 到全域 75.0，所有 coverage_category/CNV/quality_score 對該樣本系統性偏移。此即 MEMORY.md 記錄之 expected_coverage hardcoded 75.0 infra bug。
verified_high.evidence: RegionProcessor.hpp:522 `double compute_coverage_multiple(int num_reads, double expected_coverage = 75.0);` ; RegionProcessor.hpp:328 `diploid_coverage_used(75.0),` ; Stats.hpp:526 `double coverage_multiple = 1.0;     // NumReads/75.0`
verified_high.effect_hypothesis: 當 KDE auto-estimate 未啟用或 fallback 觸發時，coverage_category 與 CNV gain/loss 計數對非~75x 樣本系統性錯分；下游 LOH_subtype/quality_score/quality_tier 連動偏移
verified_high.quantification_method: 對每樣本比較 estimate_diploid_coverage() 實際估值 vs 75.0；統計 RegionResult.diploid_coverage_used 欄位中 ==75.0(fallback)的比例；重算 coverage_multiple 與 coverage_category 看分佈位移。檔案：output 各 region significance_summary.csv 的 coverage 相關欄；指令 grep diploid_coverage_used 各樣本 TSV
verified_high.fix_direction: 建立單一 constexpr/config 來源（如 Config::diploid_coverage_fallback），移除自由函式預設參數 75.0 與 ctor 寫死值；fallback 值與 KDE 估計皆從 Config 取；Stats.hpp 註解改為引用 config 而非寫死 75.0

verdict.reasoning:
Literal observations are correct (75.0 at RegionProcessor.hpp:328,522,525; Stats.hpp:526; Config::expected_coverage=0.0 at Config.hpp:56; CNV thresholds 0.5/0.8/1.2/1.5/2.0 at RegionProcessor.cpp:169-182), but the substantive "infra bug" claim is refuted by a two-pass architecture.

(1) 75.0 is a Pass-1 PLACEHOLDER, not the final classifier input. RegionProcessor.cpp:1694-1695 sets coverage_multiple with the 75.0 default but is explicitly commented `// Pass 1 default; overwritten by Pass 2`.

(2) Pass 2 (RegionProcessor.cpp:678-705) recomputes coverage_multiple / diploid_coverage_used / coverage_category / quality_score / quality_tier for EVERY successful region using a SAMPLE-SPECIFIC diploid_coverage. That value comes either from the user flag `--expected-coverage` (ArgParser.hpp:122 → Config.hpp:56 → line 681-682) or from KDE auto-estimation `estimate_diploid_coverage()` (lines 78-162, histogram mode of NumReads, validated vs SEQC2 at 7.5% error). This directly addresses the finding's core worry ("7 樣本實際 diploid coverage 不同") — the baseline IS per-sample calibrated, not globally fixed at 75.

(3) The MEMORY.md "expected_coverage hardcoded 75.0 infra bug" the finding cites is a FIXED historical state. That memory required "修 KDE 啟用並重跑"; KDE is now implemented, wired into Pass 2, AND covered by a 9-test regression suite tests/test_diploid_coverage.cpp (incl. ModeNear60, ModeNear90, FallbackOnInsufficientData, and the [C1] regression ModeAt75NotMisclassifiedAsFallback). The finding invokes stale memory as if current.

Residual truth: when KDE fails (<100 valid regions / narrow histogram / estimate out of [10,300]) it falls back to 75.0 — but this is a guarded, LOG_WARN-emitting fallback ("CovM values will NOT be per-sample calibrated"), not silent systematic bias, and never fires on the project's powered datasets (hundreds of thousands of regions). At most this is a minor code-cleanliness note (consolidate the duplicated 75.0 literal into one named constant), not a HIGH-severity infra bug. The finding conflates "magic-number-appears-textually-6x" (true, cosmetic) with "baseline broken / systematically biased per sample" (false — KDE-calibrated, test-covered).

perReviewer.area: TESTS — unit test rigor audit (bug-pinning, self-fulfilling asserts, trivial-path-only coverage, degenerate-data nulls)
perReviewer.notes:
Verified positives (good practice, NOT findings): (1) BERNOULLI distance oracle values 0.365328/0.168595/0.863754 are independently reproducible — I recomputed them in python from raw_matrix and they match exactly to 1e-6; test comments correctly label them 'python oracle'. (2) log_factorial validated against R lfactorial() to 1e-6; Fisher2x2 LadyTastingTea/extreme-separation validated against R fisher.test; chi_square {20,0,0,20}=40 and combo_code=101 are hand-verifiable and correct; Fisher2x2 extreme-separation underflow guard (p>0 for {100,0,0,100}) is a genuine numerical-stability test. (3) PERMANOVA SS tests (test_structure_bootstrap.cpp:364-463) explicitly target the catastrophic-cancellation / zero-within-variance fixes with derived analytic expectations — these are strong regression tests, not bug-pins. (4) FullPipeline_ClearASM (a=6,b=0,c=0,d=6 per CpG, two-sided p≈2/924≈0.00216, BH over 5 → all <0.05) is arithmetically sound. (5) HeuristicScore test correctly matches compute_heuristic_score (SignificanceAnalyzer.cpp:378-413): p=0.001→3 + cramers_v 0.5*2=1 →4>3; dispersion *0.5→2<4.

Did NOT find any test that pins a known-wrong Δβ value (the 'halved Δβ=-0.054' artifact lives in the Python MSA path, not in PerCpgAsm.cpp which uses a clean val>0.5 threshold with no 5mC/5hmC double-counting). No test asserts an uncorrected genome-wide p as final; BH-FDR is within-region by design.

Confidence calibration: TESTS-1 (HIGH, 0.8) is the most important — the data-ingestion path is genuinely untested. TESTS-2 (MEDIUM, 0.62) flags a degenerate null that, if fixed, may surface a real over-dispersion methodology issue for the per-CpG-ASM reviewer to quantify on real data. The rest are LOW coverage/verification-strength issues, not correctness bugs.

all_findings.title: BAM MM/ML methylation parsing → read×CpG matrix has NO unit test (only filter-to-zero negative path covered)
all_findings.lines: test_read_aggregator.cpp:79-153 (all aggregate tests assert num_reads()==0); test_read_parser.cpp:86-194 (HP-tag only)
all_findings.description: The core data-ingestion step — parsing ONT MM/ML tags into the read×CpG methylation matrix (raw_matrix / binary_matrix) — is the input to every downstream statistic (distance, clustering, Fisher Δβ, ASM). Yet there is no MethylationParser or MatrixBuilder test file, and the only ingestion tests (test_read_aggregator) exclusively assert that bare/low-MAPQ/secondary/supplementary reads get filtered to num_reads()==0. No test ever feeds a read with valid MM/ML/HP tags and verifies the resulting methylation values, strand handling, or 5mC/5hmC handling. grep for MM|ML|methyl|5mC|5hmC across tests/ returns zero hits in the parsing path.
all_findings.why_wrong: A test suite that only exercises the negative/trivial path (everything filtered to empty) gives false confidence: a bug in MM/ML offset parsing, strand-flip CpG coordinate handling, or 5mC/5hmC collapse would produce a wrong methylation matrix and silently propagate to Δβ/ASM/distance — and zero unit tests would fail. The project's own memory flags 5mC/5hmC collapse and strand resolution as historically error-prone (MSA Level1 double-column halving artifact, strand parsing). The most failure-prone, scientifically load-bearing step is the least tested.
all_findings.evidence: test_read_aggregator.cpp:97-99 `bam1_t* b = bam_init1(); auto result = agg.aggregate({b}, snv, "", 0); EXPECT_EQ(result.matrix_builder.num_reads(), 0);` — every aggregate test asserts 0 reads. `ls tests/ | grep -iE 'methyl|matrix_build|parser'` → only test_read_parser.cpp, which (lines 86-194) tests only HP-tag passthrough/demotion, never methylation values.
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: Coverage gap, not a wrong number per se. A regression in MM/ML→matrix parsing (strand, 5mC/5hmC, offset) would not be caught by any unit test; impact would surface only in end-to-end real-data runs and could corrupt Δβ/ASM/distance silently.
all_findings.quantification_method: Run `gcov`/`lcov` over src/core/MethylationParser.cpp + MatrixBuilder.cpp after `ctest`; report line/branch coverage of the MM/ML decode and strand-handling branches. Expect near-0% on the positive decode path. Cross-check with a hand-built bam1_t carrying a known MM/ML tag and assert expected raw_matrix entries.
all_findings.fix_direction: Add a MethylationParser/MatrixBuilder positive-path test: construct (or load a tiny fixture) read with known MM:Z:/ML:B:C tags on both strands incl. 5mC and 5hmC, assert exact raw_matrix/binary_matrix entries and CpG coordinates against an independent (pysam/modkit) oracle.

all_findings.title: FullPipeline_NoASM null is degenerate (zero within-group variance) — cannot detect a mis-specified per-CpG test
all_findings.description: FullPipeline_NoASM builds 12 reads all with raw=0.9 and binary all-1 for both HP groups, then asserts fisher_n_sig==0 and fisher_frac_sig==0. Because every read at every CpG is methylated, each per-CpG 2x2 table is {a=6,b=0,c=6,d=0} (all-meth, no unmethylated cell), so Fisher p is trivially 1.0 by construction. This is a no-variance degenerate case, not a realistic 'methylation varies but HP1≈HP2' null.
all_findings.why_wrong: The point of a NoASM null test is to confirm the per-CpG Fisher pipeline does NOT produce false positives when reads vary but the two HP groups have the same distribution. The chosen data removes all variance, so even a badly mis-specified or over-confident test (e.g., one ignoring read-level CpG dependence / over-dispersion) would still return p=1 here. The test therefore cannot catch the most relevant failure mode (inflated significance under realistic mixed methylation). Combined with the fact that per-CpG Fisher treats each read as an independent Bernoulli draw (no over-dispersion handling), a true null with within-group variance is exactly where false positives would appear and is exactly what is NOT tested.
all_findings.evidence: test_per_cpg_asm.cpp:218-223 `raw.setConstant(0.9); ... binary.setOnes();` then 232-233 `EXPECT_EQ(result.fisher_n_sig, 0); EXPECT_NEAR(result.fisher_frac_sig, 0.0, 1e-10);`. Source PerCpgAsm.cpp:298-305 builds table a=hp1_meth,b=hp1_unmeth,c=hp2_meth,d=hp2_unmeth → with all-meth data b=d=0.
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: The unit test passes vacuously; it does not validate calibration of the per-CpG Fisher null under within-group methylation variance. No effect on production numbers, but a real over-dispersion-driven false-positive in per-CpG ASM would slip past CI.
all_findings.quantification_method: Add a null with realistic variance (e.g., each read i.i.d. Bernoulli(0.5) at each CpG for BOTH HP groups, repeated over many seeds) and measure the empirical false-positive rate of fisher_frac_sig at q<0.05; compare to nominal 0.05. If FPR >> 0.05, the per-CpG test is anti-conservative (CpG-dependence / over-dispersion not handled).
all_findings.fix_direction: Add a variance-present NoASM null test (identical Bernoulli(p) draws for HP1 and HP2, p in (0,1)) asserting fisher_frac_sig stays near nominal; if it inflates, this is a real methodology bug (over-dispersion) rather than a test bug — escalate to the per-CpG ASM stats reviewer.

all_findings.title: Magic constant 75.0 pinned as default/fallback diploid coverage in tests (matches known infra bug)
all_findings.description: The diploid-coverage tests hard-pin 75.0 as both the compute_coverage_multiple default expected coverage (DefaultExpectedIs75) and the RegionResult.diploid_coverage_used default (DiploidCoverageUsedDefault), and as the fallback in three estimate_diploid_coverage tests. Project memory (`expected_coverage hardcoded 75.0 infra bug`) records that all 7 master-dataset samples shared this default, which biases coverage normalization per sample.
all_findings.why_wrong: Pinning 75.0 as the canonical default in unit tests freezes a sample-agnostic magic constant into the contract, making it harder to migrate to per-sample/config-driven expected coverage and effectively endorsing the known infra bug at the test level. The constant belongs in config, not as an asserted default. (Mitigating: the KDE estimation path itself IS tested — ModeNear60/90/At75 — so this is only about the fallback/default magic number, hence LOW.)
all_findings.evidence: test_diploid_coverage.cpp:28 `EXPECT_DOUBLE_EQ(compute_coverage_multiple(75), 1.0);` ; :124 `EXPECT_DOUBLE_EQ(r.diploid_coverage_used, 75.0);` ; :38/45/56 `EXPECT_DOUBLE_EQ(est.value, 75.0); EXPECT_TRUE(est.used_fallback);`
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: No direct numeric error in the tested fallback logic; risk is governance — the magic constant is normalized as 'correct' and the per-sample expected-coverage fix is discouraged. Downstream coverage_multiple values for samples whose true diploid coverage != 75x are biased when fallback triggers.
all_findings.quantification_method: Cross-reference state/invalidation/ + the KDE-fix memory: for each of the 7 master samples, compare KDE-estimated diploid coverage vs 75.0; quantify % of regions where used_fallback=true and the implied coverage_multiple bias = true_cov/75.
all_findings.fix_direction: Move 75.0 to a named config constant (e.g., kDefaultExpectedCoverageFallback) and assert against the config value; add a test that per-sample KDE override is actually used in the pipeline (not just computed).

all_findings.title: Determinism test self-admittedly does NOT verify different seed changes p-value
all_findings.description: Determinism_SameSeedProducesSameResult builds a3 with seed=99 (comment: 'Different seed') but never asserts that r3's permutation p-value differs from r1/r2. The trailing comment explicitly concedes 'we don't assert its p differs since perfectly separated data produces p=1/(n+1) regardless of seed.' So the test only confirms same-seed reproducibility, never that the seed actually drives permutation order.
all_findings.why_wrong: A determinism guarantee has two halves: (a) same seed → same result, (b) seed actually enters the RNG (otherwise a bug that ignores the seed entirely would also pass (a)). By choosing perfectly-separated data where p hits the 1/(n+1) floor for every permutation, the test makes (b) untestable, and a3 is dead weight. A regression where structure_config.seed silently stops propagating (the very thing the test claims to validate per its own docstring at 232-235) would not be caught.
all_findings.evidence: test_significance_analyzer.cpp:253 `auto a3 = make_analyzer(99);  // Different seed` ; 290-293 comment `// r3 uses seed=99; we don't assert its p differs since perfectly separated data produces p=1/(n+1) regardless of seed.` — a3/r3 are computed but never asserted against r1.
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: Weak guarantee: seed-propagation regression could pass CI. No production number affected directly.
all_findings.quantification_method: Construct borderline (non-separated) data where permutation p is in (0,1) and NOT at the 1/(n+1) floor; assert r1.p (seed 42) != r3.p (seed 99) with high probability, OR assert that shuffling with a known seed reproduces an externally-computed permutation order.
all_findings.fix_direction: Replace the perfectly-separated dataset for the cross-seed check with borderline data and assert seed=42 vs seed=99 yield different permutation p-values; keep same-seed equality as is.

all_findings.title: Several statistical asserts check only range/non-NaN, not an independent oracle (weak verification of Monte-Carlo & entropy paths)
all_findings.description: FisherRxC_BasicTest runs the R×C Fisher-Freeman-Halton Monte Carlo on a 3x2 table but asserts only 0<=p<=1 and n_samples>0 — no comparison to an R fisher.test(...,simulate.p.value) reference. NME_WithMissing asserts only that NME is in [0,1] and non-NaN. By contrast the 2x2 Fisher tests, log_factorial, and chi_square ARE checked against R/hand values (good), so the gap is specifically the RxC-MC and missing-value NME branches.
all_findings.why_wrong: A range-only assertion passes for almost any implementation, including one with a wrong null-distribution construction (e.g., wrong margin-conditioning in the FFH sampler) or a wrong missing-value/H_max normalization in NME. These are exactly the branches where subtle methodology errors live (FFH margin sampling; NME H_max=log2(valid_cpg_count) vs log2(min(reads,2^cpgs))). The strong oracle coverage elsewhere makes these two untriangulated branches stand out.
all_findings.evidence: test_significance_stats.cpp:283-285 `EXPECT_GE(result.p_value, 0.0); EXPECT_LE(result.p_value, 1.0); EXPECT_GT(result.n_samples, 0);` (no reference p). test_per_cpg_asm.cpp:150-152 `EXPECT_FALSE(std::isnan(nme)); EXPECT_GE(nme, 0.0); EXPECT_LE(nme, 1.0);` (no expected value despite a hand-computable answer: 2 patterns 11N/00N over 2 valid CpGs → H=1, H_max=2 → NME=0.5).
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: Verification gap on the FFH-MC null and NME-with-missing normalization; a wrong FFH p or wrong NME normalization would pass CI.
all_findings.quantification_method: For FisherRxC: compare result.p_value (fixed seed) to R fisher.test(matrix(c(10,5,3,12,8,7),3,2,byrow=T), simulate.p.value=TRUE, B=1e5) within MC tolerance. For NME_WithMissing: assert EXPECT_NEAR(nme, 0.5, 1e-10) per hand-calc and confirm the source matches.
all_findings.fix_direction: Add an R/scipy reference value to FisherRxC_BasicTest (seeded, with tolerance) and replace NME_WithMissing's range check with the exact expected 0.5; same for any other range-only MC/entropy asserts.

verified_high.title: BAM MM/ML methylation parsing → read×CpG matrix has NO unit test (only filter-to-zero negative path covered)
verified_high.lines: test_read_aggregator.cpp:79-153 (all aggregate tests assert num_reads()==0); test_read_parser.cpp:86-194 (HP-tag only)
verified_high.description: The core data-ingestion step — parsing ONT MM/ML tags into the read×CpG methylation matrix (raw_matrix / binary_matrix) — is the input to every downstream statistic (distance, clustering, Fisher Δβ, ASM). Yet there is no MethylationParser or MatrixBuilder test file, and the only ingestion tests (test_read_aggregator) exclusively assert that bare/low-MAPQ/secondary/supplementary reads get filtered to num_reads()==0. No test ever feeds a read with valid MM/ML/HP tags and verifies the resulting methylation values, strand handling, or 5mC/5hmC handling. grep for MM|ML|methyl|5mC|5hmC across tests/ returns zero hits in the parsing path.
verified_high.why_wrong: A test suite that only exercises the negative/trivial path (everything filtered to empty) gives false confidence: a bug in MM/ML offset parsing, strand-flip CpG coordinate handling, or 5mC/5hmC collapse would produce a wrong methylation matrix and silently propagate to Δβ/ASM/distance — and zero unit tests would fail. The project's own memory flags 5mC/5hmC collapse and strand resolution as historically error-prone (MSA Level1 double-column halving artifact, strand parsing). The most failure-prone, scientifically load-bearing step is the least tested.
verified_high.evidence: test_read_aggregator.cpp:97-99 `bam1_t* b = bam_init1(); auto result = agg.aggregate({b}, snv, "", 0); EXPECT_EQ(result.matrix_builder.num_reads(), 0);` — every aggregate test asserts 0 reads. `ls tests/ | grep -iE 'methyl|matrix_build|parser'` → only test_read_parser.cpp, which (lines 86-194) tests only HP-tag passthrough/demotion, never methylation values.
verified_high.effect_hypothesis: Coverage gap, not a wrong number per se. A regression in MM/ML→matrix parsing (strand, 5mC/5hmC, offset) would not be caught by any unit test; impact would surface only in end-to-end real-data runs and could corrupt Δβ/ASM/distance silently.
verified_high.quantification_method: Run `gcov`/`lcov` over src/core/MethylationParser.cpp + MatrixBuilder.cpp after `ctest`; report line/branch coverage of the MM/ML decode and strand-handling branches. Expect near-0% on the positive decode path. Cross-check with a hand-built bam1_t carrying a known MM/ML tag and assert expected raw_matrix entries.
verified_high.fix_direction: Add a MethylationParser/MatrixBuilder positive-path test: construct (or load a tiny fixture) read with known MM:Z:/ML:B:C tags on both strands incl. 5mC and 5hmC, assert exact raw_matrix/binary_matrix entries and CpG coordinates against an independent (pysam/modkit) oracle.

verdict.reasoning: Tried to refute on three fronts; all failed. (1) The parsing code exists and is exactly as described: src/core/MethylationParser.cpp (290 lines) parse_read() reads MM/ML aux tags (lines 20-21), branches on 5mC vs 5hmC ("C+m?"/"C+h?", lines 41-66), and contains intricate reverse-strand BACKWARD-iteration CpG coordinate logic explicitly self-labeled "CRITICAL" (lines 103-157). This is precisely the strand-flip + 5mC/5hmC collapse logic the project memory flags as historically error-prone. (2) Zero test coverage confirmed mechanically: grep across all of tests/ for 'MethylationParser|MatrixBuilder|parse_read|parse_mm_tag|MethylCall' returns NO hits. (3) The test executable in CMakeLists.txt:155-170 lists 13 explicit sources; there is no test_methylation_parser.cpp or test_matrix_builder.cpp. The ingestion tests are as the finding states: test_read_aggregator.cpp every aggregate() test asserts num_reads()==0 (empty/low-MAPQ/BAM_FSECONDARY/BAM_FSUPPLEMENTARY, lines 79-153) — only the filter-to-zero negative path; test_read_parser.cpp:86-255 tests only HP-tag passthrough/demotion, never methylation values. I checked whether test_per_cpg_asm.cpp rescues coverage: it does NOT — it feeds synthetic Eigen raw/binary matrices directly (make_meth_mat, 0 'bam' references) and exercises only the downstream Fisher/NME/epipolymorphism statistics, bypassing MM/ML ingestion entirely. No gtest integration test feeds a real BAM with MM/ML/HP tags and asserts resulting methylation values, strand handling, or 5mC/5hmC handling. The most failure-prone, scientifically load-bearing step (input to Δβ/ASM/distance/clustering) has no unit test, and the only ingestion tests exclusively assert filtered-to-empty. The finding is accurate, not a reviewer misunderstanding. Severity note: this is a genuine test-coverage gap / quality risk, not a demonstrated live defect producing wrong numbers today — the parser may be empirically correct downstream. That keeps it at HIGH (real risk on the most load-bearing path) rather than CRITICAL (no proven incorrect output). Confidence high on the factual claim; the only residual uncertainty is whether an out-of-suite manual/integration validation exists outside the gtest harness, which would not change the unit-test gap.

perReviewer.area: PYASM — 統計方法學稽核 of Python ASM analysis scripts (research/tsg_promoter_asm_reviewer/scripts/) producing paper ASM numbers
perReviewer.notes:
Scope: I deep-read the 8 most paper-relevant ASM stat scripts (+18_dual_axis_pivot as the TSV producer, +49 measurement audit for collapse semantics). Checked: null/permutation construction, Fisher vs beta-binomial, multiple testing, AUC confound (within-group/AF-bin/permutation), partial correlation, MSA Level1 5mC/5hmC collapse, single-sample caveat handling, HP-shuffle null unit.

Things I checked and found CORRECT (not reported):
- 59 genome-wide HP-shuffle null: pools main+sub reads and permutes READ assignment into same-size groups (59:150-160). Read is the correct exchangeable unit for the per-read collapsed beta; null respects finite-sample noise floor. Excess-over-null framing is sound.
- 26 perm null shuffles the is_tp LABEL 2000× and recomputes AUC (26:58-71); two-sided p = (#|null-0.5|>=|obs-0.5| + 1)/(n+1) with +1 correction — correct permutation p.
- 26 AUC via MWU U/(n_pos*n_neg) (26:47-55) is the correct rank AUC; per-position aggregation (one row per site, 26:88-97) avoids the read-instance pseudo-replication that would inflate n. Label mutual-exclusivity is checked (26:99-102).
- 22 Fisher exact for categorical LOH/hypo + Bonferroni/6 + explicit non-independence caveat (22:82-84) — honest.
- max-collapse in 33/34/49 takes max over the two mod rows per (read,CpG) and dedups read-per-CpG (33:48-49, 34:48-50) — this is NOT the 5mC+5hmC double-row砍半 double-counting bug from the old MSA Level1 history; it correctly collapses to one value.
- Single-sample HCC1395 caveat is explicitly carried in code/metadata for 03/26/49 (e.g. 26:200 'single sample').

Main systemic issues (PYASM-1..7): the per-CpG Wilcoxon dependency under-estimate (HIGH, affects the significance/strong-ASM counts but NOT the Δβ effect sizes), absence of any FDR across positions/loci, a 5mC-only vs max-collapse口徑 split feeding the same BRCA2 number, magic cis-candidate threshold, the AF gate of the AUC confound protocol being un-runnable on the current TSV, duplicated/divergent window constants (±600 vs ±1000), and germline-axis 'imprinting' labels without a het null. None of these flips the existence/direction of ASM (Δβ point estimates and the read-permutation excess-over-null are robust); they bias significance COUNTS and mechanism LABELS, which is where the paper text must be careful.

Did not deep-read 73_aggregate_ism.py / 44_q3_reverse_predict.py / the modkit cross-val (54/55) within budget — recommend a follow-up pass on 44_q3 (reverse-prediction dAUC) for the same AF-confound and on 73 for any genome-wide aggregation口徑.

all_findings.title: per-CpG Wilcoxon treats spatially-autocorrelated CpGs within a ±600/1000bp window as independent paired units → p systematically under-estimated (drives strong-ASM gate + credible-locus selection + AUC inputs)
all_findings.description: The core per-locus significance number `wilcoxon_p` is computed by `stats.wilcoxon(pg, ps)` where pg/ps are per-CpG betas of all CpGs in a ±600bp (18/57/59) or ±1000bp (03) window (paired_test:106-116). Wilcoxon signed-rank assumes the N paired differences are i.i.d. exchangeable. CpG methylation within a sub-kb window is strongly spatially autocorrelated (co-methylation blocks) AND each per-CpG beta is itself an average of correlated reads. So the effective number of independent units is far smaller than n_paired_cpg. This inflates the test statistic's significance (p too small). The same anti-conservative p then feeds: the strong-ASM Bonferroni gate (22_tp_vs_fp_stats_confirm.py:26-27 uses `wilcoxon_p < 0.05/len(d)`), the 'significant regime' AUC subset (26_H5:86,98), and the credible-loci annotation that 57/59 read back.
all_findings.why_wrong: Wilcoxon over correlated per-CpG betas violates the independence/exchangeability assumption; window-level p is anti-conservative. Any downstream count of 'significant ASM loci', the Bonferroni survivors in 22, and the 'sig' AUC stratum in 26 inherit the bias.
all_findings.evidence: 18_dual_axis_pivot.py:104-116 `def paired_test(cpgs, g_germ, g_som): pg, ps = [], []  for mpos, hpd in cpgs.items(): ... pg.append(bg); ps.append(bs)  ... w_p = float(stats.wilcoxon(pg, ps).pvalue)` — paired units = per-CpG window betas, no autocorrelation/cluster adjustment. 03_step4:157 `stats.wilcoxon(paired_g, paired_s, ...)` over per-CpG betas in ±1000bp window identically.
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: Number of loci declared 'significant ASM' (and the Bonferroni-surviving strong set) is likely inflated vs a dependency-aware test; absolute Δβ point estimates (mean_delta) are unaffected, only the p-values / significance counts shift.
all_findings.quantification_method: Re-run paired_test with a block-bootstrap or cluster-robust p (resample reads, not CpGs, or collapse co-methylated CpGs to one effective unit) on asm_dualaxis_tp.tsv / asm_dualaxis_fp.tsv; compare count of wilcoxon_p<0.05 and Bonferroni survivors (22) before vs after. Also compute the autocorrelation of per-CpG deltas within windows to estimate effective n.
all_findings.fix_direction: Report Δβ as the primary effect (already done) and treat per-CpG Wilcoxon p only as a descriptive ranking, OR replace with a read-permutation null (shuffle HP labels among reads, recompute window mean Δβ) which respects the read as the exchangeable unit. Do not gate 'significant ASM' on this p alone.

all_findings.title: No multiple-testing correction across the 38 key positions (cross-sample synthesis) nor across genome-wide per-locus tests — recurrence/imprinting counts not FDR-controlled
all_findings.description: 58 classifies each of 38 positions as recurrent_somatic / recurrent_germline / imprinting_consistent purely by per-sample threshold gates (|hp_axis_delta|>=0.05, |germline_delta|>=0.10) with NO multiplicity control across positions or across the 6 samples tested per position. A grep for multipletests/fdr across the whole scripts dir returns nothing. With 38 positions × 6 samples and a |Δβ|>=0.05 gate, some 'recurrent germline ASM' hits are expected by chance. 59 likewise reports per-locus strong-ASM rate over ~2000 loci with only a per-locus shuffle null for the rate, no FDR on which individual loci are 'strong'.
all_findings.why_wrong: Calling positions 'recurrent' / 'imprinting-consistent' from thresholded effect sizes across many positions without FDR over-states the number of reproducible loci; the headline counts (n_recurrent_germline_asm, n_imprinting_consistent) are not error-rate controlled.
all_findings.evidence: 58:41-43 `ASM_MIN = 0.05; GERM_MIN = 0.10; COV_MIN = 10`; 58:153-162 `if n_germ >= 2: germline_status = 'recurrent_germline_asm' ... (imprinting_consistent_hits if imprinting_consistent else discordant_recurrent_hits).append(hit)` — pure count of samples passing a |delta| gate, no per-position p / FDR. `grep -lE 'multipletests|fdrcorrection|benjamini|fdr_bh' *.py` → empty.
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: Headline recurrence/imprinting counts (and the per-sample n_somatic_asm overlap) are upward-biased; direction-concordance filter (sign_concordant) partially mitigates but does not control FDR.
all_findings.quantification_method: Attach a per-(position,sample) p (read-permutation Δβ null) and apply BH-FDR across the 38×6 grid; recount recurrent_germline / imprinting_consistent at FDR<0.1. Compare to current threshold-only counts in cross_sample_synthesis.json.
all_findings.fix_direction: Add per-locus permutation p + BH-FDR before declaring recurrence; or frame counts explicitly as descriptive effect-size tallies (not significance claims) in the paper text.

all_findings.title: Δβ口徑 inconsistency between scripts feeding the same paper: 03_step4 uses 5mC-only ('m'), while 33/34/49 use 5mC/5hmC MAX-collapse — same BRCA2 Δβ measured two different ways
all_findings.description: 03_step4 builds the per-CpG methylation call using ONLY mod_code=='m' (5mC), discarding 5hmC (get_methylation_calls:64-65 `if mod_code != 'm': continue`). The per-tag cohesion (33) and the normal-anchored cis-test (34) instead MAX-collapse the two mod rows per (read,CpG) (`if cpg not in mat[rid] or mc > mat[rid][cpg]`), i.e. include 5hmC when its ML exceeds 5mC. 59/57 use 5mC-only again. So the headline BRCA2 Δβ and the cis-test on the SAME locus are computed under two different mod definitions. Memory note documents the buggy −0.054 vs −0.122 BRCA2 history arose exactly from a 5mC+5hmC double-row砍半 artifact; this口徑 split is the same family of risk.
all_findings.why_wrong: 5mC-only and max(5mC,5hmC) are different signals; comparing/combining Δβ across scripts (e.g. cis-test verdict vs flagship Δβ) mixes口徑. 49's own audit notes max-collapse is dominated by 5mC, but where 5hmC>5mC the two differ — and the max-collapse can systematically shift beta upward relative to 5mC-only.
all_findings.evidence: 03_step4:64-65 `if mod_code != 'm': continue` (5mC only). 33:48-49 `if cpg not in mat[rid] or mc > mat[rid][cpg]: mat[rid][cpg] = mc` where meth_call already encodes any-mod max-collapse from MSA Level1. 49:117-122 collapse_max `return max(vals)`.
all_findings.effect_hypothesis: BRCA2/control Δβ magnitudes differ between the 5mC-only path (03/57/59) and the max-collapse path (33/34); if 5hmC is non-trivial at BRCA2 the cis-test deltas and the flagship Δβ are not on the same scale.
all_findings.quantification_method: Recompute BRCA2 HP1-vs-HP1-1 Δβ both ways (5mC-only and max-collapse) on HCC1395_tagged.bam ±600bp; report the difference and the frac of dual-called CpGs where 5hmC>5mC (49 already emits frac_5hmC_gt_5mC). Decide one canonical口徑.
all_findings.fix_direction: Pick ONE mod definition for all paper Δβ (5mC-only is the modkit-recommended primary per 57's own comment) and apply uniformly; if max-collapse is kept anywhere, label it distinctly and never compare across口徑.

all_findings.title: cis-candidate verdict gated by a magic heuristic (|d_cis| > 1.8·|d_drift| + 0.02) + uncorrected per-CpG Wilcoxon across ~10 control loci
all_findings.description: The normal-anchored cis-test declares a locus 'CIS-cand' when `pcis < 0.05 and abs(dcis) > 1.8*abs(ddr) + 0.02` (line 149). The 1.8× multiplier and +0.02 offset are unsourced magic constants with no calibration/justification. p_cis/p_somatic/p_drift are per-CpG Wilcoxon (line 118-119, same dependency problem as PYASM-1) and are NOT corrected across the ~10 control loci nor across the 3 deltas (somatic/cis/drift) tested per locus. The verdict that decides 'true cis-driven' vs 'drift' for the paper rides on these.
all_findings.why_wrong: An arbitrary effect-ratio threshold + an uncorrected, anti-conservative p jointly determine a qualitative paper claim (cis-specific vs germline-drift).
